reviews.author: Charu
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text:
During my vacation to Kashmir, many friends told me that Khyber was overhyped. I always disagreed  it was on my bucket list, and I truly believed it would live up to its reputation. But when I finally arrived, I was deeply disappointed.

The rooms are in urgent need of refurbishment. The plumbing clearly requires attention, and the overall condition feels tired. The lift system is confusing  at one point you take one lift, at another level you need to change to a different one. Given that it’s built on a hilly terrain, some structural complexity may be unavoidable, but poor maintenance and lack of clarity are not. Cleanliness was another concern; certain areas felt dingy rather than luxurious.

To their credit, they upgraded us to a suite with a balcony, which was a relief and certainly better than the initial room allotted. The food was good, and the live santoor playing was honestly the biggest highlight of the stay  it added a beautiful Kashmiri touch to the ambiance. The spa experience with therapist Islary was excellent as well. Varun and Abhishek genuinely tried their best to make our stay comfortable, and their effort is appreciated.

However, good staff efforts and cultural touches cannot compensate for the pressing need to invest in upkeep and room maintenance. Unfortunately, I now have to agree with what I once dismissed — this property does feel overhyped.

reviews.author: AK
reviews.title: A Magical and Unforgettable Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg, and it was certainly the most memorable trip of our lives. We had booked 2 rooms for our family, and we absolutely loved our stay. The hotel truly stands out for its exceptional hospitality, which goes far beyond expectations. The staff are extremely polite, warm, and always ready to help with a genuine smile.

The property itself is breathtakingly beautiful, surrounded by stunning mountain views and lush greenery. Every corner of the hotel reflects luxury, comfort, and attention to detail. The restaurant staff went way beyond to ensure that guests were comfortable and well taken care of. The room service team was also very prompt, polite, and helpful throughout our stay.

The location is perfect, as the hotel is right next to the Gondola point, making it very convenient for guests. There are also multiple taxis available just outside the hotel, which makes commuting easy. The breakfast and dinner spreads were lavish, with a wide variety of delicious options catering to different tastes.

The spa and wellness facilities are excellent, and the overall ambience of the resort is very peaceful and relaxing. The rooms were spacious, warm, and offered spectacular views of the snow-covered mountains, making the experience even more special. The hotel also offers great activities and personalized experiences, which made our family holiday even more enjoyable.

Overall, it was a magical stay, and we would highly recommend The Khyber to anyone visiting Gulmarg. It is truly a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and warm hospitality.

reviews.author: Lokamitra
reviews.title: Fancy hotel, fancy pricing poor culinary hygiene.
reviews.text:
The place is very high brow with an astronomic pricing so it was full of well-heeled guests. The architecture is beautiful and the service very responsive. 

Food:  We only ordered two ala carte  items. It took some time to come but the food was well prepared. The mutton and rotis were excellent.  They brought us some sweet items complimentary but we found them unappealing.

Ambience: It was pleasant with a local musician playing the famous Kashmiri instrument the Rabab.  The traditional music was nice but it didn’t last and one of the staff wanted the artist to pluck out some filmy songs to sing too.  it was sad to hear such a fine instrument plucking out Bollywood songs for the entertainment of the employees who obviously didn’t care for their own traditional music.  The overall effect was that the place was attempting “classy” without the staff having a real understanding of what entails.

The only thing that kind of clashed with the ambience was the serving of water in plastic bottles.  Glass decanters would have been more aesthetic.

Disaster:  The sad thing is both of us fell ill after the meal.  Neither of us had eaten early in the day since breakfast and we ate the same dishes at this hotel.  The difference was that I ate much more of the lotus stem starter my partner had very little.  Within two hours I was vomiting and having loose motions.  Violently sick.  The whole night I had to continuously go to the bathroom for 10 times until in the morning the only thing returning was the water I was drinking in-between the bouts.  I am pretty sure that the lotus stem dish was the culprit though it could have been the side salad of carrot,radish and tomatoes or  even the complimentary sweet items.

I had heard such great things about the hotel and the food was very tasty and well presented.  Something went wrong with the food hygiene.

reviews.author: Sanhita B
reviews.title: I would love to stay here again.. worth the hype :)
reviews.text:
If u think Gulmarg is heaven on earth, then Khyber was the icing on the cake. Yes it was an expensive 2 nights and I was apprehensive when I booked it but after staying there I thought it was pretty much worth it :) the room was excellent and quite massive. It was my husband’s birthday and I had asked for a surprise cake which was sent to the room and it was fantastic and really truly fresh and delicious. Between the two of us we finished the 1/2 kilo cake without any problem, and we call ourselves light eaters! So u know how good it was :) the hotel has an Italian restaurant hidden away from prying eyes called Brava where we had dinner twice coz we liked it so much. That is where we met Varun (the manager). I cannot praise him enough! On the first night he got us a little treat for my husband birthday and on the second night he recommended a mushroom soup (gucci) which was delicious and something we would have never ordered on our own. He also made us some brilliant coffee and mocha at breakfast the next morning. Basically he went out of his way to make us comfortable and happy and I can’t thank him enough.  Kudos to him! I would also like to thank the chef at the Italian restaurant deshraj whose cooking was out of this world and he too made us feel very at home while we were dining there. The rest of the hotel was also beautiful and well maintained. The lounge is a nice place to sit and watch the view outside and relax but the service there wasn’t that great unfortunately.  There is a great heated pool as well to use. One other staff I would like to mention specifically would be Waseem at the check in check out desk. He was very professional and quick and efficient which I totally appreciate. 
The one thing I would like to point out is that the hotel has a steep climb from the gondola station.. the gondola station is actually quite close so that is another advantage of staying here. So coming back to the steep climb, it would be nice if the hotel had a buggy kind of service for that. If they do have one, it was not mentioned to us. If my parents were with me, they would not have been able to walk up that road to the hotel. 
All in all, I would give it a 5 star. We loved it and we thank everyone who made out stay memorable

reviews.author: Murtuza B
reviews.title: Kashmir and Khyber - Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
Stayed from 12-16 February.

Jaw dropping view which begins right from the time you are climbing from district tonmerg to gulmarg. Postcard views from all sides but this is just the beginning since you can spend hours just seeing the Himalayas from the resort.  

The pool is again unique and a great spot for photos. Many thanks to Ms. Bilkees for her assistance. She was also kind to bandage a cut that I got while entering the jacuzzi which they need to change. The state of it is very old and it barely works in terms of pressure or heat so I believe this needs to changed.  

Meals are all good considering the remote location. Chefs always come and check on you and offer dishes sometimes outside the menu. Many thanks to Varun for his assistance during breakfast. Saima is also sweet and genuinely good to my kids. 

I have to give a special mention to Junaid from the restaurant who really worked hard to make each meal a special experience. After a point the meals gets repetitive and he made sure to customize each meal as per our preference. He really is an asset to the hotel and I hope he is looked after well.

I also would like to thank Waseem and also irfan Hussain for coming out of his way and assisting us with photos.

My 2 cents of advice to this beautiful hotel. Integrate the concierge to book activities and transportation for the guests. Currently they direct you to vendors and it is difficult to haggle with them sometimes. Fix the shower tap handle. It’s difficult to adjust the temperature and sometimes suddenly you get very hot water and sometimes it’s too cold. I did not enjoy my shower. Change the jacuzzi in the men section. 

We will be back surely whenever we visit Kashmir.

reviews.author: ashm99
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth !! Simply Outstanding !!
reviews.text:
After reading so many raving reviews on TripAdvisor and avid recommendations by several friends, we decided to plan a stay for 2 nights at Khyber ! We were simply blown away by this beautiful property that would make Taj and Oberois of the world a run for their money !! 

 It was peak winter in Gulmarg with temperatures around -6 degrees with ample snow and daily snowfall. The hotel seemed straight out of a postcard with a wonderful backdrop of stunning Himalayas. 

The pickup from Srinagar was very smooth and reasonably priced at 5k. Highly recommended because if you book your own vehicle, you may have to make a change at Tangmarg, where you need to take a vehicle with snow chains on tyres. 

The check-in was smooth with their signature welcome drink. The room was quite spacious. We chose a room without balcony, as balcony rooms don't make much sense for winter months where you can't step out. The view was amazing !! 

The decor and architecture of the entire hotel has been very tastefully done with walnut wood used in abundance. The pool area, the spa and the garden outside (although covered fully with snow) are simply stunning !! 

The service in the restaurant and the housekeeping both were too notch !! The hotel even organized a small birthday celebration for my daughter, which was very touching. A special thanks to Mr Arindam who was very courteous. Aamir Javed in the restaurant was super efficient. 

Our Guide Bilal 8899261148 was the best guide we ever had ! Very honest and he helped us save a lot of money and gave perfect recommendations. Highly recommended for all travel plans to Gulmarg. 

The only suggestion I would like to give is to organize some live music in the lobby or the restaurant during  weekend evenings. 

Overall a terrific stay !! Must visit atleast once a lifetime.

reviews.text: Absolutely enjoyed our stay at Khyber. The staff is very kind and welcoming. Hands on with all the requests. reviews.author: Parag Chitale
reviews.title: Too much hype about Khyber
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber in a group of 10 (5 couples) and realised that Khyber is one of the most over rated hotels. While the location is excellent and the indoor heated swimming pool is a great facility to have, the hospitality and service is pathetic. We found the staff to be very arrogant, not at all warm. We experienced absolutely horrible service - order something and keep waiting whether it is in restaurant or in room dining. Any request at Khyber is met with a response - its not part of our policy. In spite of having a dinner included package, a waiter chased us after dinner asking us to pay. And this is after 3 different people checking our room number while entering the restaurant. 

For the amount they charge, their service and hospitality is absolutely rubbish. We would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

We had a big group and he was kind enough to host an evening dinner for us. The best place to stay in Gulmarg. reviews.author: Gaurav Deshpande
reviews.title: Heaven in heaven .. !!
reviews.text:
What an amazing place The Khyber is .. !! 

Amazingly convenient location for all excursions in Gulmarg and stunning views from the rooms. The decor and the amenities perfectly compliment the natural beauty around. Its confusing - you fall in love with Gulmarg and then you have an equally amazing experience at The Khyber!

We visited during winter and experienced some amazing snowfall. The Khyber with its open decks and open space is perfect to enjoy snow and build a fine snowman while enjoying a nice Kashmiri kehwa or a nice hot chocolate! 

The food at 'Cloves' is really nice with a good spread. A slight let down that we could not taste authentic Kashmiri food at the buffet. 

The staff is extremely warm and friendly without being intrusive and ensuring that the guests have their own space. Firdous bhai at Cloves was extremely nice and helpful towards us. Unfortunately, I do not remember the names of the other staff members. However, every single local person we met at The Khyber, in Gulmarg and in Kashmir in general was extremely warm and helpful!

Now looking forward to the next visit to The Khyber!

To stay in Khyber was an amazing experience, one of the best skii resorts worldwide. Taken away by the beauty of Gulmarg. Kashmir is really heaven on earth. A special thanks to the front desk guy a young gentleman named Aarif Bhatt who helped us smoothly check in and guided us around the property very well. Cheers!! 
Look forward to come every year !!

reviews.author: Saurav C
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth - Jannat
reviews.text:

Let me start with thanking Mr. Abdul ji who was the 1st to meet and greet us at the Srinagar airport. He is humble, well educated and ready with all the answer to all the questions a tourist wishes to know. A very save chauffeur and well behaved.

I would like to thank Mr. Vaibhav, who is the food and beverage manager, who has an excellent well behaved staff. Let me start with Mr. Junaid -  Excellent Human, Good at heart and serves all Khyber guests with all that one needs. I would like to appreciate the care give to us by Mr. Sajad Mr. Suowket Mr. Navin Mr.  Jaweed Mr.  Ishfaq and Mr.  Aamir to name a few. Cheers & Regards
Saurav Chatterjee

reviews.author: Deepthi S
reviews.title: A wonderful place to stay!
reviews.text:
I and my husband stayed here in Feb 2021. The resort is beautifully nestled between mountains. One can see the opulence upon entering the hotel's main entrance. The reception staff aren't very active in receiving guests as would be expected in a 5 star. That being said, the restaurant staff are one of the most hospitable and courteous that you can find. Special mention to Mr.Govind and Mr.Iqbal for their great service and ever smiling and pleasant behaviour. Also the manager, a tall, lean, bespectacled person (I don't recollect his name), was also very courteous, sometimes even removing our plates after we were done. They always asked us about our day and if we were enjoying the food. They are a true representation of customer service and hospitality.

The rooms are very cozy and the heating system is top notch. Even when the temperature outside is sub zero, you will feel very normal inside the room. 

One small thing that can be improved is the shower. It had temperature control but did not have flow control. Or maybe it was just with our room. So every time you want hot water, the flow will be at the maximum. This is a waste of water and can be worked upon. 

We had all our meals there itself. The buffet spread was average, nothing special to write about. However the ala carte food is delicious. You should definitely try their mutton biriyani, for that matter any of their mutton dishes. They should really concentrate on improving their buffet spread. Both taste and variety need to be worked upon.

Overall it's the best place to stay in Gulmarg. There are few improvements that are needed but this is an experience not to be missed.

reviews.author: Nikk
reviews.title: One of the best experiences ever had in Gulmarg !
reviews.text:
Well , at the first place I would like to rate the hotel on different attributes

reviews.author: Saurabh gupta

reviews.author: Monil P

reviews.text: Everything about this resort is perfect .. right from check-in process to hotel facilities to hospitality .. u can say food spread is not up to 5* luxury standards but can’t complain .. special mention to Govind singh ( staff of restaurant ) for his prompt service with is ever smiling face ... our meals for 3 days were best experienced because of him .. my daughter still miss him ❤️

reviews.author: RajatParakh
reviews.title: Poor Service.
reviews.text: Great place and superb ambience. Wish the service was as good . Our room had a heating issue and nobody seemed to know how to fix it . Had come with some great expectations,  but was completely let down. Maybe coz the hotel was completely sold out. Would not want to come back for sure .

reviews.author: zorbathetraveller
reviews.title: Not worth you money at all - Pls read it before booking

In restaurants also services are very poor. You may find good reviews of this property but the problem is Khyber is taking advantage of no other big hotel in this area. If Hyatt Oberoi and Marriott are allowed to open their hotels here - no one will go and stay in this property. I contacted front desk staff Mr. Vishwas for the bill and he spoke in so rudely manner. Have stayed in so many 5 stars in India as well as abroad but never experienced such pathetic cuatomer service ever. The force of showed was dead slow - we complained at the front desk but no one bothered to come and check. There was a continuous bad smell outside room and told the room service staff also many a times but no one did anything. Food taste was the worst. Pls avoid booking this property if u want to have a memorable experience of your trip.

reviews.author: Jay M
reviews.title: The paradise in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The hotel is really worth the price.
The view is mesmerizing. Hotel service by Suhail Habib was remarkable. 

The hotel is perfect gateway for holiday. Just breakfast is OK Ok not that great. 

Our family had good time.

There staff Arif Hussain is good Person in this property he suggests as very well I have enjoy a lot with my friends in hotel & Gulmarg also nice place to visit for fun

reviews.author: Bhavesh Bhansali
reviews.title: ONE OF THE BEST LUXURIOUS PROPERTY IN GULMARG
reviews.text:

reviews.title: One of the best Property  at Gulmurg
reviews.text: Good Location . Enjoyed Stay at Hotel on 22nd February 2020. Recommend for Family Trip . excellent spread at break fast . Best Quality of Vegetarian Food . Seightseen and other activities are near to Hotel . Room attached with  Balcony gives clear view of snowfall.

reviews.author: Ram1975
reviews.title: White KASHMIR!!!
reviews.text:
It snowed heavily during our short stay and the green turned into white overnight... just amazing

Do take a room with balcony to enjoy the views and the rooms are large and perfect

reviews.author: Bandish P
reviews.title: Best Property to stay in Gulmarg if u wanna Spend
reviews.text: We had stayed in the wild flower a year back and the next one on the list was khyber. well if you compare the two the wild flower beats this property. But none the less khyber is very good too. The downside is that there is no alcohol served here. But very few know that you can bring your own alcohol which they allow you to drink in the sheesha lounge for no extra cost. Another downside is that pool is not heated enough. It is just a lil warm and it would have been nicer to have better temperature control. The food here is to die for. The buffet is expensive but totally worth it. We stayed here for 3 days and each day we got the chance of different dishes. Hardly anything was repeated in breakfast or dinner. The food is very well made and the staff is very courteous and polite too. The spa treatment was good too. Please prebook this if you intend to get it done. The rooms are huge and spacious but i found a few problems like the air conditioning did not keep the temperature steady and the refrigerator also wasnt working. I think having a balcony in your room would be awesome so choose your room accordingly.

reviews.author: Tanisha Mehta
reviews.title: Khyber is a winter lovers paradise. It's like living in a snowglobe!
reviews.text: My stay in Khyber was for a short span of three nights four days.  The hotel is such a beautiful property that four days won't do justice to seeing it and enjoying it completely. The amenities of the hotel are of international ski resort categories and the service is commendable. Hamid , Amir , Roohi and the entire staff of khyber made my time there a memorable one. If you are stuck for anything in gulmarg Hamid is your go to man, his hospitality is a true example of the warmth and hospitality of Kashmiri people. I will cherish these memories forever. The staff is there constantly on their feet at any time day and night to make you feel at home. The food is lip smacking and perfectly complimenting the view alongside their clove restaurant. The spa is so relaxing you wouldn't want to leave it.  Dipali's service in the spa made my day, I was completely relaxed and could enjoy the rest of my trip. Their staff is their strength. Their Kawah made by Amir is so yummy you'd wish you could bring it back home. The resort is royal, kashmiri and a paradise one could only dream  about. Khyber made my white winter wonderland dream come true and I cannot thank them enough for it! Khyber and Kashmir will definately be a recurring trip on my travel bucket list!

reviews.author: Jigar D
reviews.title: Stay during our skiing trip
reviews.text: This hotel has excellent views. Staff is courteous and always smiling. House keeping team of Waheed and Sameer always kept room sparkling clean. Hotel team took care of all our needs. We stayed for 5 nights and every day we were served with mouth watering delicacies.

reviews.author: Nikhil Javeri
reviews.title: Magical Fairytale - The Khyber Himalayan Resort
reviews.text:
We were completely overwhelmed and mesmerised with the beautiful resort. It is truly located at the best place in Gulmarg amidst the pine trees. We were also taken aback by their warm hospitality extended by the courteous staff . The rooms were exceptionally clean with the best
 view one can get, house keeping was done on a timely basis, the swimming pools location is excellent, the restaurant has a great variety of food with extremely tasty delicacies. All our special requests were taken good care of.

Special mention to Basharat, Mohd Rafi, Kader and Firdous for their excellent services and always taking good care of us.

A visit to Gulmarg is incomplete without 
a stay in Magical Khyber resort.

reviews.author: SumitIndianTraveller
reviews.title: Great location, good food, decent service.
reviews.text:
Travelled to Gulmarg in 1st week of January 2020. The intention was to enjoy snow as much as we can since there is none in New Delhi. I had booked 3 nights stay at Khyber from Makemytrip in november but as i got near to January i was worried if flights are cancelled due to bad weather what will happen to my hotel booking. But all went well and we reached Kashmir-heaven on Earth. I had arranged my transfer from Srinagar airport to Khyber and back  with the hotel. It is a little expensive(INR 3500 each way) but they take care of everything then. As soon as i landed there was a person from hotel waiting in the luggage belt area. Got luggage and moved towards Gulmarg. The car sent was a 4x4 scorpio which surely is required to drive n the snow from Tangmarg-Gulmarg. Till Tangmarg the roads are clean and a normal car works but not from Tangmarg-Gulmarg.It was constantly snowing and there was a lot of snow on the road which made it slippery as well. On way to Gulmarg the driver assisted in renting the boots required for walking in snow from Tangmarg as normal shoes won't work in 5ft or more of snow.Always bargain everywhere in Kashmir. They ask for 3 times the normal prices for everything. 
On reaching the hotel was given welcome drink kashmiri Kahva-great taste. After the check-in formalities was shown way to my room which was what i booked a luxury balcony room with Gulmarg view. I would surely recommend everyone to book a balcony room to enjoy snow. Though you can hardly sit outside for long but having a balcony surely has its charm. The problem i faced before reaching Kashmir was i tried to connect with hotel several times and a lot of times the reservation person does not pick up the phone. 
The property is built with taste and i believe a lot of effort. The resort is centrally heated which is surely required.There is gym,heated pool , jacuzzi ,steam ,sauna in the hotel. The hotel also has a kids play area but it is next to nothing. I believe the snow is the best thing to play here for kids. The gym was decent with good views and working machines. 

Room: The room was spacious with central heating. Had a separate shower and a bath tub. Enough space for luggage , had a locker in the almirah , tea coffee, water sufficient in the room. The property is running old and they are not refurbishing things like the sofa in the room was in a very bad shape. It had lost all the cushioning and was dirty as well. No one cleaned balcony in 3 days and when i requested that there is too much snow in the balcony then they sent someone to clean it. The room has a desk but you cannot work on it. Not a good design to put a laptop and work. 

Spa/swimming pool: On the website it was mentioned that the pool is under renovation but it was operational when i reached hotel. Now the hotel sells the swim suits etc at exorbitant prices. the pool surely has the best views of snow clad mountains. The spa is not the best. The steam room does not work properly and someone needs to check that. There was hardly an attendant in the spa area. 

The property is minutes from the famous Gondola ride which will take you the mountains to enjoy the beauty of Kashmir. Though there are people at the resort who would want to be your guide for a fee but i recommend to enjoy yourself. Just walk down the road and take left and you will be at the ticket counter for Gondola. The guide / car hiring / sledging etc all are quoted 3 times by the people outside the resort. So bargain for everything.One of the days i just walked from the resort to the Gulmarg main market and there was no problem except people troubling you to hire sledges or car or take guide. 

Food: The food was good on all occasions here. 2 out of 3 nights we had the buffet as the manager offered us 1+1 deal on the buffet. Prices for a-la-carte are too steep. Breakfast was decent ,loved the south Indian dosa that they prepare. 

The hotel does not serve alcohol but you are welcome to get your own and drink in their shish lounge. They do serve shish and some snacks there. 

Phones : Were not working in Gulmarg. I had vodafone which did not have any signal in Gulmarg. Reliance & Airtel i believe work.

Last word: The hotel is not the best 5 star property i have stayed in but surely it a commendable job done at such height. The prices they are charging are a little on higher side but i thing to maintain this property in Kashmir surely is a big task.

reviews.author: Ashif Memon
reviews.title: Best Hotel not only in Gulmarg but Kashmir
reviews.text: This amazingly located hotel is in the heart of Gulmarg with breathtaking view of Afarwat & Himalayas with the best of food at renowned Cloves restaurant, world class room service, amenities like heated pool, jacuzzi & spa. On top of it, it's walking distance to Gondola rides. I accidentally called Sanjeev - Sr. Manager at Khyber & although he wasn't supposed to assist me with booking, he did get me the best deal & than put me on with the Manager - Manzoor who was very helpful. All the hotel staff were very courteous & well mannered. I can't forget Aijaz in the restaurant area as he provided personalized service experience to my family, he remembered names of my 2 childrens as well. In a nutshell, out stay at this hotel was memorable & one of the best experiences.

reviews.author: Ankit_divine
reviews.title: Amazing. This is how Jannat will be.
reviews.text:
We have just spent 3 wonderful days here and were sorry to leave. Me and my friend celebrated our wedding anniversary at this beautiful place.

 Our stay at Khyber resort was the highlight of our vacation in Jammu n Kashmir. The resort is located in the most spectacular part of Gulmarg with great views from the resort. And is near to all the major attractions like golf course and gondola.

This is a centrally heated resort which was a boon during the winter as we visited with sub zero temperatures. The rooms are amazing in size, tastefully furnished with state of art bathroom and heavenly views!! Our view outside was straight out of a fairytale!!

Built passionately and tastefully by Mr. Umer Tramboo. Who is such a gem of a person. We were fortunate enough to meet him personally. He even invited us for the dinner. Such a down to earth person. 

To mention Mr Hamid helped us out during over stay. He took care of all our needs no matter what. (Dont rem his department as he helped in every matter).

The hotel doesn’t serve/sell alcohol but you’re welcome to bring your own booze and sit in the sisha lounge and drink. This worked out quite comfortably. There is service there and you get everything you need. A SHOUTOUT to Firdous, at the Shisha lounge. His service was exemplary.

The property has heated pool which has breathtaking views of snow clad mountains no words can explain beauty of this place..

We would certainly return to this hotel as its locatiom is perfect, the staff are friendly and obviously well trained and the facilities are excellent.

reviews.author: AKD
reviews.title: Redefining JANNAT-e-KASHMIR!! Paradise is here......  WORLD CLASS LUXURIOUS PROPERTY!!
reviews.text:
“Gar firdaus bar-rue zamin ast, hami asto, hamin asto, hamin ast.” “If there is a heaven on earth, it’s here, it’s here"
I am not sure where to begin!!
being Dubai-ites and avid world travellers, our definition of & expectations from a  luxurious property are very high!!
I can proudly say that Khyber, built passionately and tastefully by Mr. Umer Tramboo, is truely a feather in India's cap......... and our kids not only loved the skiing(in fact found it better than europe), but they are in awe of this magnificent property!!
Built on the best location in Gulmarg with views of heaven and more importantly Amazing maintained and serviced as a world class resort!!
ITS BETTER THAN THE PICS!!
Led ably by the young owner, the onsite Hotel Director, Mr. Sanjeev Gupta and his professional and well staffed team, esp. the front office manager Mr. Manzoor,  ensured that even before our arrival, we are comfortable with everything from the room and view selection, to mela preferences, to transfers, hotel spa details and facilities, help with the best ski instructors, etc. 
The rooms are amazing in size, tastefully furnished with state of art bathroom and heavenly views!! Our himalayan facing room was 570sq.ft. and the view outside was straight out of a fairytale!!
The world class spa is mind-blowing!! Huge heated pool, super jacuzzi, steam, sauna facilities open till late and to top it off the world class La'occtaine Spa, with amazing staff and service!!
The multi-cuisine food is to die for........everything form local kashmiri cuisine to world class continental dishes to super live stations and amazing service led by Mr. Shyam!!
There were always eager to please staff everywhere!!
The lobby and coffee shop are massive and tastefully done and surprisingly very well heated, is super place to hang out after a day out in the snow!!
The location of the resort is perfectly central and 200 mtrs from the world class Gondola!! The ski patrol team lead by professional team of Brian Newman, have made it a world class ski destination, in spite of the lack of support from the administration & Central Govt.. All the foreign skiiers I met there said the snow powder qulity better than Europe, slopes r longer, safety world class, off piste is best in the world, in this only among the 2 such high Gondola(cable car) accessible ski slopes in the world. The cable car, itself, is world class French, similar to all leading ski destination in the world. The able certified ski guides, like Javed, Mushtaq and Mehmood, bring respectand class to the slopes. My kids found it better than Europe for several reasons. Indian Govt., can use his venue as the best showcase to restore normalcy in Kashmir, by bringing in tourists in hordes. This is the game changer than Central Govt. needs to recognize. 
Khyber complements the luxurious world class definition of this ski destination.
The super drivers, 4x4 vehicles to navigate snow and the fantastic rooms and service make Khyber the MUST VISIT destination in India. Kudos to Team Khyber.

reviews.author: Amruta Shirodkar
reviews.title: Mesmerising!
reviews.text:
Me and my husband celebrated our wedding anniversary at this beautiful place. The hotel is simply superb. A perfect winter destination!! The rooms offer excellent views of the snow covered mountains. The rooms are centrally heated and very comfortable even at - 10 outside ❄!! The food is simply superb. All the staff are extremely polite and co operative. The spa is very good. We visited it twice. Swimming pool is heated and there's excellent jacuzzi, steam and sauna. The gondola is walking distance and we went upto phase one for sking.
They have some excellent hookah. Breakfast spread at cloves was excellent.
Keep it up khyber!! We look forward to visiting you again.

reviews.author: prernasinha2000
reviews.title: The Khyber Resort & Spa- Luxurious And The Best Option In Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Rooms
It is a 85-room resort with beautiful views of the valley and the Himalayas. Wooden ceilings, luxurious interiors and spacious rooms are some of the wonderful features of this resort. Our room had a balcony with majestic views of the Himalayas. While the morning and the evenings were chilly, with the temperatures dropping to almost 0 degrees, the days are lovely and we would step out or even sit with a book in the balcony.

Cottages
Apart from the rooms they also have an option of the cottages with a private hideaway.

Fitness centre
They a reasonable size gym with well appointed machines, dumbbells and other accessories. There are separate sauna and steam facilities as well as jacuzzis. Again the views from here make winter workouts interesting.

Swimming Pool
The one feature that is covered in almost all the magazines is their heated indoor swimming overlooking the snow laden coniferous forest. It’s a luxury you understand when you are in a cold, freezing atmosphere.

Kids play area- IGLOO
This was well equipped but at the basement and we tried going there twice but it was deserted so we skipped the same. They also have a games room if you want to catch a quick round of snooker or billiards.

The Den
They have the concept of the Den which is where you can watch movies of your choice but we never got the time to check this one out. Restaurants

Cloves
Most of our meals were eaten here. The breakfast has an amazing lay and for dinner and lunch they have a buffet and an ala carte option. I thought the food was pretty decent.

If you are a non-vegetarian then their Kashmiri thali is a must-try though you might need two people to finish it off.

Nouf
Nouf has to be booked in advance and in our usual hurried trip style we never ended up doing the same but it is supposed to have stunning views from every direction. Freshly grilled meats, cooked just the way you like on traditional coal-fired barbecues. Nouf is ideal for a cozy dinner by the candlelight. Definitely on my list for the next time.

Chaikash
Think of it as their coffee shop. It is just next to their lobby and perfect place to lounge and have tea or Kahwa. Their Kahwa is absolutely delicious and for us it became an evening routine to just sit their with our books and chat and indulge in some couple time here.

Do not forget to create a snowman and indulge in some snow fights while you are surrounded 

OTHER ACTIVITIES
Trekking and Fishing
Treks are closed in winters but if you head here in a slightly bearable weather the the trek to Khilanmarg Valley to see spring flowers is supposed to be enchanting. If you are an adventure seeker then you can trek to the serene Alpather Lake. For fishing enthusiasts  Ningle Nallah and the Ferozepur Nallah are streams famous for trout fishing.

reviews.author: Abdullah Saeed
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect, the warmest welcoming I have had in India, the best property I have stayed ever, although I am used to boutiques and 5 stars hotels and resorts, yet this resort was amazing in every aspect, breakfast was delicious, staff unlike what some reviews here experienced were warm and kind, I guess they fix that issue. The facilities were nice, the room was spacious. and yes the pool looks as amazing as the pictures :D

reviews.author: deshna c
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed in Khyber for 2 nights, just a couple of days after the attack. We called the property a couple of times before actually going to check on whether it was safe or not. The front desk staff was extremely reassuring that it was safe and we should definitely travel, and that they would shield us if anything went wrong. We did take the trip and it was a one of the most memorable trips. Every single staff member was courteous, helpful and always had a smiling face. The food was delicious, our room had an amazing view of the Himalayan mountain range and we were extremely fortunate to experience snowfall. The house keeping staff Ms Rukaya was really helpful. The restaurant staff and servers made it a point to check on us if we were satisfied with the meal or if we wanted anything else. The general manager Mr Vinit and the front office manager Mr Manzoor were available to answer as all our questions at any point. Over all we had an amazing experience and would love to visit again.

reviews.author: Shobhika G
reviews.title: Superb hospitality
reviews.text:
It was really one of best experience...Khyber having very nice ambience , very well staff.they have a warm pool you can swim with a snow view..
The jacuzzi service in the spa was outstanding and staff ‘ Ruqaya’ done brilliant job ...her service was excellent in jacuzzi and Sona bath places... we really delighted by her comfortable services in ladies bath area..

reviews.author: Monish A
reviews.title: Fantastic property, excellent staff and hospitality
reviews.text:
From the moment you step into the property till the time you leave, all you experience is world class hospitality and smiling faces by the staff. 
The entire team is courteous and willing to help guests no matter what time of the day it is. 
There was never a dull moment while we were at the hotel. The location is amazing especially if you have the Himalayan view by your balcony. 
The food is good with loads of variety catering to both vegetarian and meat eaters. 
Every corner of hotel is clean and well maintained. 
You will be greeted by helpful Jehangir at front office who will be more than willing to guide you with everything. 
Even the security staff is amazing and would always greet you and help you sort out with ski gear. 
Special shout out to both Amir and shayista at the pool area who went out of the way to help guests and us, enjoy the facilities available. They were more than happy to click amazing pictures of us without any sign of unhappiness considering they were working long shifts and were always on their toes to take good care of guests. 
Must visit property.

reviews.author: RKK
reviews.title: Excellent hospitality
reviews.text: It was one of the best and safe stay we have had, hotel has one of the most scenic views possible and great offerings but the most important aspect which made us extend our stay is their staff and hospitality. Right from Mujjamil and Rafi at the reception to Shyam and Bilal in the F&B and Mukesh at housekeeping. Mr. Dasorah ji took a very good care of us and it’s definitely recommended to stay at Khyber and experience their amazing warmth. It’s completely safe for tourists and breathtaking views in winters. Cheers and hope to visit very soon again.

reviews.author: Ro P
reviews.title: Unreasonable
reviews.text:
We had booked this hotel when we were visiting India.  About 4 days before we were suppose to visit - there was a terrorist attack in the area where 40+ people died.  With this place being on the no visit list - we tried to cancel our reservations.  The hotel was so unreasonable that they used the no-refund policy on us at that point.  I understand if we were trying to cancel a reservation for personal reasons but this is something that was out of our control.  The hotel won’t acknowledge that there is a curfew there with 350,000 active troops there.  What kind of social self awareness is this?? They want us to still come to the war zone and stay at their hotel?? 

The ridiculousness of this is that when we were calling their employees weren’t in at work at times due to the curfew and military in town!! I just had high expections from a hotel like this.

I don’t think I would ever stay here again!

reviews.author: alneebari
reviews.title: Amazing from the top
reviews.text: The hotel is in the top of mountain and have amazing view for all rooms and the the restaurants are very good and all staff is helpful and give a good service and they have a warm pool you can swim with a snow view

reviews.author: karangoenka
reviews.title: Very luxurious!
reviews.text: This is the most high end property in Gulmarg. It's v luxurious. Rooms are very comfortable , spacious and well heated. The bathrooms in the rooms are excellent, the shower is simply too good! The hotel is well staffed , with great service and courteous staff. The swimming pool is very good (although the water could have been more heated). The jacuzzi in the spa was excellent although some of the jacuzzi seats weren't working properly. Definitely would recommend this property to people looking for luxury. The property seemed to be very child and family friendly . Please note that this property does NOT serve alcohol but they are very happy to let you carry your own liquor and serve it to you in their hookah lounge.

reviews.author: Kritika Mehta
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I visited the hotel recently with my friends. Everything was great. I dont think i’ve been to a better property than this in India. There heated pool is the lime light!! Must must stay here if planning to go to gulmarg. The view, the vibe, the comfort, service everything is top class.

reviews.author: Nikhil Kanungo
reviews.title: Excellent property & Hospitality
reviews.text:
Excellent views with luxurious services.
Great swimming pool & great food 👍🏻
Good time to chill & stay in hotel especially during winters & snowfalls..

Evening you can spend time @ Sheesha lounge (Known as Calabash lounge)
The manager Of Calabash lounge is so good he can provide you any kind of demands in food.. As we are pure vegetarian he gave us exactly what we want even if the item is not in the menu.. This was the best of all experience..

Also a very bad service of Khyber was during check out when there was snow fall & the road to Khyber was jammed by snow, none of the car’s were able to come up to Khyber to pick us (as the resort is located 300mts of sloppy drive). Khyber did not provide any of the facilities to the customers to drop them till the end of the Resort enterance even after requesting so much as this slope was only & only made to operate the Khyber resorts. So we hired snow mobiles (which were available at hotel lobby itself) & paid 3000/- just for 300mts for 2 person.
This was the worst experience of Khyber .

reviews.author: Tanvi T
reviews.title: A winter Wonderland
reviews.text:
Best resort in Gulmarg infact Kashmir. Their service, facilities, rooms everything is superb. We stayed for 2 nights in Luxury room. Snow was right upto our balcony so that kids were playing in balcony. Resort is centrally heated when there was -5 to -11 outside. 
Indoor heated pool is the highlight of the stay. We used the pool all 3 days. Kids specially enjoyed it.
Their service staff was extremely helpful be it room, restaurant or pool.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gaz
reviews.title: Snow Paradise
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star hotel, but an excellent 4 star hotel with value for your money. The hotel staff are excellent and the Kashmiri hospitality is the best in the world, and trust me I’m a regular traveller. 

The L’occitane Spa is outstanding and a definite “must do” during your stay. 

The Indian food is outstanding and Room Service is fantastic. 

If you haven’t skied you must ski ! It’s a fabulous experience! The Gondola ski lifts is less than a 5 min drive from the hotel. 

Get your own personal ski instructor for as little as $35/day and I would recommend Mushtaq with his brother Imran (+91 96226 41899) are an excellent duo and they took incredible care of us throughout our stay.

reviews.author: marmik m
reviews.title: Brilliant Stay , surreal experience
reviews.text: A lovely property to stay at the staff is extremely warm and friendly and will be at your service for all your needs ( a special shout out to Shahid ( 07006575092) get in touch with him to truly experience gulmarg he is the true meaning of Kashmiriyat )

reviews.author: shristy t
reviews.title: Best property and excellent service
reviews.text: This is the excellent property in India and the way the staff treated is really very nice.... I really thank full to Ms Khalida and Mr Mohshin for their wonderful service.... everything was good in the hotel... location/food/spa/swimming pool everything... my wife and kids really enjoyed a lot .....

reviews.author: jaanvi m
reviews.title: Great staff and amazing hospitality
reviews.text: Khyber indeed justifies being heaven on earth. The property is very well situated and offers breathtaking views from everywhere. The hotel staff makes an add on to make your stay the most memorable . They are so generous and warm and are available 24*7 to provide help. I would like to give a special thanks to chef manish sharma , mr vishal and miss khalida for providing such great hospitality that one would want to visit the hotel time and again. Thankyou to these people for making our stay worth the money.

reviews.author: Ruchika B
reviews.title: Anniversary getaway
reviews.text:
A truly magical property with beauty and grace. The Khyber is everything you are looking for in terms of luxury and hospitality. The experience of having  the local version of tea-khewa  by their scenic tea lounge Chaikash window is a true delight. The property promises to chill and thrill with its gorgeous views and heated indoor pool in the midst of snow claded mountains all around. 
The staff was warm and courteous. A great choice for our anniversary, a truly memorable experience!

reviews.author: parul s
reviews.title: Super stay with stunning views of the pir Panjal
reviews.text: We just returned after a 3 nights stay at the Khyber , we had a fantastic stay which was smooth from the check in till the day we left . The food is great and there’s a huge variety of vegetarian food on the menu , the cottages are spic and spacious and they are much much better and bigger than what the website shows ( please take better pictures and repost )and the service is extremely prompt and the staff is very friendly and warm. The F&B manager Mukesh took great care of the food that was served to us and was always will to accommodate our demands . Asrar at the reception assured that we wasted no time checkin in.The staff is polite and always smiling and courteous... Enjoyed my stay to the fullest - definitely worth a trip .

reviews.author: yashrajesh2016
reviews.title: Woderful
reviews.text: This was our 3rd trip to Khyber and as usual it exceeded expectations.Great food, wonderful vistas, friendly staff and spacious rooms. A big shout out to Manzoor Hamid and Majid at front desk, Imaran, iqbal, Junaiad and Ajaiz  at cloves the restaurant who were particularly warm and welcoming. Will definitely be back for the 4th time.

reviews.author: MlAJAPAN
reviews.title: きれいですが。
reviews.text:
ホテルの雰囲気も良く、部屋やプールからの雪景色は最高の眺めです。スタッフの対応も良し！
また、ホテルにドクターが常駐しており、不調の折来ていただいたところ、とてもよく診ていただき助かりました。

難点をあげれば、連泊中のルームメイクはひどく、ベッドを整え、ゴミを捨てただけでした。アメニティの補充なし、床に落ちたクズはそのまま。
バスルームはシャワーにも問題あり。
辛かったのが、横の部屋のテレビの音が丸聞こえで眠れなかったことです。
これはボリュームの問題というよりも、壁の異常な薄さだと思いました。

いいホテルではあるのですが、宿泊料金に見合っていないようにも思いました。

reviews.author: Reshma A
reviews.title: Enjoyed snowfall
reviews.text: Last year I visited here in April and I had a wish to visit in peak winter to experience snowfall..and I was again warmly welcomed with hot khawah by your staff in that chilled wind,i just loved it, the scenery from this hotel was exciting and I also loved my stay and was impressed by the staff especially f&b dept. The food was great, and they made me feel at home, overall experience was amazing.. I would like to thank all the staff members for such a lovely service.

reviews.author: Bhavna J
reviews.title: Beautiful property, excellent location and amenities
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber in Feb 2018. We wanted to experience snow, some friends wanted to try skiing and go up to phase 2 on the highest cable car in the world. The rooms are nice though this would probably be the most expensive property in gulmarg. There are different levels starting from basic to Himalayan view. However, the experience is worth it because the views from the property are spectacular. See the pics. Breakfast is usually included. Should try and call about including dinner as well because there are very few options and it gets dark by 6pm. 
The heater pool and steam room are a must do to enjoy the property and views.
Overall a very good experience 
PS - food is average, some of the dhabas have better food

reviews.author: Syed Zabi S
reviews.title: F and B department
reviews.text:
I  had been there in my vacation  with my family i really had grate  time and there service were damn good loved it special thanks for Mr:Ajaz,Mr:Bilal,Mr:Mukesh,Mr:junaid and Mr:ishfaq etc i would like to see you all soon.
Thank you

reviews.author: Alaina S
reviews.title: F and Bdepartment
reviews.text: The servic was good and we loved it staying  there and  f n b department  people like Mr.Ajaz,mr bilal,mr mukesh,mr junaid ,mr ishfaq and how can I forget manager as well. they helped us a lot in all aspects by serving us good food I would like to visit again and again to same hotel thank you so much

reviews.author: Radhika S
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with a lovely location. It feels you are at the end of the world and the view of the mountain ranges is the best in Gulmarg from here. Stayed in for two days with good service and nice food. Warm set of people at the hotel receive you with a very warm kahwa drink. They would like to pamper you in all possible ways and a must visit even in winters as snow and Sun play a lovely game which you can watch from the comfort of your room. Today early morning we enjoyed the snowfall from the terrace garden of the hotel. It's a safe heaven for travellers looking for peace and love. Be careful only with the guides outside the hotel. Worth visiting is the gondola and snow bike rides. If you love yourself do visit this lovely resort and get spoilt.

reviews.author: Punit Gadhia
reviews.title: Good property!! Rooms with MOUSE
reviews.text:
Check in: Quick n easy. Were upgraded to a luxury himalayan view room 

Food: 
breakfast not as per 5 star standards. It was brief and similar to a 3 star offerings. We have been to Hyatt and Taj. And nothing compares to the spread that they offer. Surprisingly, Kashmir being a state offering abundant dry fruits, we didnt see any of the dry fruit being served during the breakfast. 

Lunch and dinner: overpriced as compared to the portions that were offered. 

Room ambience: 
Good view of the Himalayan range from the balcony. Decent ambience. 

Good toiletries. Spacious bathroom 

Now coming to the most horrifying and depressing part of our stay:

WE SPOTTED A MOUSE INSIDE OUR ROOM (2021). OH MY GOD!!!! Yes u read it right. A MOUSE.....

Does this sound familiar to anyone else... 

after spending a BOMB and hoping to receive the best of luxury services. Its indeed horrifying to have rodent infested rooms. On questioning we get a response that since its winter time, thats why maybe the rodent must have ventured in. 

Seriously!!!! 

Staff’s reaction on the MOUSE issue:
Housekeeping staff tried his best to assist but in vain

No Manager came inspite of us asking for one to come and meet us. I agree to one of the travellers review that the staff at Khyber are taking their guests for Granted. 

The Manager came to meet us only after we settled our bills. This was just Ridiculous on his part being a Manager. Shame on you Mr. Manzoor. By the look of it we understand that this was not taken seriously by any of the staff. 

Highly disappointed!!

reviews.author: shoeman015
reviews.title: Could have been great
reviews.text: A  great building definitely the most luxurious in Gulmarg but it lacks any character. There always seemed to be lots of staff but when you wanted one they were nowhere to be seen. if you wanted something out of the ordinary like a booking for dinner in an alternative location the concierge refused to help. We had already paid for dinner but ate out 3 nights for a bit of a change. Breakfast was very good and the masala dhosa was the best i have had. The spa was good but the pool and steam room looked like they could do with a good clean. Gulmarg was great and the Khyber could have been.

reviews.author: Aarif123
reviews.title: Skiing
reviews.text: Hi i stayed in Khyber with my friend from 12th February to 15th February.  The hotel is incredibly beautiful and more beautiful thing is Staff which is very cooperative especially two young female staff Pakeezah and Khalida. Their food is keeping the worlds best tastes in one bowel. Only request to add Nun Chai (Kashmiri Green Tea) in the menu.  My final choice in kashmir is Khyber.

reviews.author: Kaushik D
reviews.title: A huge property with zero hospitality!!
reviews.text:
We visit Gulmarg/Kashmir almost every year in different seasons. Wanted to try out Khyber after all the reviews. Overall, supremely disappointed!!!

Location : Thats an advantage, closest to the Gulmarg Gondola counter. Amazing views of the Aphrawat ranges, (only from high end rooms)

Ambience/Common Areas : It's a wonderful building. Well spread out property and well maintained.

Room : Moderately spacious. But the décor is pathetic. Neither traditional nor chic, just a hybrid, confused mess.

Food : Bad.!The breakfast assortment was sub optimal and didn't justify the "Luxury" tag. Variety was totally missing. Obscenely high priced for the taste and portion size. Hashbrowns and Croissants never tasted so dull and rubbery. The omelettes were good though!

Staff : That's the worst part of Khyber. They just don't care. Stayed for 3 nights and 4 days, there wasn't a single soul who reached out to check in if the stay was comfortable, no occasional "hellos". No greeting in the breakfast table. No hint of recognition as you pass by. As if you don't exist. Surprisingly it wasn't for all guests. Some groups did receive good dose of attention, so does it come with the room type. May be our experience would have been different if we stayed in the Presidential Suite ? How ridiculous!!

Being a Taj Inner Circle and La Cirque/Connoiseur Club member, and a Luxury Hotel expert, my understanding of a baseline expectation from a 5Star property is very realistic. Khyber, fails to meet that basic expectation - the warmth!!

Its not the property but the staff and their warmth who make those 5 Stars - anyone with a Taj experience would agree for sure. The staff in Khyber is as cold as the snow in the backdrop. Their cold and indifferent attitude stinks of arrogance at times.The supervisors exude that more than others. 
Check In experience was very messed up. The guy had no clue of the booking (made via Booking.Com) and made us wait for close to 2 hrs.

Best part - During check out, after 3N/4Ds, there was a customary question from the lady at the reception (Khaleda, if I recall correctly) - "How was the stay". I responded - "It was good, could have been lot lot better". That was the end of conversation, no further look/enquiry from the lady, no check in on what can be better, she just handed me the envelope with an arrogant indifference which screamed "Whatever..we don't care!!
And this was just one example.

The best and most warm acknowledgement we received was from the security at the gate - rest of the staff, and management should learn from him!!

One unsolicited advice to Khyber - You're in the hospitality business, its not your property but how you treat your guests will make them loyal and keep you in business. Don't take your guests for granted. 

Not recommended unless you have money to waste!

reviews.author: Bhavita C
reviews.title: Not worth of the money
reviews.text:
It is the best property in Gulmarg. But for the money it costs - one expects more. Below average service experience. 

Pros- The property itself is beautiful. Take the Himalayan facing rooms if u can. The swimming pool has awesome views n so does their coffee shop. Location is very close to the cable car starting point. Lots of place to play in the balconies if it snows. Our daughter was not well - they called a doctor promptly who even provided the medicine n we didn’t have to go hunting for it. Appreciate this a lot. 

Cons - Not worth the money if it doesn’t snow. Food is ok. Rooms r ok. Service is average bordering on below average. They didn’t even have snow shoes we could rent / buy to play in snow. When u pay this amount of money - you expect a wow factor in the service which was absent. They were clearly understaffed considering the crowd. 

There was only one staff member in the restaurant named Junaid who always had a smile on his face n would care of all my daughter’s demands. If he was not around - The rest of the staff was too busy to even care forget smile. 

Breakfast was included in our rate. Since we were checking out early we asked for two portions of bread n paratha to be parcelled. But they parcelled only one portion - for a total of 3 people! This when we have paid for a buffet breakfast! Unfortunately we came to know of the less portions only when we opened the packaging to have breakfast at the airport. 

We were staying here for our anniversary. My parents called to ask them to deliver a cake for us. The hotel had assured them they would. When we reached here we were asked when we wanted the cake. We told them. But the cake never came. Not a single person bothered to wish us. This when we told them we r staying for our anniversary and my parents had specially booked a cake. 

As I said if u pay a freaking 33k per night for a room - you expect more. This is not 5 star service experience. 

Overall not worth the money.

reviews.author: abdullahs682

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Sojanjs
reviews.title: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
reviews.text: the best one in town, near to the gondola & other activities area, Views from resort itself is breathtaking, you need to plan atleast 3 months in advance to get rooms here !! one thing never to be missed is the food served here !! top class

reviews.author: Amit Rajpal
reviews.title: Heaven on heart...incredible
reviews.text: Stayed there for 2 nights with my family (2 kids)......was an amazing experience....the staff was so courteous ,kind and prompt in their service...would especially like to mention about Mr. Manish executive chef.....met him in the restaurant and soon we were like good friends was really overwhelmed by his gesture to treat his guests......was given an upgrade and complementary meal during my stay....was like a once in a life time experience with such beautiful scenic views from every part of this resort......Thanks to all the staff .....khalida at front desk and Ofcoz Manish  for making my stay a wonderful and awesome one

reviews.author: sunitavinayak
reviews.title: Thanks to team khyber from Mr. Naresh kohli and Mr.Mukesh Vinayak
reviews.text: Our stay with khyber has been one of the best experience that we have had till date. Amazing property with an excellent hospitality from the hotel staff. Thanks to the hotel staff for giving us all the VIP treatment with so much love and ease. Special thanks to Mr. Manish Sharma and Vivek chhabra and also mr. Sanjeev gupta from the F.N.B dept for making our stay very memorable.

reviews.author: RajeshJain68
reviews.title: Very Sweet with bitter after taste
reviews.text:
This is simply a dream property. One has to experience it to believe especially in winter when it snows in Gulmarg. The rooms with a view, the heated pool, the spa, the gym and common areas are all out of a fairy tale !! 
I had the most amazing experience of a life time during my stay in January 2018. The facilities, food, infrastructure are absolutely top of the line
The only area in which it lacks is house keeping to some extent and the back office and accounts which is just very very poor and inefficient. So much so that inspite of the heavenly experience of staying at the hotel one ends up with a philosophical trip through hell on way to heaven.
There is urgent need to spruce up the back office and I think the inefficiency stems from complete lack of competition from other properties. In Gulmarg, either there is Khyber or there is Khyber. 
I wish one more m\hotel of their standard comes up in the area and Khyber would have resolved all its ills in a jiffy.

reviews.author: rs11234567
reviews.title: Huge, Heavenly Property in the Paradise
reviews.text: Everything was just fantastic. The management is awesome and the staff is very friendly and polite. The property is huge and beautiful. The location is just perfect and you dont want to leave the hotel. Whenever I visit Gulmarg again, I am sure Khyber will top the list of to-do's. Thank you Team Khyber for making our stay special

reviews.author: Anil M
reviews.title: Every Review about this Resort being the best is true!
reviews.text:
Khyber does not need any more reviews about it being the best mountain resort but still I am adding one more...

I have always seen that it is NOT the property, or it’s location but its facilities and staff that decides whether it’s worth a second visit or not. Khyber is worth many, many visits. Everyone here makes you feel that you are a VIP and takes that extra special care, which makes you feel that you were really welcome. 

Of course it is an excellent property with an excellent location and facilities. Motivated staff takes special care right from entering the Hotel till they are sure that we are comfortably settled. Rooms are well located with views of snow clad mountains. 

Though the Hotel does not have a Bar due to  religious reasons, but it freely allows the guests to carry their own alcohol to some designated areas in the Hotel. 

Food is excellent!! Special thanks to F&B manager Mr. Basharat and sous chef Veer who took extra pains to prepare dishes which were not on their menu. 

A very special thanks to Ms. Khalida & Mr. Manzoor has on the front desk who were always present 24x7 for everything, whether it was Transport, Sight seeing suggestions or shopping. 

Thanks for being such a wonderful host.
We will definitely come again.

reviews.author: Swapna31
reviews.title: Rejuvenating Himalayan Stay!
reviews.text:
About the Property:
The property is has very unique and modern wooden interior and exterior. This place is really cozy and comfy. The view from the property is really mesmerizing, surrounded by snow and trees. It’s a heaven, close to nature surrounded by mountains.
The rooms are really immense, clean and with royal interior and very well maintained. The hotel is provided with all the amenities that any 5 star property should have. Property location is really great and everything to explore is nearby.

Staff:

We will definitely visit the property again. And would love to recommend this for those who really wants the experience of peace and close to nature stay.

reviews.author: rounak t
reviews.title: Awesome and memorable stay at Khyber
reviews.text:

A special thanks to MR. Saqib and MR. Ishfaaq and the team at the coffee shop.  for the awesome hospitality they rendered to us. It was also amazing that one of the staff remembered that we had visited the Khyber 3 years ago for my aunts birthday. Its a highly recommended property to stay.

reviews.text:
Hi, 

We had a stay at the hotel from 28Jan to 30 Jan. The hotel has all the amenities like a good well maintained Gym, a heated swimming pool, steam , sauna and jacuzzi.My 4 yrs old son enjoyed the heated pool. The view from our room was beautiful, as it was snowing both the days.

reviews.author: Vidushi G

What an experience it was to stay at Khyber resort in Gulmarg?! From the check in to our stay to meals to their service, everything was perfect.
The whole resort was covered in snow n the beauty surrounding it was unparalleled. The views were to die for that to from the comfort of your hotel room.

reviews.author: T S
reviews.title: Just absolute Paradise!
reviews.text:
It was our first time to the Gulmarg and chose The Khyber Himalayan Resor after researching on TripAdvisor first. It totally surpassed all my expectations.Perfect to go in the month of January

We stayed on a 2 Luxury room balcony with Himalayan view of the Green Trees and the Mighty Himalayas was breathtaking. We had the Balconies to each of the Rooms, well heated inside, and with everything we would have wanted. Our Stay was for only 2 Nights!,Overall, It was so beautiful to see snowfall and after staying in this hotel makes our trip much more pleasant and amazing.

The location is amidst snow-covered mountains and pine trees, beautiful views all around, one couldn't do better with the location. The gondola/cable car ride is a 5 minute walk down the road,, but if you are older or not used to walking in the snow, then get a ride. The restaurant offers excellent food choices, although a bit expensive. 

Just loved every single minute on this beautiful Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Luv B
reviews.title: Heaven!
reviews.text: Absolutely heaven on earth. Especially, when it snows. This place is out of the world. The food is awesome here. The hotel is well heated. One could not feel that he is in a minus degree Celsius temperature. Best spa I have ever come across. Rooms are warm, spacious & airy. This is a real 5 Star property. I would definitely visit it again & again & again.

reviews.author: Swaransehgal
reviews.title: Annual Ski holiday
reviews.text: We come to Gulmarg every year and been staying in khyber for last 3 years. This was our 4th stay in Khyber. As always the staff is very warm and attentive. Particularly Shauqat in restaurant and housekeeping staff was excellent. The vibe in the hotel is very friendly and hospitable. We will always stay here. The indoor heated pool and jacuzzi is a sure plus and Kashmiri food is superb. Tip- carry your own booze they do not have a bar.

reviews.author: AddyKohli
reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful place and incredibly warm people
reviews.text: Just finished a 4 day holiday. Khyber was excellent, it's location, staff and the best of all it's an extremely kids friendly hotel. Has a lot for both adults and children. The heated pool after a day of skiing was a bliss!

reviews.author: yashrajesh2016
reviews.title: Kashmir
reviews.text: The hotel is superb in terms of location. Rooms are very nice and made as per the location using a lot of wood and old World design syncing it with modern day needs. If one has to stay in Gulmarg, I highly recommend to Stay in Khyber as it is an experience.Great property. really grand looking.Service was fantastic. Very prompt and courteous staff as specially Iqbal, showkat and Aijaz, they gave exceptional services in their restaurant.

reviews.author: MuffinEats
reviews.title: A luxury ski getaway in the Himalayas
reviews.text:
Hidden in the snow-capped mountains, the Khyber Hotel was located 2 hours away from the Srinagar airport. We were picked up by the hotel transport,  passed through towns with some initial tripedation due to the ubiquitous armed forces scattered every 1-2km. However, once turning into Gulmarg, we could feel the warmth of the locals and that they warmly welcome foreigners (most visitors are from India). 

The hotel was impeccably decorated and the room was large, spacious and very clean. We stayed at Room 1014 and woke up to a wonderful view every morning. The room came with a walk-in wardrobe which led to a huge bathroom - comprising of a huge sunken bathtub and a separate shower area. 

Breakfast spread was extensive with both Asian and Western choices - including a live dosa and egg station. We had dinner at the restaurant for 5 nights and were spoiled for choices even with the ala carte menu. Food was delicious and the chef certainly took pride and efforts with his presentation. The vegetarian egg-fried rice was fantastic complete with the wok-hei.

What impressed us most was the awesome service of the hotel staff - definitely to name - Hotel Manager Basharat, Suhil, Sameer and the wonderful staff at the restaurant and concierge team (I am unable to make all their names). They truly took pride in delivering wonderful service, and made our stay a memorable one. Basharat for one was very quick in contacting the in-house medic to procure altitude sickness medicine for my husband when he saw him unwell. 

The house-keeping team was so efficient in managing our laundry - we got back our laundry every morning before 9am (without requesting for express service). 

Power trips (lasting 2-3 mins) at the hotel did go off once or twice per day but generally it did not cause much inconvenience to us. Complimentary Wi-Fi was only limited to 2 devices, any additional device will cost Rs 750 for 24 hours. 

The L'occintain spa and heated swimming pool were exactly what it was depicted in the pictures on the website. Full body massages prices were from Rs 3,900 and above. 

One thing to note - The hotel does not sell or serve any alcohol. Guests can bring in their own wines or liquor.

We were here primarily to ski (for 5 days) and was pleasantly surprised to find a ski room/locker located just at the hotel's driveway. We parked our ski gear with the security team at the ski room every day - nothing went amiss. In fact the security team at the ski room helped to get me into my ski boots every morning! 

Transport from the hotel to the Gulmarg Gondola Station took only 3 mins and costs Rs 200 one way. There were many cars parked outside the hotel which you could negotiate with the drivers. 

We hired a local ski guide Manzoo (about Rs 2,500/day) as the ski trails were not clearly marked, so a ski guide was essential to acclimate skiers to the terrain. Manzoo was very experienced (he is also a snow boarder), who took us off-piste to experience the powder snow. He was friendly, helpful and took some great videos and pictures. He was also able to ascertain our skill levels and recommended the appropriate trails. Manzoo's contact  +91 70065 81644.

As the first phase of the gondola started from 10,000 ft, we took a day to acclimatize to the altitude before we hit the slopes, with just rest and lots of water.

It was a most luxurious and comfortable stay in Gulmarg and we won't think of staying anywhere else the next time we are here. We will definitely be back here at the Khyber the next ski season!

reviews.author: AnkkitV
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
Hello,

We stayed there for 3 nights and it was 36 of us! 

The hotel is superb in terms so location. Rooms are very nice and made as per the location using a lot of wood and old
World design syncing it with modern day needs. 

Food buffet is good and taste is nice as well.

They have one of the best spa's in india. The therapists work wonders!!

Have been there twice and looking forward to the third trip in 2018!

Cheers

reviews.author: Viswa_309
reviews.title: Milestone Wedding Anniversary !
reviews.text:
An experience only to be enjoyed. Luxury redefined and Wonderful memories. Very comfortable stay, Great View, and an awesome experience to stay in Khyber. If one has to Stay in Gulmarg, I highly recommend to Stay in Khyber as it is an experience.
Staff can do better, they can speak better English and communicate well. Food is good but not very great. Buffet spread was not very elaborate but sufficient. Staff were Friendly, courteous and very polite in behavior all the time. 

One request I had was that the Lovely looking Sign of Khyber (Stone) on the entrance outside was covered with dirty pile of Snow and we weren't able to take a neat picture. Although I requested the Staff and the F&B Manager to pass on the feedback to clear the Snow but it wasn't taken seriously. The Charm of the Hotel is its Signature Sign board while so many efforts were made to keep the Resort Clean inside  but leaving the Sign board outside with no care didn't give its Charm !!
Otherwise I recommend travelers to stay and enjoy in Khyber as its very unique to stay in Gulmarg and Celebrate it !

reviews.author: gvinita46
reviews.title: Beautifulyl layout,  wonderful experience
reviews.text:
we reached in the evening of 30 jan,my feet was almost frozen and could walk with great difficulty.Someone at the reception helped a lot in making me comfortable,even carried my shoes inspite of my asking not to do so,thank u so much.He made sure i was comfortable in my room.This is called hospitality in true sense. 
Rooms,bathrooms,decor,amenities,everything is perfect.Food was also good.In snow it is picture perfect.Heated swimming pool is well designed from where u can see snow.Jacuzzi,steam are also nice.Did not try the spa.

reviews.author: 165ankurp
reviews.title: Very Good but can be Great
reviews.text:
I visit Khyber from Feb 9 to 12 2017. It was covered in Snow and was the most beautiful place i ever saw. A beautiful resort of Luxury covered under Snow. The view outside the pool and the room was just awesome. Gulmarg is known for Skiing and February was the perfect time for it. We learnt a little bit and had good fun. The resort as such is the best resort in Gulmarg the only one with all luxuries. Its centrally heated which is a must and then it has its Heated Pool, Jacuzzi, Steam and what not and all this is part of the money you pay for the room. So yes you could be under3 meters of snow and still enjoy all the luxuries on earth. The hospitality was at its best - A special thanks to Mr. Asrar or Azrar who took great care of us . They have split beds in room which i think should be changed for couple rooms plus the noise from neighbouring room TV does come into your room so they should look into it. Since your in a 5 star you would expect everything to be perfect and thus the 1 star goes off here. The food is indeed simply awesome except for Pasta's. Try their Indian food and you will be Amazed specially the Dum Biryani's. 

Overall its a great place nestled under Snow - i wonder how did they manage this kind of luxury so high and under snow. My recommendation if you don;t want to ski then don;t stay beyond 2-3 days . You could surely use all facilities at the resort.

reviews.author: genghis_on_road
reviews.title: Great hotel, kids' facilities were disappointing
reviews.text:
Stayed for 4 days with my wife and 2 kids (3 and 7 years).

What we liked -
Great property. really grand looking.
Service was fantastic. Very prompt and courteous staff. I think the service was the highlight of our stay.
Rooms were fabulous.
Amenities like the heated pool, jacuzzi and the sauna were well maintained and were great fun for the kids. the gym looked nice though we did not use it.
The food buffet had a lot of variety.

What we did not like -
Considering that most guests were families with children, there was surprisingly little to keep kids engaged. 
The kids play area was icy cold and dark and gloomy. There were no attendants so you could not leave the kids. Very few games. Basically you would not want to spend time there at all.
There was no kids menu - ala carte or buffet. It would have been good to have at least a couple of items on the menu or in the buffet that were specifically for kids.
Other than this, they had a peculiar rule of not allowing the locals into the hotel. So my guide and I had to stand outside in sub zero temperatures to plan our next day or any such conversation. Apart from the cold, it was just very distasteful.
And, the food is expensive. I must also add food is expensive everywhere in Gulmarg for obvious reasons. We had breakfast and dinner included in our plan. But when we did spend, meals were about 5000 for the family. Even if you ask for plain boiled pasta for the kid, it was charged at Rs. 900. At the Taj, they would give it to us for free, considering we were spending 4k on the rest of the meal anyway.

Overall, I think its a great hotel with a wonderful staff. I hope they focus on the little guests a bit more.

reviews.author: pkjain2017
reviews.title: My stay at THE KHYBER HIMALAYAN RESORT AND SPA
reviews.text: I have been to lot of resorts and hotels in the country as well as abroad but something that stuck me most in the place was the excellent homely and courteous behaviour of all the staff ...one and all of them. Also the service was excellent ,Rooms were excellent well kept and the resort as whole is just Awesome.

reviews.author: Deziree-Reddy
reviews.title: Best Holiday Ever
reviews.text: This place is simply wow. The staff was superb they made our holiday even more worthwhile especially Showkat and Aasif. managers are always out and about and very attentive to the their guests. We were so comfortable at this resort that we cancelled our trip to Palagham and extend our stay at The Khyber. In February the snowfall is spectacular. We woke up to beautiful snowfall  and it was picture perfect. Amazing stay amazing staff, amazing hospitality. The food was excellent at Cloves Restaurant. It was a culinary delight. Whenever we called to reception they sent someone immediately to our rooms to have our query resolved. definitely a WOW factor. Well done Khyber. Will recommend your resort to my clinets

reviews.author: ariajainxx
reviews.title: INSUFFICIENT SERVICE
reviews.text:
The hotel is marvelous and grand, the rooms too are very comfortable. We however went at a time when the whole hotel was empty. We had paid for all the services but since the place was empty most things were difunctional. The television wasn't working.
