Everyday they made the guests walk down the slippery snow slope for 5 minutes in the snow because they had no ATVs. 
 The cafe didn't have most of the things on the menu. Service at the Khyber is poor, but if you go there expecting less, that shouldn't affect the comfort level.

reviews.author: Sameer Bansal
reviews.title: Don't die to see the heaven, go to Gulmarg and stay in Khyber.
reviews.text:
I was in Khyber for my anniversary for 2 days, it was a excellent stay, their hospitality, location, service, food, management and everything you can expect is above the level. Superb experience, I was attended by Mr. Asrar at the reception till both days for assistance, he attended so well for each and everything, and second day senior manager Mr Manzoor upgraded my room, I would like to Thanx both of them and the whole team of Khyber for the excellent service and hospitality, would recommend strongly for khyber for stay in gulmarg .
Thanx

reviews.author: Kartikeya V
reviews.title: Most beautiful resort in the Country!
reviews.text: This is by far the most beautiful 5 star resort in the Country and considering its mesmerising location I would rate it even higher than Wildflower hall Shimla. The service is excellent and specially Bilal at the reception was at his professional best to assist us. We'll certainly visit the property again.

reviews.author: NoinahJaeb
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Mesmerizing views from the room, from the pool and from the breakfast area. Topping it up with great service & high security, what more can one ask for in Gulmarg?

The hotel was just a short (but a steep slope) walk away from the Gondola station; making that an easy access.

There were flights of stairs at different parts of the hotel (at main entrance, to the room, to the pool & to the kids play room) so not sure if there any lift access (did not notice).

reviews.author: Nidhi S
reviews.title: Beauty at its best
reviews.text: This place is excellent to visit beautiful view ,best service ,amazingly made, best facilities worth the money and amazing people .This hotel has the best location in gulmarg ..the hotel staff is very caring amd sweet ..there is no such fear in going to kashmir at all ..it is no less than heaven ..truly....and if you go there than a stay at khyber is a must it has an indoor swimming pool covered with glass so even in winters swimming is possible and amazing spa and games and best food .

reviews.author: NanduNikul
reviews.title: Hotel in gulmarg
reviews.text: The best feeling of my time.. mesmerzing view best room himalayan view... super service by asrar for check inn... eijaz in resturant clove...also other staff... very helpful...must be here in winters... good food... good spa...super pool with view...amazing hotel..

reviews.author: Idreesbeigh
reviews.title: Perfect hotel at gulmarg
reviews.text: Very nic ..luxury hotel with all facilities..at gulmarg...only go to khyber.if u want to plan gulmarg. Fine cottage and food . One of the best hotel at gulmarh area... sevice is very nic. Rooms are also great...facilities....nic swimming pool. Snooker club... jym...spa..

reviews.author: rajiv7679
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort at Nice Location
reviews.text:
It was my first visit to Gulmarg and I would say that words are less to write about Gulmarg. We stayed at the Khyber. The place is built at great location, it is at walking distance from gondola. The resort is built with heritage theme taking into consideration the culture of Kashmir. 
The rooms and facilities are fine. There are not many options for food in the resort. As the resort is comparatively new, it needs proper maintenance and up gradation time to time. There is a difference between very good and great and Khyber needs to cover that distance through its hospitality & warmth. Overall it was nice experience as I feel the USP of Khyber is its location, it's snow all around. Do visit it to feel and experience Enchanting Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Moiz A
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: The hotel was great, the staff were exceptional. starting from the security to the housekeeping, the waiters, the reception ( Mr Bilal and Mr Ishfaq i still remember by name ) they were all extremely hospitable and friendly. Ive not been to a hotel ever with such a nice staff. the room was great, the bathroom and bathtub were excellent. the view was superb. If you are going to kashmir i would absolutely recommend staying at the Khyber hotel, u wont regret it ! their hotel representative at the airport and the driver all were just too friendly! and Gulmarg itself is just heaven !

reviews.author: sidsaraf
reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the khyber between 17th to 20th feb 2016,
we were a group of 22 people and i have to admit the property and the staff was simply excellent. 
Great hotel and location, excellent spa, superb gym and indoor pool.
A note to the management that i asked for my mattress to be flipped or changed room 4007 as it was too too soft to get any sleep on specially post a day of intense skiing, this was a huge disappointment
the hotel ski gear deposit room next to the main porch is simply a great idea very convenient and well thought of,
we would usually spend our early evenings post skiing at their coffee shop overlooking the grounds, the scones and coffee was great   
But apart from that this was a really great hotel, a special thanks to ASIF who was specially sent to sri nagar airport on behalf of the management for our group to check in at the airport,
But due to a snow slide most of us  missed our flight, 
I managed to reach the airport and without his help it would have been impossible to catch the flight, he was extra helpful polite and very responsible, kudos to the management and the team to extend and offer services beyond their resort

reviews.author: MsPragati
reviews.title: spectacular
reviews.text: We spent the last week of december at this gorgeous resort nestled in the beautiful breathtaking gulmarg valley. Right from the onset, when we landed in Srinagar, the hospitality by Khyber staff was just immaculate. They assisted us with the luggage and we were in the hotel cab immediately. Highly recommend booking a cab through the hotel , there are innumerable checkposts on the way to the hotel and the hotel chauffeurs handle them promptly. The stay at the hotel was superbly relaxing and enjoyable. The welcome drink- the traditional Kahwa is droolworthy. Their spa , indoor pool and the evr helpful staff - made our stay totally memorable.

reviews.author: JADE-NY0079
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel but NO BAR OR ALCOHOL!
reviews.text: The hotel setting is really idyllic and the rooms are very nice and spa excellent. The staff were friendly but seem more geared for domestic than international guests though and generally had only very rudimentary english language skills - with all due respect, as I have no Hindi or Urdu!  Notably, the hotel has NO BAR and NO ALCOHOL on the premises. It isn't a particularly festive or lively place, although the premises are lovely.  This came as a bit of shock.  The food was acceptable, especially given the very remote location. Wifi was reasonably reliable but not very fast - but that's not necessarily a bad thing in a place so remote and beautiful.  Very comfortable bed and room was warm when it was sub-zero outside!

reviews.author: Ashir
reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: We visited Khyber recently. We were there for one night. Superb hotel, nice interiors and surrounded by snow. Can't get better than this. But once we checked in the difference between taj n Khyber started. No warm welcome. The room 6003 were we stayed didn't have hot water it had only warm water. With -7 degrees outside and paying almost 24 k per night without food u at least expect hot water 24 hrs. After complaining thrice nothing happened. Even in breakfast while I was still having food they rudely closed all the counters even without informing. Inshort they have that attitude that in gulmarg it's their monopoly. Whether u are satisfied or not u have to stay there. Beautiful hotel no doubt about it.

reviews.author: PriyaSuri
reviews.title: Brilliant Hotel
reviews.text: From the minute we entered the hotel, everything was seamless. The check-in process was quick and they had upgraded us to Luxury Balcony room. That was a big room. They view from the room & bathroom was stunning. The indoor pool was very nice. Didn't have the time to check out spa. Food was average and a bit over-priced. It's very well located next to the ski entrance. I felt a 2 night stay was short and would definitely like to go back again.

reviews.author: sjaveri
reviews.title: Terrible service ruins a potentially magical stay in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
Pros :

Stunning views, fantastic location near the Gulmarg gondola.
Exceptional health club and heated swimming pool
Very spacious and well decorated rooms with great central heating
Large breakfast and dinner buffet spread

Cons : 
Abysmal service, the worst i have experienced in a luxury hotel
Poorly maintained games room, no staff nearby to help and equipment missing or broken
No free WiFi
No taxi service unless you want to visit the airport only

This place could easily have been one of the best places to stay at all over India, there is an incredible amount of potential. However, the facilities (aside from the health club) are not well maintained at all. The snooker table has places where the cloth has torn, the table tennis table didn't have a ball that we could use. Their is a foosball table as well with a ball missing, and the air hockey table didn't have running electricity. They have some console games as well but those didn't work either. Upon calling someone to help us, we waited nearly 20 minutes and finally left. The staff was not particularly warm in general, we stayed in other places in Kashmir at half the cost and the staff was much nicer. The worst was when we wanted a taxi to take us down the mountain from Gulmarg to Tanmarg. The hotel informed us the only taxi available is to the airport and we cannot go anywhere else due to union issues. We had a flight to catch at Srinagar and we already had a car waiting to take us there, all we had to do was take a car from the hotel and descend down the mountain. After refusing to give us a taxi, we requested them to offer us a taxi to the gondola atleast where we could perhaps find another tourist taxi willing to take us down. Even that option was not entertained by their staff. Despite the poor weather conditions (-8 and snowing heavily), they probably expected us to walk on our own with our luggage down their hotel slope for 10-15 minutes and hope to get a taxi ourselves. Either that or pay 4000 for a taxi to the airport. When you stay at a luxury hotel, you don't expect to ever have to worry about these things, yet when something as basic as transportation cannot be provided, it's a real shame. Will not come here again.

reviews.author: Ami
reviews.title: lovely staff and hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here on a birthday were given a discount due to this and brought a surprise birthday cake. A really nice room and view, restaurant and extremely hospitable staff! Thankyou very much we had a great stay.

reviews.author: Chris Q
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is great. It's beautiful and the staff are great. We stayed here to ski and the hotel was spot on. The spa with all its facilities was a lifesaver after a hard days skiing. The food in the restaurant is great and has a good selection of both kashmiri and western food, although for the area it is a bit expensive. There is no bar at the hotel but guests brought their own alcohol and drank in the communal areas. All in all a great hotel with great staff. They also arrange transfers from Srinigar airport in nice cars.

reviews.author: BombayNomad
reviews.title: Lot of potential. Major improvements needed.
reviews.text:
When you enter the hotel, you are in awe of the architecture, design and the views. Unparalleled, I should say. Rooms are brilliant. Swimming pool and spa area are astounding. 

But the hotel lacks Kashmiri hospitality and warmth. Food is average and overpriced. Breakfast, though, is really nice. In some ways, it lacks soul. Too 5 star-ish for my liking. 

Stayed there for 3 nights during honeymoon. Glad we chose it. With the corrections suggested, this could be among the best hotels in India.

reviews.author: Highlandtrekker
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Stayed in the hotel for two days . It has an excellent location . It's a beautiful property and have lovely interiors . The whole of Gulmarg was covered with snow at that time. The food is ok , bfast is a good spread but the restaurant is expensive . They have a good spa . The reception teams needs to be pushed a bit . They are slow to respond and don't have ready answers .

reviews.author: Ankurzv
reviews.title: stunning property at exceptional location & average service
reviews.text:
its good but definitely not the best 

Pros  :-

Stunning property at exceptionally beautiful location 

Cons :-
3 star service, warmth & soul missing 
avg food ,rooms are not sound proof can hear adjacent room's TV In night.

reviews.author: Gautam_Meetu
reviews.title: A 5 Star property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: It's a wonderful 5 star hotel at 9000 Ft above sea level, with lounges, a huge dining hall, coffee lounges, all wth huge windows and facing the hills / forests. It has a fanstatic Spa and a heated swimming pool looking out in the lawns, which were covered with snow when we visited. Typical chain hotel, with all modern amenities and conforts. The only draw back, was that it does not have views of the Gulmarg Valley. But overall great experience of playing in the snow in the lawns and coming back to the comforts of a star hotel.

reviews.author: doshiketan
reviews.title: "FIVE STAR HOTEL WITHOUT HOSPITALITY"
reviews.text:
Stayed at khyber from 5 to 9 feb with my son. My bad experience started even before i checked in. After booking long back, i tried to contact them by telephone atleast 30-40 times for requesting twin bed room but either no one picks up phone or line is busy or told to wait n then line gets disconnected . Finally i wrote mail request n then instead of checking content of mail, i was sent quote for room rate so again i sent mail informing that i already have booking n i need twin bed room. Then i got very rude reply .
At the time of check in i told mr Bilal that i had sent mail for twin bed room n he said he doesn't have any information about my request but kindly agreed for providing extra bed but it was very uncomfortable n I couldn't sleep for first two nights .
Check in was done at counter itself instead of lounge n no welcome drink was provided to us for reasons unknown to us. 
After reaching room waited a long for my bags to arrive but after many calls also it didn't arrived n finally i told them that i m coming to reception personally n then it came after more than an hour .
Same day went to spa n was given locker key which was already occupied by someone else n had to change the keys. 
Next day morning while at breakfast table no one was ready to attend for tea/coffee n finally caught hold of one of the server n got tea.
Next day room was cleaned but tea cups were not changed n replenishment was not done. Called housekeeping many times but it didn't came.as a last resort went to reception n talked to Mr.Manzoor informing about all above mentioned problem n still after reaching room nothing happened inspite of promise made by mr Manzoor, finally shouted at housekeeping n then cups n tea replenishment came .  
Next day evening when returned to room, electronic key was not working so opened room with the help of housekeeping staff n then requested him to replace key but it didn't came for hour. Called reception still it didn't came n then again went to reception n fortunately met Mr.Sujith Herbert GM of property n explained him all above facts. Things turn around after talking to Mr Sujith . He is the man n Mr.Shyam from restaurant because of whom i rated khyber 3 stars otherwise i would have given them 1 star rating only. As a very kind gesture mr Sujith offered us complimentary dinner n also took very special care even at the time of check out by sending bell boy immediately n confirming if all luggage came or not?
Same day morning at breakfast table after ordering tea/coffee three times to different servers it didn't came n finally when it came only coffee was served n again v had to talked to manager on duty n then it came properly.
Apart from above issues, cleanliness of general area needs lot of improvement.
As far as rooms are concerned, its well done with very good view. Also their spa/swimming pool was best amongst all hotels i have visited world over. 
Overall its very good property but needs more people like Mr Sujith /shyam to run it better to meet expectations of any five star grade hotel.

reviews.author: akhilbhansali
reviews.title: Amazing location, good service average food
reviews.text: This resort is an amazing place for family outing. Right in the heart of Gulmarg. Very good view. The food however seems to be very average and expensive. The indoor pool seems to be an unique feature which is hard to find in a place with -4 C temp. Hot water is available round the clock, you will know the importance of this when you compare this feature to the other hotels in Kashmir. I enjoyed my stay there. Better food could have made the trip five star.

reviews.author: PuneetDave
reviews.title: Khyber...U r just awesome...
reviews.text:
Couple of days back i stayed in Khyber for three nights. I and my wife enjoyed the gulmarg truly. Luxury carved in Pine woods. Location and picturesque sight is like the nectar for eyes. Room quiet spacious and comfortable. Swimming pool ans spa quite soothing for body.
Food is bit expensive but worth to have. During stay i faced a problem of frequent power cut. Rest as per of what i expect when i reserve it.

reviews.author: Bhappy0143
reviews.title: Luxurious resort, warm staff, beautiful location
reviews.text:
Our decision to stay at Khyber resort in Gulmarg for our 6th anniversary was best over nearby hotels (Highland park, Vintage etc). We finalised Khyber as we were visiting Gulmarg in winters during 2-5 degrees temp with our 3 months baby. The resort is centrally heated, offers all required amenities and has Luxury room with Himalayan mountain view which my husband couldn't let go. The staff is very warm and is readily available to serve you at all time. Food is way beyond expectation. Dinner buffet and breakfast buffet had many varieties and I couldn't stop myself from trying it all.
The indoor heated pool is super awesome. The himalayan view while swimming is mindblowing.
We took a taxi from airport to Khyber and it cost us Rs. 2000 one side. The driver Umar Amin (09419593474) is nice and very helpful guy.
Unexpected Gulmarg has warm people around, smiling, helpful. I think its a major point that added to the overall satisfying experience of staying at Khyber.
Keep it up!

reviews.author: ajay_satija7
reviews.title: Good hotel but need better staff trainning
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel khyber gulmarg. It a a new resort and good during winters. The attitude of the staff however is not nice. We were not allotted room for good one hour in spite of having a confirmed reservation and there was no apology. The rooms got too hot & in spite of several complaints the fault was not rectified. The room service is very slow and they took almost 1 hour for a sandwich to arrive. Better staff training required if they want to improve services.

reviews.author: Lalli5618
reviews.title: Marvelous
reviews.text:
My friend and I enjoyed a wonderful time there 2/2-3/2.Unfortunetly we were time constrained..hope to return for a longer stay.
Great location ,very scenic with easy access to popular activities.
The hotel provides excellent services and efficiently with a smile.
Food was plentiful with Indian/western cuisines.
A wonderful place to relax and be pampered.
It's pricy but worth every penny cos absolute luxury comes at a cost.

reviews.author: Brijacob16
reviews.title: Worth the wait
reviews.text:
The wife and I have been planning a holiday here for a while. Their unavailability speaks of their popularity. Finally we managed to make it for our anniversary and boy were we glad we did.
The ambience, location, rooms, staff is all 5 star. It's warm (thanks to the central heating) friendly and homely. The spa is a must visit and so too is the heated pool.
Hat tip to Sujit, the GM who you will find all smiles, warm and welcoming at the lobby taking care and listening to everyone on everything.

However the only thing that needs drastic improvement is the food. The restaurant and the food is just passable. Breakfast is strictly nice but that's about it. 
Would recommend heading to (by car) Highlands Park for a meal and you will know what I mean.
Hence only a 4 Star rating :)

reviews.author: VishvVijaeS
reviews.title: The balcony was so beautiful!!
reviews.text: I visited this beautiful property in Nov 2015.  This resorts is beautiful and close to the Gandola lift. Our room had a beautiful balcony facing the khillan marg mountains  covered with  fresh snow, we spent our whole day sitting there watching that beautiful nature and breathing the fresh air. Interiors of property are very nicely done. the indoor heated pool was a charm. The only problem i faced was making a reservation with them as no one picks there reservation line tel. no's.  But that was all compensated with their service and hospitality. would love to visit here again.

reviews.author: Ashok C
reviews.title: Unbelievably luxurious and amazing location
reviews.text:
My advice to anyone visiting Kashmir is to stay in this hotel to have a splendid views and strategic location to the cable car. Though the view may be not as good as highland park, it still is the best serviced hotel in whole Kasmir valley. We just were able to have one lunch due to paucity of time, we had amazing food and great view. The staff is service oriented and well cultured true to kasmiriat.
Must visit property.

reviews.author: Idris E
reviews.title: Not upto the expectation.
reviews.text:
I have nothing new to add as my experience was more or less same on the line of other reviews rating the experience terrible,poor or average. Just one heads up to all going for premier rooms. 
1. Avoid Odd no rooms.(View sucks, I had a nice car parking view. needless to say curtain remained shut all the time)
2 Avoid corner rooms near the staircase. you will be unwilling party to every conversation other guests walking past by are having(rooms are not sound proof)
3. Don't go for the non refundable payment option. keep your options open if you don't like the allotted room.

Positives.

1.Excellent room service.
2. Excellent Dining area with beautiful view.
3. Beautiful Beautiful Beautiful property.

I just wish that front office staff was less condescending, subtly rude. 
I did feel that had I gone for more expensive room, I would have been treated better.
but it is not that horrible either. Just stand up for yourself & don't get intimidated. 

Tips for other traverllers.

1. In house restaurant is expensive so go for  plan inclusive of breakfast & Dinner.
2. Don't go for non refundable payment option, you end up saving some money but you are left with no option if you do not like the allotted room.
3. If you have booked premier room, go for even numbered rooms. they have better view.
4. Incoming calls  in your rooms fixed line are allowed don't trust the front office guy who introduces & welcomes you to the property. and tells you otherwise.

reviews.author: ploytenkate
reviews.title: Hotel with a view
reviews.text:
Khyber arguably offers the best view of the Himalayas among hotels in Gulmarg. The property is centrally located with a few steps away from a Gondola ride, shops and ski slopes. 

We just came back from a three-night stay in February which is also one of the busiest months for Gulmarg. Indians and foreigners staying here mostly come to ski or snowboard. 

You can book a hotel car pickup from the Srinagar airport for 4,000 Rupees and it would take you 1.5 hours to get to the hotel. Local cars, however, are cheaper.

Upsides:

1.) Loccitane Spa is a must. Lives up to its name. Would recommend its Signature Lemon Balm massage. Treat yourself for 90 minutes after a long-day of skiing or walking up and down the hills.

2.) Heated swimming pool, fitness and wellness facility: The mountain view from the pool is stunning. The fitness is well-equipped w/ treadmills and weights. The locker room has well-maintained sauna, steam rooms and jacuzzis. The staff is polite.

3.) Rooms offer great views and spacious.

4.) Most of the staff (the spa, the fitness and an IT lady) are responsive and polite.

Downsides:

1.) The Internet here is chargeable at 750
Rupee/day with relatively slow speed and frequent disruptions.

2.) No shuttles or golf carts available from the hotel going up and down to the main road. This makes it inconvenient for the guest, especially the elders or tiring skiers. Be prepared to walk up and down yourself.

3.) Empty minibar. Or the staff failed to stock it up otherwise.

4.) Unreliable power system. Frequent blackout.

5.) We enjoyed local Indian food but international menu isn't quite up to par. The breakfast spread was ok but served Nescafé (not freshly brewed coffee until we asked for new ones). Room service needs improvement with slow pre- and post- services. Certain food on the menu can't be ordered until after 7.30 pm. 

6.) Amenities aren't quite 5-star standards. No shaving cream. No qtips.

7.) No information from staff about the gondola or ski shops. They basically refer you to touts outside the hotel.

reviews.author: Vivek G
reviews.title: Truly, the best property in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
If you are traveling to Gulmarg and you want to stay in the best resort there, think no further. Our group of 12 (incl 6 kids) stayed at Khyber for two nights early January. The resort is right in the middle of Himalayas and in a picture perfect location. You can take those Kodak picture moments from any point in the resort. The interiors and exteriors are just splendid. The resort has a nice restaurant (clove), a coffee shop, a cigar lounge and a spa.

We picked the regular deluxe room with extra bed in each room. Kids above 5 will be charged extra. Our package included breakfast and internet. The resort is less than 500 meters from the Gondola and a 10min walking distance from the Skiing area (beginners). 

The hotel premises were spotless and professionally managed. Breakfast and Dinner buffets at Clove were pretty good. The main course of the dinner buffet needs to be updated. I enjoyed the continental appetizers and hors d'oeuvres. Very little choices for non-vegetarian items in the main course. The hotel does not have a liquor license and it was disappointing.

The cigar lounge is an interesting set up. You can smoke Cigars and Hookah but not cigarettes. You can bring your own liquor and the hotel will serve the rest of the stuff (snacks, sodas etc.) We enjoyed our time there. 

Some tips for fellow travelers:
- It costs Rs. 300 to go from the hotel to the ski area or the Gondola (one way). And Hotel will not be able to arrange this for you. We were told that the cab services in Gulmarg are controlled by a small group. We struggled quite a bit to get a car when needed. There are couple of guys hanging out in the arrival area. They will not only try to get you a car but also try to sell you a general guide, tickets to gondola, tickets to ski slope, guide to ski slope etc.
- And if you do not go with those additional services, you will not get your cab when you need it. This is border line blackmail. I hated this so much that we walked the 10min when we could. It is much harder to walk back to the Resort because of the steep incline of the road.
- Best option is to make a deal with the car that drove you to the hotel from Tangmarg.
- You will also be pressured by many people to hire a guide. We had at least 20 people that approached us during the 10 min walk from resort to Gondola. They asked anywhere from Rs.600 - Rs.2000. They will tell you many stories and try to scare you as well. We did not take a guide.I suggest that you pick one (can negotiate for Rs. 300) for two reasons. One is that you will not be approached by anyone else. The second reason is that the guide can discretely talk to the security guys in phase 1 of Gondola and extend the time you can spend there by a few house.
- Buying tickets for the Gondola is quite easy. Once you are in the phase 1 area, you are required to return in one hour. 
- The published rates for snow mobile rides in Gondola are also exaggerated. We negotiated ride to PK1 for Rs.1000/person (published rate was Rs. 2000)
- If you are looking for a guide + ski equipment, you will have to negotiate quite a bit as well. We were quoted anywhere from 2000 to 4000/ person for this. We did not make a decision until we reached the ski area. There we were able to negotiate a guide + ski equipment + lessons + skiing for 3 hours for Rs. 1000/person. That also included a cab ride back to the resort.

reviews.author: Anuradha257
reviews.title: Heavenly abode in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The wood finished hotel is in stark contrast to the cold of January in Gulmarg. The warmth of the decor is welcoming on stepping inside after the chilly wind. The attention paid to  view of the snow clad environs from the lobby, dining area and swimming pool is praiseworthy. The pool is one of its kind with glass walls on three sides showing only snow-clad Gulmarg as far as one can see. The artefacts and photos all round the hotel were beautiful.
I had a Deluxe room which could have had a better view from its glass wall if facing the opposite side but they were full when requested.
The services are very good. Pool comes with jacuzzi, steam & sauna. The L'Occitane spa is one of the few in India with very good ambience. We tried the Relaxing and Deep tissue massage, both very good. Staff is courteous and helpful.
Breakfast was good. Dinner could have been much better for such a nice hotel.

reviews.author: DDalal
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel, including Service.
reviews.text:
A fabulous hotel with fabulous service and location. Specially during Winter.
I will go there every year . Only problem is going to skiing points from the hotel. Only mode is taxi and difficult to get and a bit expensive as they charge 500 rs for one km. drive.

reviews.author: Niravmansi
reviews.title: Simply amazing
reviews.text: Had a great time with himaliyan views and snow all around u.service is best. Gone to celebrate my hubby bday and Mr.aman from fnb department made sure to make everything special with bonfire out in snow and roof top candle light dinning...amazing experience.looking forward to visit again

reviews.author: Manishsinghdangi
reviews.title: Mindblowing
reviews.text: Beatiful location. Best place to come back to after skiing all say. Rejuvenate in the swimming pool. Have a relaxed meal and sleep comfortably and then repeat the skiing next day.The transfers to and from the airport is well taken off. Would surely put Gulmarg in the list of best places to ski in the world.

reviews.author: Saurav H
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL GULMARG EXCELLENT KHYBER
reviews.text: Great place in paradise. I have only one word for this resort "FANTASTIC", with one of the best views I have ever seen in my life. Good food, Nice ambience, caring and helping staff, and all of the above unmatched location.. Highly recommended to stay at KHYBER.

reviews.author: Dhruv80
reviews.title: Beautiful location. Excellent hospitality. Great food. Highly recommend!
reviews.text: I have only one word for this resort "Fantastic" with one of the best views I have ever seen in my life. Sujeet the GM of this resort is a great guy who is always interacting with the guests of the hotel. Sajid at the Cloves rest is a friendly guy who makes sure that you receive the utmost service. Would highly recommend to friends and guests!

reviews.author: SanjayP310
reviews.title: THE KHYBER
reviews.text: Stayed for 6 days 13 to 19th of February 2015. Had gone for Skiing. Fantastic Hotel. No other place to stay in Gulmarg. Great ambience, supreme staff, very good food. Adivse one and all to stay there. Do not waste energy looking for places in Gulmarg. Definitely will visit again.

reviews.author: k_vishwanathan
reviews.title: Amazing place in paradise
reviews.text:
Stayed at the hotel in Feb right in the midst of a snowfall. It is truly paradise. The hotel service was impeccable, staff most friendly, amazing amenities. Will go there every year.

Please do take the number of Farooq (9797248209). Amazingly knowledgeable, very helpful guide and ski instructor.

reviews.author: sumita2052
reviews.title: Simply perfect !
reviews.text:
I spent time at the Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa , Gulmarg in August 2013 with my parents, and as my experience was so perfect it has been on my mind since then to write a review for it ! 

I am a native Kashmiri who has spent time in hotels in Gulmarg and other tourist places in Kashmir and in different parts of the world as well. And I was very proud and happy to note that this hotel in Kashmir was so superlative and welcoming that it could easily be compared to other top hotels across India and some in Europe/ US as well. 

The location of the hotel itself is simply stunning ! Even as someone who has grown up in those environs and used to seeing lofty mountains on a daily basis - exploring the area around Khyber and the views from its balcony filled my senses with peace and joy. 

We were in a gorgeous family room with a lovely balcony and a spacious bathroom with sunken bath and plush toiletries. We had the view of the snow capped mountains and some 'gujjar' huts - and probably spent good few hours at the balcony just looking out and admiring the beauty of the place. 

The food was exceptional and nothing was too difficult for the waiting-on staff to organise for me and my parents. Kashmiri food is world famous anyway and the Chef did full justice to that expectation. Food from other parts of India/world were also there in the evening buffet. The desserts especially were exceptional ! And even my father who is a very fussy eater kept going back for more :-) Breakfast too was quite delicious and we had it custom made . 

There is tons to do around the hotel - long walks/ horse riding / gondola ride / wildlife watching/ skiing (depending on the season) etc and you will not be bored for days. 

We were very well taken care of by Junaid Iqbal and other staff members of the hotel - and I cannot praise them enough, esp Junaid who went out of his way to make sure that out trip went without any hitch. 

I cannot wait to go back to Kashmir and staying at Khyber again ! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: JoshSZ
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Didn't know what to expect coming to Gulmarg.  Our Heli-Skiing operation gave us the option to stay at a few different places around Gulmarg and we chose Khyber because one of our group wasnt snowboarding... very happy that we made that choice.  Hotel staff is very friendly and willing to help but sometimes it was difficult to understand what they were saying (nit-picking but thats why 4 stars, not 5).  However, they were always eager to help.  The facility is very nice and comfortable... rooms, restaurant (food pretty good and lots of options) spa.  Would definitely come back to stay at The Khyber if/when I come back to Gulmarg.  Also, its just next to the gondola so getting up and down from the mountain so if youre planning to ski/snowboard, its a great location

reviews.author: Shilpa N
reviews.title: Great property but at an exorbitant price & very unprofessional front desk staff
reviews.text:
Our bad experience with the Khyber service started even before we reached. Booked this place through booking.com but got a message closer to our stay saying that there was some issue with the card details. I contacted one Mr Mashood from the hotel and he suggested I either use another card or do a bank transfer. I confirmed on email that I shall execute the transfer from my bank acc and promptly did the bank transfer the same day. In a few days I get a message from booking.com saying the transaction has failed and my booking stands cancelled. On contacting Mr Mashood again, he arrogantly replied that I did not email the transaction details post the transaction, hence the booking stands cancelled. If the transaction details were required, couldn't Mr Mashood do a quick call back post my confirmation email and ask for the same? Anyway, here's what he had to say: "you are lucky there is a room still available. Send me the details soon now." I did that and got an email from him giving the date of transaction, amount & my bank acc details. Soon got a confirmation voucher from him.

We arrived at Khyber on a snowy February day. 

And then the wait to check in began: almost half an hour and then the front desk staff tells me I will need to swipe my card before check in as they can't trace my payment. I was livid since I'd already done the transfer in full. When I showed the confirmation voucher, they claimed it's not enough and they need the transaction id.  I had already given my bank acc details and date of transfer, so couldn't understand why it was rocket science for them to check their with accounts instead of making me wait so long and insisting that I log into my bank acc and give them the transaction id right then. This was after a 3 hour long journey and I had a toddler in tow.
None the less, I offered to check into my acc and give them the details if I had access to the internet, but there was no 3G connectivity on my phone/laptop in this remote location. They promptly suggested that I BUY a premium wifi package!! I was astonished at the audacity!! Finally, managed to get hold of their desktop and fish out the details. On speaking to the manager about my experience, I did get a customary apology which neither meant much nor changed my opinion about the service.

As a parallel, when I compare this experience to the experiences we had at other luxury hotels like the Taj, Khyber doesn't stand a chance. No special surprises or personal touches by any staff member. Khyber comes across as mercenary and cold.

However, while the service was disappointing, here are the pluses
-The place was opulent and we immediately fell in love with the property. Warm wooden interiors, rich furnishings and full length glass walls offering magnificent views of the snowy landscape outside.
- The food at the restaurant is quite nice
- The L'Occitane spa is out of the world. The staff at the spa is very professional & well trained

This place costs over 17k INR(close to 300 USD) per night with no inclusions other than breakfast. Even the wifi comes at a price tag(very, very regressive). One expects great service when it is THE most expensive hotel one has ever stayed at. Not meant for travelers who spend hard earned money and expect a once in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: sanketutility
reviews.title: Khyber - Lives up to its reputation and more!!
reviews.text: When we booked Khyber, with a toddler in tow, we were really not sure what to expect. We had heard about its excellent hospitality and location, and within a couple of hours of reaching there, our apprehensions were all gone and we settled down into the sheer opulent luxury and outstanding hospitality of its staff. Everyone was courteous to a fault and they made sure that we did not have the slightest of problems during our stay, even if it meant delivering a glass of warm milk within 5 minutes at 4 am for our son. The Gandola is within walking distance of the hotel and the views are breathtaking. The food is excellent and the breakfast is a treat. Can't wait to go back for my next ski vacation to Khyber!!

reviews.author: Sanasawhney19
reviews.title: Hospitality at it's finest
reviews.text:
Stayed at The Khyber for 3 nights and I must say this hotel is worth every penny spent. 

Bedroom was cozy and comfortable with a spectacular view of the resort.
The most important aspect of any room in a hotel is the bathroom, and full marks to the hotel on that front.

The best part about Khyber was the hospitality, right from the driver who picked us up at the Srinagar airport to the bell boy who helped us while checking out were amazing. 
We even used the services of the resident physician Dr.Nazir a couple of times, really appreciate the way he took care of us and called in from time to time to check on our health.
Special mention for Mr.Shyam, Mr.Samir and their team at Cloves and Calabash. What an incredibly enthusiastic, hard working group they are. Some of the guys from the team deserve special recognition.
1) Arshid
2) Ishfaq
3) Yasir 
4) Bilal
These guys along with their managers made this perfect holiday an unforgettable one. These guys definitely are a great asset to the hotel.

Definitely going to recommend it to anyone traveling to Gulmarg. Kudos to the entire team at Khyber.

reviews.author: Lee Alexander R
reviews.title: The best hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a good hotel and certainly offers better accommodation and facilities than any other hotel in the village. It is conveniently located close the gondola - short walk down the hill in ski boots and then straight up the mountain for powder skiing challenges! The staff are friendly, the rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable and the food is adequate Indian cuisine - not the best but sufficient to satisfy a calorie recharge after a days hard skiing. Could the hotel be better? Certainly, some more attention to fixing problems would not go amiss - the shower in my room was partially broken; the furniture was scratched and looked a bit tired; and the bathroom shower gels and shampoo were never replaced and were running low by the time I left. Moreover, the sound-proofing between rooms leaves little to ones imagination. 

The warm swimming pool and spa facilities were good and looked out on the spectacular mountain scenery. The airport transfers were great and on time. On balance it is a hotel I would stay at again when skiing in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Shruti1911
reviews.title: Sensational Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed for 3 nights at Khyber and it is truly magical. The service is one of the best we have come across. The rooms are lovely. The location superb. the views from the hotel and rooms is spectacular. While Gulmarg in the winters is anyways one of the most beautiful places on earth, what made our trip special was the staff at the hotel. Not one in particular but across, everyone was so helpful and the hospitality is at a different level. I would like to name a few who made our trip even more special:
Arshid - he was so helpful, took our pictures, helped us in the deep snow and always courteous.
Mr. Shyam - he was managing the restaurant and took our preferences so he could include in the buffet menu the next day. Amazing.
Others who I would also like to mention are Bilal, Ajaj, Ishfaq, Samir and Yasir. I am sure I have forgotten many more who were as good.

reviews.author: Rakesh D
reviews.title: Arrogant Staff- Bad Food
reviews.text: Checked in on 18th Feb with Family as we had heard lot about this hotel with raving reviews. Right from the entrance the security was very rude not ready to help or provide with wheel chair for senior citizen . Buffet had very little spread with most of the dishes uncooked with arrogant waiters not ready serve water inspite of asking several times. Overall very frustating experience.

reviews.author: francesca d
reviews.title: A cozy indian experience
reviews.text: We enjoyed our four day stay in gulmarg. The hotel is cozy and warm, with beautiful large windows over the snowy landscape. The hotel has a very scenografic spa area, with a nice and warm swimming pool, exactly what you need after an intense day of powder snow skiying. The spa itself is l 'occitaine and the quality of the treatments is very very good. The room is decent size and we had a very large bed. Personell is extremely attentive, helpful and kind and takes personal interest in the comfort of your stay. Extremely kids friendly staff and place ( there is also a kids pool). We wiould certainly stay at the kyber again.

reviews.author: Dip0
reviews.title: Magical Place
reviews.text:
The Khyber at Gulmarg is simply a fairy tale - beautiful and magical. We stayed for 3 nights and what made this trip really special is the hospitality of the staff at khyber. They made us feel so special and i just have to mention a few names who made this trip magical.
1. Arshid - extremely helpful and was patient and wonderful and took great photos
2. Manager Shyam who ensured that we always got great food
In addition also wanted to mention Ishfaq, Samil and Bilal

The rooms are a great size with an enormous bed. 
Just 2 suggestion:
orientation of the hotel when we check in - we were a little lost and took us a a bit to find the lobby
change plug points in the hotel as even the mechanics struggle with them

Overall a magical property

reviews.author: Badri Beriwal
reviews.title: Only place that stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: this was my second time to Gulmarg and found this property to be the best place in Kashmir right now with amazing people and fantastic food. This is just my second day and I am loving it. Will keep you all updated.

reviews.author: pravinsri
reviews.title: himalayan wonder
reviews.text: Our 2nd visit to this hotel and it was more awesome than the Ist. Perhaps because we were able to witness snow fall the first time in our lives! But it's an amazing place anyway, beautifully located and with very nice comfortable rooms. The ambience is just right for a relaxed stay with extremely hospitable staff. The restaurant too is good and the staff there very very helpful. Aijaz, Ishfaq, Arshid in particular were outstanding in their service. A hotel truly worth a visit by everyone who can!

reviews.author: Sahil G
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text:
Stayed in jan end. View of snow covered gulmarg is awesome. Big propert with a cozy feel. I suggest balcony rooms especially to smokers. One of the most romantic property I have stayed especially in snow..
Foll marks to the property: 
spacious rooms 9/10
luxury 9/10
Cleanliness 10/10
hospitality 10/10
In room food 9/10
Breakfast 7/10
Price 8/10
Overall feel 10/10 
Thanks to Jerin and zafar from the front desk for taking care of everything personally.

reviews.author: Thenny M
reviews.title: Serene space
reviews.text:
The property although is huge, it gives a homely feeling, staff is super friendly, always willing to help with a smile. The space is gorgeous, especially the room overlooking the Himalayas, is just breathtaking.  The spa and the indoor heated pool are located in a perfect space to get rid of sore muscle after a day of skiing.  
The cottages are great for group with its own private seating/dining area.
I wish I had more time to enjoy all the facilities, had a fantastic time, highly recommend it.

reviews.author: PKT207
reviews.title: The hidden Jewel of India in Paradise
reviews.text:
So, let me start by saying that I was surprised with everything I saw from the moment I entered Gulmarg. It was blissful. It has snowed for 3-4 days and the entire landscape was filled with lush white powder. 

And, when we entered Khyber, it was a world apart. I was taken aback by the ideal location, the beautiful resort, impeccable service, and amazing food. 

The resort itself is mystical with great views. Our room had a great balcony overlooking the mountains. We were very happy with our rooms. the common areas were also great. It has a beautiful spa and gym. However, the heated pool stands out in the cold weather. 

Since all our meals were in the hotel itself, I really enjoyed everything. Though, I do think they can work on their Kashmiri taste a little bit. 

The service was amazing. From the bell boy to the reception to housekeeping, they were very well trained and friendly. They did everything we asked for and took really good care of us. 

I had injured my foot, so their in-house doctor was very helpful in sorting our my injury. 

I fell in love with the place and hope to visit it over and over again.

reviews.author: TheJMs
reviews.title: Great hotel and location
reviews.text:
We were there for four days skiing. Location is ideal for the lift station just round the corner and easy to get a lift if don't want the short walk.

Hotel of the highest standard with staff who appear genuinely friendly rather than having been trained to be so.

Spa facilities very good. Exceptionally good value for both accommodation and food. 

Clearly there are safety concerns but we felt comfortable during our visit and the locals were more than welcoming. 

Only tip is take your own alcohol as the hotel has no licence but happy for you to drink in the lounge. In particular take wine as no where to buy it locally.

Overall a great stay.

reviews.author: mughal13
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: We stayed at newly opened resort in gulmarg khyber as previously we used to saty in hotel highlands park. The hotel is located next to gandola nad does not have spectacular views as probably highlands park does but the rooms, heating are good. The food needs improvemnt as their kashmiri food is very mediocre. Also a la carte rates are exorbitant and do not justify as per portion size and taste. Khyber can be better with improvement in food quality.

reviews.author: AhujaKamal
reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: Kashmir is heaven on earth and Khyber resort the shining star in Kashmir. I was pleasantly surprised to check into this amazing property amidst beautiful settings of nature in Gulmarg. What really amazed me was top class luxury that I had neither experienced or expected in a hill station in India. Of course Wild flower hall is an exception. But we as a group of 4 families with kids had an unbelievable time. The hotel is totally comfortable for kids with a nice warm pool , game arcade and warm staff. Spa is excellent too. We took skiing lessons on slopes just about 5 mins from the resort. Would definitely come back often. While here a few times a question popped into my mind ;Switzerland ???

reviews.author: Valvexpert
reviews.title: as they say Gulmarg is Heaven on earth and Khyber certainly makes it complete
reviews.text:
14 of landed here this afternoon. It's been a wonderful experience since then. Check in was taken care of impeccably by 
Sujit the GM was there to ensure every need was taken care. The view is for a better word astounding, the rooms very well adorned. Snow fall, the view everything is gorgeous. Thank you Khyber team.

reviews.author: FlyByKnight
reviews.title: Fantastic property!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 3 nights, and loved it completely. What strikes you first, and leaves a lasting impression is the warmth and hospitality extended by EACH and EVERY member of the staff. I think it's a Kashmiri thing.

The rooms were well appointed and luxurious. Not the forgot the excellent central heating in the hotel was such a welcome relief to the -5 degrees outside. 

The food, be it at the restaurant or room service was probably the best I've had anywhere in a very long time. 

The best part...they don't serve alcohol, but permit you to get your own alcohol to the public cigar lounge and consume it. (Mixers have to be ordered though, very minimal cost) 

The Loccitane Spa, was the highlight of our stay. It really was the best spa we have ever been to, and was such a treat after a long day of skiing. 

Flip side, the heated pool wasn't operational and we weren't informed by the management. This was quite a disappointment, but everything else at the hotel made up for it.

reviews.author: Arun K
reviews.title: Fantastic hospitality
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is truly a spectacular property and the staff are the most courteous and follow a "Never say no to customer" policy which is amazing. The rooms are spacious and well furnished and so are the bathrooms with a separate shower area, comfort room and main wash area, well segregated. We get a wardrobe area where you can keep your luggage. Facilities in the hotel are awesome like a well equipped Steam, Sauna and a Jacuzzi- separate area for men and women. A nice well equipped play area for kids and adults called the "Igloo", they have an air hockey game, carrom and x box (3 sets) and some toys for young kids. Table Tennis was a miss and thy can easily add this.

reviews.author: VagabondOnTheMove
reviews.title: Overwhelmed!
reviews.text:
It's been three days since we left Gulmarg, but the holiday hangover/blues persist. Firstly, the place is beyond gorgeous. The thick blanket of soft, white snow makes it picture-postcard perfect. And there's no better hotel to experience it all from than the Khyber Resort & Spa.
Central heating itself (in a small town like Gulmarg) is a big luxury; and while the heating here is fab, it's no match for the warmth exuded by the people. We were completely overwhelmed by the hospitality and service. 
We loved the fact that we could take our own alcohol to the hookah and cigar bar. I don't know if that's just a function of the hotel not having its liquor licence yet, but nobody's complaining. The rooms were nice and toasty considering it was -7 outside. The view too was simply breathtaking. We had a small glitch with our bathroom drain but it was sorted out almost immediately.
The spa too was exceptional. The only bummer was that the indoor heated pool was under maintenance. Wish we had been informed before we got there, because we had actually carried our swimwear!
Although there's only one restaurant at the property, it's pretty damn good. And the bolognese definitely deserves a special mention.

To conclude, it was a fantastic holiday and there's absolutely NO doubt that we'll be going back next year, if not earlier.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Perfect Rooms | Incredible Views | Great Hotel Design
reviews.text:
This is truly and surprisingly a five star resort in Gulmarg. The resort is well designed with attention to details and touch of Kashmiri architectural styles. 
The rooms (including heating) are very comfortable and do not let the extreme climate affect your stay. They are fairly sized with lavish bathroom.
Food including buffet was quite good - four star. Staff service was excellent.
The heated pool is really heated and we saw people using it and having fun!
Next time we will go to Gulmarg only if we get rooms in Khyber! Cheers!

reviews.author: Isha2512
reviews.title: it's a paradise !!!
reviews.text: Had a 4 night stay at the Khyber Gulmarg and just got home yesterday. It's one of the few hotels which I couldn't wait to get home and review. Had a fantastic wholesome experience at this beautiful property. Its a complete package where nothing goes wrong, great rooms, beautiful location overlooking the mountains and pine trees dotted with snow, nice cozy well-heated rooms, clean, luxurious spa and health club, mouth watering food and lovely friendly and extremely helpful staff who were more than willing to make us feel comfortable, recommending some delicious dishes, helpling out with last minute taxi bookings and pretty much looking after all our needs. We were travelling with a 4 yr old child and were a bit apprehensive initially of the snow and weather, but staying at Khyber my little one enjoyed it soo much , he keeps asking when we are going back. Kudos to the friendly staff who made him really have a good time made him so happy with gulab jamuns and chocos and stuff everyday.. the hotel really knows how to pamper its guests :) feeling truly pampered and spoilt with all the luxury... can't wait to go back to the khyber soon !!!

reviews.author: Riddhivardhan
reviews.title: Divine Snow Wonder
reviews.text:
One the most amazing snow luxury hotels in the world, KHYBER is a perfect combination of nature and luxury. The views are mind blowing.......u feel close to the Divine.I went in late january, could enjoy the snow fall and snow carpet all around with chilling cold. 
          Courteous staff, nice ambience, good food , heated pools with good himalayan views and close proximity to Gondola make it a perfect recipe for fun. As the word khyber means extremes of health , fortune and spirituality..........U FEEL IT !!!!! One of my finest holidays , i will remember khyber for a long long time, i strongly recommend this himalayan resort for your trip to gulmarg.

I want to thank Mr Zaffar Malik (Manager Operations) for giving me a complimentary upgrade to himalayan view room which made my experience more beautiful.

reviews.author: NikhilChaudhary
reviews.title: Stairway to Heaven
reviews.text:
Forget the Swiss Alps. Outstanding service, luxurious spa, delectable Kashmiri food, interiors speaking volumes about the rich Kashmiri culture... Indeed a Paradise on Earth !!

After spending my first day at The Khyber I realized that the mountains never leave you. Whether it’s the bedroom, balcony or bathtub, the snowcapped mountains and meadows are always there. I will remember my evenings spent sitting on the balcony that offer the uninterrupted view of the snow covered pine trees and the mighty mountains. 

This was my second visit to Gulmarg and first visit to The Khyber. I am happy to say that nothing has changed here since my last visit as the government has banned further commercial construction in this region – I hate Shimla, Nainital and all the Mall Roads in the world. 

Last but not the least special thanks the hotel staff and their impeccable service who can give Rajasthani hospitality run for its money.

I’m going to see you guys again !! Kashmir is my second love.

reviews.author: PrateekBhargava
reviews.title: Absolutely brilliant... One of the properties in India
reviews.text:
Khyber is by far the best luxury resort to experience snow across the country. Better than even Oberoi's wild flower hall. Set in the beautiful valley of Gulmarg the resort is absolutely superb.

Brilliant rooms, latest technology, amazing food.

We stayed in the 2 bedroom cottage and it is absolutely brilliant. Spacious luxurious and awesome views.

We were well taken care of by our private butler Bilal who was absolutely perfect. 
Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Srinagar and Gulmarg.

reviews.author: sswang
reviews.title: Magnificient!
reviews.text: Though we were not residents at the hotel, we used the restaurant services of the hotel during a break while sight seeing. Even though the property was still under construction, we could tell by the look of it that it was magnificent and had the best views in town. This review is really for the Manager & restaurant staff who were very nice, despite just a brief interaction over a cup of Kehwa. They were gracious enough to even provide the tea & snacks on the house! The Manager was kind enough to provide a tour of the hotel to ensure that we would love to stay at the Khyber the next time in Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Sue
reviews.title: Wonderful place to relax :-)
reviews.text: The Khyber is one of the more expensive hotels in Gulmarg but is worth every penny. The rooms are spacious and the showers are always wonderfully hot:-) The hotel staff are attentive, polite and always willing to help. There is a range of food to cater for different tastes at the delicious evening buffet (which was included as part of our package) as well as a range of Indian and European style dishes for the breakfast buffet.The swimming pool and sauna are great for a visit after a days skiing. We really enjoyed our stay and are already planning a return visit next year:-)

reviews.author: Vinit M
reviews.title: The Signature Of Indian Hospitality With Mesmerising View
reviews.text: Always Dreamed Of Seeing Snowflakes Falling From The Sky....And That Historic Moment Happened During My Stay At The Khyber ..The Best Hospitality With Respect To Food , Service , Spa & Pool Maintenance & Guest Relations ... Apart Of The Spa , Jacuzzi & Indoor Heated Pool  The Things Not To Be Missed In The Property Is The Kashmiri Kheer , Kahwa , Sheesha & The Pastry Shopè...

reviews.author: Ajay G
reviews.title: am amazing hotel to stay in
reviews.text: one of the finest hotels that i have been to .. amazing hospitality , great food , excellent ambiance ,, u could not ask for more !! a really well kept hotel keeping the hostile weather in gulmarg during winters . The GM of the hotel personally ensure that everyone is comfortable and even the smallest needs are taken care of . Umar ,the  the owner of the hotel personally ensures that everyone and everything is taken care of in the best professional manner .The hotel has a character and kashmir is depicted in every step of the hotel, right from the photographs, to furniture, lamp shades,....u are truly treated like a ROYALTY  I would rate this as one of the finest hotels in the country

reviews.author: heb999
reviews.title: Excellent hotel with superb service.
reviews.text:
We recently spent seven nights at the 'Khyber' as we were visiting Gulmarg for a heli-skiing holiday.
The hotel is new, spacious and luxurious. It is situated just a short walk to the gondola and is surrounded with beautiful views of the Himalayas.  The shuttle service to the gondola was efficient and very much appreciated at the end of the day as it is a steep climb back uphill carrying ski equipment.
Our room was well appointed, cosy and very clean. The bathroom has a good walk-in shower and a bathtub which was wonderful for relieving sore muscles after skiing. The room is also provided with a good-sized fridge and a tv with channels from all over the world. It was serviced twice a day and on some days fruit and cookies were left for us. The only observation is that the room did not have much storage space for clothes.
We only ate at the Cloves restaurant which was excellent. We are not normally a fan of buffets but the food was so good that we made an exception. There was always something freshly cooked on offer besides the comprehensive a la carte menu. Breakfasts were also good with plenty of both Indian and Continental offerings. What was particularly impressive was the service, something the hotel should be very proud of.
Unfortunately, we did not have time to try the spa but we did take a quick look at the swimming pool which was very large and inviting.
We would like to thank the Managers for their warm and friendly service. They were always on hand and very approachable and nothing was too much trouble for them or any other staff member.
The only area of the hotel that needs a little attention is the ski room in the basement. The boot rack was sometimes used as a coat rack, skis were all over the floor and there was no way of securing skis. My skis were taken by someone else one morning (by mistake most probably) but it caused me considerable inconvenience. Other ski hotels have lockers or secure storage.
We would certainly recommend the Khyber and return next time we visit Gulmarg. We would also recommend taking advantage of the heli-skiing opportunities available in the area.

reviews.author: Jigna06
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 2 nights and We were overwhelmed with the level of service that we experienced starting with our room upgraded to the most beautiful mountain balcony room.These are  absolutely amazing in terms of view and comfort.One Can spend hours lounging in the balcony with a beautiful view of the mountains not just that even the bathrooms are so well planned,  the view of the mountains covered with snow from the hot tub is just out of the world experience.The place is very cozy and luxurious with great warmth.Hotel staff including the drivers were very helpful and made our stay even more comfortable.The whole experience was beyond our imagination.Special thanks to Zaffar for looking after us and making our stay memorable.Overall just the perfect place with breathtaking view and wonderful staff. couldn't ask for anything more. 
I did not want to leave this beautiful place and had to literally force myself to leave but I will definitely be back at Khyber.

reviews.author: Riyaj J
reviews.title: Expect nothing less than royal treatment
reviews.text: Felt like royalty from the minute I checked in to the minute I checked out.. We were ushered into our cozy bedrooms after an awesome kahwa tea.. Wasn't really impressed by the dinner buffet though, which I felt could have included some more Kashmiri dishes.

reviews.author: jindalnick
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
Kashmir is heaven on earth..but it truly lies in Khyber.. Awesome stay experience.. 
According to me ,"To Be Treated Like A King You Dont Have To Be Born In Royal Family..Just Visit Khyber"..esp thanks to Mr. Zaffar malik for making our stay so wonderful. Whole staff from ground level to upper level is so customer service oriented that is just beyond imagination. Food, rooms, ambience, spa area every corner, every inch is just wow....ATHITHI DEVO BHAV.  MEANS GUEST IS GOD.

If you havnt been to Khyber you havnt seen paradise.. So must visit...i just simply lived my dream by staying over here...

reviews.author: anshulmumbaii
reviews.title: Good hotel poor service
reviews.text: We booked khber gulmarg as the best 5 star resort hotel in gulamrg but we were disappointed with the servcies and attitute of the satff. We were made to wait for 1 hour for check in though we reached the hotel at 12:30pm, we were alloted the last corner room inspite of our booking done nearly 15 days before. The a la carte indian food which we were served looked stale and was just preheated with loads of cream added on it! We requested for a kichdi for an infant which was denied outright. The staff was over burdant and attention was on foreigner groups & owner with his friends, again we reuested for kadi at night which again was refused. They did not even allow us to have our own liquor in public areas this despite the fact that they dont have a in house bar. Overall we were highly dispappointed.

reviews.author: Vikrant Singh
reviews.title: Gar Firdaus Bar Rue Zamin Ast, Hami Asto, Hami Asto, Hami Asto.
reviews.text:
It was my first trip to Kashmir and I do not have words to justify this wonderful experience. We stayed in a house boat in Dal Lake for 2 nights and encountered a curfew on 9th, 10th and 11th Feb. I called up Mr. Aditya Mata (General Manager, The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg) and he showed the epitome of hospitality. He helped arranging an accommodation as well as evacuating us from Srinagar safely to reach this paradise on earth. Every moment of our trip was turned into a memorable holiday by the team at this resort. Starting from Mr. Mata (GM), Mr. Manuj Bahl (EAM), Mr. Bilal (Duty Manager), entire operations team consisting Hilal, front office staff, security staff from G4S and the entire culinary team are highly professionals and make you feel safe and at home. A major credit goes to Mr. Umar Tramboo (MD) who had a vision to create such master piece in Gulmarg.

Our stay of 2 nights was full of happiness. Everything was Our Way and Right Away – a luxurious room, balcony with a unique view, buffet breakfast, culinary master pieces like Haaq or Nadru Yakhni, temperature controlled pool, a nice spa, bon fire arranged by staff in evening, immaculate housekeeping, courteous concierge staff, humble chauffeurs, indoor games and view of snow covered Gulmarg.

We will surely return to this heaven and recommend to our friends, family and business partners.

Also, it is a great location for residential conferences as the resort offers state of the art meeting facilities.

Keep up the good work and you really deserve to be No. 1 which you undisputedly are.

reviews.author: maitreyi k
reviews.title: what an experience !
reviews.text:
We were here with our 2 children on a 4 day ski trip and despite bad weather ( we got snowed in ) , it was a great trip only because of the hospitality of the Khyber team . All our little demands and fancies were met with ease . The property is great , well located and close to the ski slopes . The food is excellent , the pool is so inviting , the spa is very good . 
Mr Aditya Mata , the General manager was around at any point to deal with any situation . Our sincere thanks to him and his team . 
Look forward to next year again .

reviews.author: jaidelhicantt
reviews.title: Best hotel in Gulmarg but with average views
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is probably the best hotel in gulmarg but the biggest drawback is that it offers very limited views as compared to highlands or nedous.hotel. We stayed in standard room and we payed 12k per night and the room offered view of trees and hotel compound and no view of gulmarg bowl. The hotel however has good heating facility and decent food but the food rates are on the higher side. There is no bar in the hotel which is not mentioned on their website.

reviews.author: Jayesh-Khilna
reviews.title: Heaven on earth..far better than Switzerland!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Khyber resort for 3 nights and I must say it is the most wonderful place we have ever been to. The hotel itself was very lavish and the scenery from the hotel was breathtaking! Special thanks to the manager Mr.Aditya Mata and his team who made sure our stay at the resort was very well looked after. All the staff were very generous and catered to all our needs. 

If you want to see Heaven on earth..visit Khyber Himalayan resort.

reviews.author: Geogeneric
reviews.title: "True Paradise on Earth"
reviews.text:
I am not sure if The Khyber will get anything less than a 5 Star Rating! The property and the people who run it exude such warmth, you'll hate yourself for leaving!
My wife and I stayed for 5 nights. The property, every inch of it is exquisite, very tastefully done up.The service quality is simply outstanding. Aditya, their VP at 9 starts at in the morning and ends his day at maybe 12 midnight. He is just everywhere ensuring things are in order. And the staff, every single one of them, serves with a smile. We're going back there to experience the summer!
If you're thinking Gulmarg, think Khyber! Bilal, Mansoor, Zafar, Shakeel, Puneet and Bilal from the restaurant will make sure you have an unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Sita S
reviews.title: Mint!
reviews.text:
Khyber you make me think about all the good things in Gulmarg. This is a 5* hotel.

The first time we walked in! Wow my eyes were all over the place. Aditya the GM welcomed us and organised some Cava and a snack.

Zaffer the Assistant Manager checked us in after a horrible night at Nedous. 

Rooms are spacious and amazing view. They are also centrally heated.

Breakfast/ afternoon Tea and Dinner is amazing.

Calabash is one of my favourite hang out spots. You can have a nice sheesha and mint tea! 

The Chaikash was amazing too once you get back to the hotel u get free complimentary Kashmiri Cava. This just hits the spot once you come back from the cold.

Please note the hotel does not have a bar so bring your own booze! Respect the family for not having a bar due to religious reason! But they allow you to drink at the hotel.

Staff at the Khyber are all polished and very very polite. Always very helpful.

Shakil for at the front desk and was always very helpful and friendly. So was Zaffer! Thanks guys! You made us feel at home!

The drivers were also amazing and the hotel offers free pick up and drop of to the airport in decent 4 x 4 cars. Thanks for getting us back safely to the airport after snowing 15inches! 

Spa/ Gym/ Pool / Sauna / Steam and Jacquzi - if you can't ski don't worry you have all this to enjoy at Khyber! 

For people going to Ski in Gulmarg.

Hotel is less than one minute  drive from the Gondola and offer a free transfer to and from the Gondola which is amazing. Other hotels are a good 10-15 min walk or charge for using the taxi service.

Hiring Ski's - Alpine Ski Shop is one of the best places to hire ski's and equipment.

Storage room to store your Ski's and boots is very nice and safe at Khyber and the staff help you.

Ski Instructors - this is one thing you need to be careful about. A lot of them are guides so are good to show u around you on the slopes and off piste but not great teachers. We wasted three days with one instructor and change for two days with another one who was slightly better.

Ski passes cost -
Phase 1 - 600 rupees for full day and Rs 200 for a single way.

Chair Lift - 150 for single way

Phase 2 - 600 for full day

Ski instructors roughly cost Rs 600 -1000 per person. 

Food and drinks are available at the Dhaba's at the top of phase 1 which is cheap and reasonable.

Skiing in Gulmarg is a different experience if you are used to skiing in France. Where you have a map and 25 different slopes. There is one main slope on Phase one which is a Blue to Green ( Europe Standard). The rest of the time you experience there is off piste. Your guides will take you through small off piste routes.

So in one line - Khyber is the place to be in Gulmarg it's a one stop shop! Ticks all the boxes. I loved it and thanks for the great time!

reviews.author: Clarabellestar_UK
reviews.title: A unexpected gem in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I've just spent 7 nights in the Khyber resort, with a group of friends celebrating a 40th.

Without doubt, the Khyber is a gem in Gulmarg.  A member of the Small Luxury Hotels group, it offers 5 star facilities and accommodation in the magnificent setting of the Gulmarg ski area.

The rooms are lovely - comfortable, well appointed and impeccably clean.  After a day on the slopes it was a joy to get home and snooze, before heading out to dinner.    The food is wonderful, both Indian and continental dishes available either a la carte or buffet style.  Most of the time we were served in the Cloves restaurant (lovely).  When the hotel was fuller, we were relocated downstairs to the banqueting hall, which was by a margin less pleasant and felt more like a large school dining hall!  However, a minor gripe.

The L'Occitane spa was an unexpected treat.  Lovely setting, good massage, good value.  Much appreciated after a hard couple of days on the slopes!  I didn't get to try the pool and jacuzzi, but the gym was well appointed and barely used (the three of us working out there were the only people to have been in for a while I think.....)

The hotel is located directly above the gondola with the hotel offering free drops from the door to the gondola every morning, plus a pick up in the evening.  Not exactly ski in, ski out, but I think the best you're going to get!  Be warned though, the weather here is extreme, and if you're not lucky then you might end up walking in and out (but then again you do get to enjoy the powder when this happens...).

A couple of minor gripes - the pre-arrival service and comms could have been smoother, with the person in charge having some difficulties in getting replies from the hotel.  Service sometimes is a bit slow (if you're ordering a coffee in the morning then be prepared for a 15 minute wait).  For some reason there are no racks on the jeeps for skis?  Finally they need more boot and ski racks in the ski room.  

However, all in all, a truly memorable stay and an amazing holiday.  Would go back in an instant.

(BTW bring your own booze!  The Khyber is dry but they have no problem if you bring your own.  And if you do fancy a night out, the Highlands Hotel has a v nice bar and restaurant!)

reviews.author: lm1900
reviews.title: Impeccable Service and Hospitality!
reviews.text:
Would like to start this review by stating just how extraordinary the attitude of the service staff was!
To elaborate, at every instance they were so polite and just out to help and make you more comfortable, right from the doorman to every waiter and other staff.
We were on a Snow package that included our transfers from Srinagar and b/fast and dinner.
As were a group of 10, and the hotel does not serve alchohol, we had carried our own bottles which we would sit in Calabash, an area with tables outside the restaurant in the lobby for hours drinking listening to our music and no one bothered us.
Even if we got some food out of the restaurant to feed the kids, they were adjusting unlike most other hotels which are unnecessarily finicky not looking to the convenience of the guests.

Food
Food was generally good, especially their SHEEKH KABABS were to die for!! However, those we ordered a la carte and food apart from the buffet is expensive.
Buffet had decent variety and food was fairly good, better on some days than others.

Rooms 
rooms are decent, nothing extraordinary but for the remote location of the hotel, I guess good.
BUT even in winter the rooms get very very stuffy and suffocating at night, so much so that we opened the door the first night a bit and then got table fans to circulate air  the following nights.
We did complain and people did come to fix but I think their system doesnt go below 24 degrees into air conditioning, so dont know if it was just our room, or whether changing rooms would have made a difference?
Also goes to show that their insulation so good or the quality of their glass/windows/doors that despite it being below minus outside, still not freezing in the room! 
Mattresses are also ok, not particularly comfortable and pillows very large, heavy and uncomfortable.    
THE MOST IMPORTANT thing is no matter what anyone tells you, please get a HIMALAYAN view room versus the GULMARG view!!!!!!
The room with the balcony makes no differeence in winter as balcony does not get used so though we had it, was not worth paying the price difference. In summer, probably yes!

Room Service too was extremely helpful and willing to finger cut some carrot and cucumber I had carried with me as my 4 year ols has food allergies! 

Spa is run by L'occitane and the facial I had was good and therapist though fairly new and from nagaland but decent.

Jacuzi and indoor pool was also really enjoyed by the kids! 

Overall the staff goes out of their way to satisfy and are very courteous and polite in a very genuine way and not just how the thai do it because they have to or are supposed to!!

All in all would surely go back, just wish they would aircondition the rooms!

reviews.author: sunny1232014
reviews.title: excellent hotel and very helpful staff
reviews.text: lovely place, beautiful surroundings, very helpful and friendly staff, we had snow during our stay there and views are breathtaking. we were overwhelmed by the hospitality and particularly zafar and bilal helped us out of the way in arranging our transportation as we would have been stuck due to heavy snow overnight, they arranged everything, we will definitely be returning back, very close to gandola and other activities in gulmarg.

reviews.author: Ronnie
reviews.title: Gem of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber has the best location especially for skiiers and is right above the Gondola.
