This hotel really changes your experience of Gulmarg and made me feel like home. The Cavas served in the lounges are amazing. They have a nice Hookah lounge and the hookahs are amazing. Hotel would benefit greatly from a bar.

The rooms are centrall heated and are very spacious.

The Gym and Spa are facilities offered only by Khyber although the jacuzzi needs to be repaired.

I wish the hotel would provide more affordable wifi if not complimentary. 

A nice value added service would be a ski shop and professional ski instructors like in Europe because I had a bad experience with a ski instructor.

The General Manager, Aditya was an extremely helpful manager who was on on his feet pretty much round the clock.

reviews.author: amitmittal24
reviews.title: An perfect all around experience which could'nt get better.
reviews.text: Fantastic food, excellent service, great ambience. My staying experience was beyond expectations. Though a bit expensive but does not pinch paying the extra bit for the wonderful all round experience. Only if it had some extra activities within the property it would be a complete package. On the whole just one word Excellent & hope that the hotel management can maintain it all.

reviews.author: Ishfaq M
reviews.title: A blissful holiday
reviews.text:
It has just been 3 months since the Hotel has become operational and it seems like it has always been there. This magnificent property is nested on a platue with views of, some of the most scenic slopes of Gulmarg. A new addition to the prestigious SLH club in India and the only one in Kashmir. This property gets my two thumbs up! Highly recommended - Five Star deluxe mountain resort experience. 

I also look forward to conducting my company conferences and business meets here and if I find my soulmate soon, then most likely celebrate here :)

reviews.author: Dilshad M

reviews.author: sushimaru
reviews.title: 雰囲気よし、ベーカリーが美味！
reviews.text:
2月上旬に宿泊してきました。まだ、2012年の12月21日にオープンしたばかりのこのホテルは、グルマルグ一の最高級ホテルであり、施設も充実しています。正直、来る前には場所的にカシミールの地方なのであまり期待はしていなかったのですが、行ってビックリしました。

従業員のサービス、清潔さ、雰囲気、お部屋、すべてをとっても洗練されており、大都市の5つ星ホテルと設備はほとんど変わりません。ホテル内に入るとまずはカシミールの緑茶、カーワのウェルカムドリンクから始まり、ガラス張りのラウンジやレストランからは山々が見渡せます。建物はカシミールの伝統木材建築で、内装も落ち着いた感じです。セキュリティー（警備員）も沢山おり、安心です。

バスルームにはバスタブがあり、シャワーブースも別、お部屋の設備もどこの5つ星ホテルと変わりません。ここはセントラル・ヒーティングシステムがあるので、外気温が氷点下の中、お湯がふんだんに使え暖房もよく効いている事はありがたいです。

従業員の感じもよく、大抵すれ違うたびに挨拶をしてくれました。まだ新しいホテルですが、皆さんとてもがんばっている印象を受けました。

レストランで夕食と朝食を頂きましたがどれもとても上品の味で、特にパン類を含めたベーカリーは今までインド在住13年の間で食べたパン類で一番美味しいものでした！しかもこのカシミールの地方で！朝のクロワッサンと、デザートで頂いたブラウニーは本当に美味でした。

夕食は、カシミール料理を召し上がりました。カシミールは野菜や果物が美味しいので、素材のうまさを生かしている印象を受けました。カシミール料理はインドの平地の料理とは違い、あまり辛くなく、食べ易いかと思います。肉料理が多いのも特徴です。

ホテルにいるかぎり、ここがインドである事を忘れさせてくれる雰囲気でした。

短所を申し上げると、バスタブの水調整が悪く、お湯が少し出る程度で、とても使える状況ではありませんでした（その代わり、シャワーはお湯が勢いよくでて気持ちよかったです）。チェックアウトの際に文句をつけたら、マネージャーの人に「なぜもっと早く言わないんだ！」と言われ、すぐにフロントの担当者に直すように言っていました。聞いたところ、まだホテルができたばかりで、時々不具合があるらしく、プレッシャーを調整すれば出が良くなるとの事でした。どちらのしろ、すぐに行動に移した様で、次のお客に迷惑が掛からない様努力しているのかと思います。

もう一つの難点は、ホテルは山の高台に位置し、とても景色が良いのですがスキー場に出るまで急勾配の坂を上り下りしなければなりません。私達は徒歩でスキー場やゴンドラ駅まで行ったのですが、年配の方々や小さいお子様連れには少々きついかもしれないので、短い距離でも車をご利用される事をお勧めします。実際、ゴンドラ駅まではホテルから徒歩5分なのですが。

あと、ホテルのホームページにスパや屋内プールの案内がありますが、こちらができるのは2013年5月以降になるらしいです。

総合的にはとても満足のいく滞在でした。

reviews.author: Chetan S
reviews.title: Great Experience At Cloves Restaurant- The Khyber

This was our second time visiting khyber after 12 years and we felt the food was an upgrade especially the chaat and the indian dessert .On enquiring we did find out that they have a new chef Mr.Rajeshkumar Guptaji and his chaat was such a refreshing change from the same food we had been eating on our 7 day trip combined with other hotels.The RAS MALAI and garam gajjar halwa was to die for .
The resort had tooo many families with loud kids all around us which obviously is not their fault but the vibe is just tooo noisy.
The heated pool a plus but changing room not great.
So all in all a mixed after taste.Though would definitely come back for Guptajis chaat and Mithai.

reviews.author: JanviShahh
reviews.title: Nature's Luxury Haven: A Majestic Retreat at Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Our return to Khyber for the second time proved to be just as remarkable as our initial experience. Our first encounter with this exquisite establishment was in December of 2018, where we joyously welcomed the New Year amidst the hotel's splendid arrangements.

This recent visit took us to the snowy landscapes of Srinagar and Gulmarg, where we were blessed with a picturesque snowfall upon our arrival in Gulmarg, transforming the surroundings into a mesmerizing white haven.

Upon returning to the hotel after a delightful snow play, we were greeted by a dedicated room for guests to store their snow gear and change footwear, providing the convenience we needed. The hotel offers comfortable footwear for leisurely strolls, while guests can conveniently leave their rented boots in this designated area.

Cloves, the hotel's primary restaurant, offers a diverse array of cuisines, predominantly North Indian, where we relished in the culinary delights amidst a bustling ambiance, particularly during buffet hours. Our culinary journey extended to Brava, where we delighted in delectable Italian fare accompanied by a scenic view. While the mushroom soup surpassed expectations, the Eggplant Parmigiana fell slightly short, yet the Tiramisu redeemed the dining experience with its delightful taste. The attentive staff provided warm and insightful service throughout our dining experience.

For those seeking lighter fare and evening teas, Chaikash, the hotel's tea lounge, offers an inviting space, while CALABASH caters to enthusiasts of shisha.

One of Khyber's standout features is its temperature-controlled pool, offering a breathtaking view that complements the luxurious experience. The spa services uphold a high standard of professionalism, with knowledgeable therapists ensuring a rejuvenating experience.

Khyber in Gulmarg stands as a testament to the harmonious blend of nature and luxury, offering an indulgent escape for discerning travelers.

reviews.author: Hetal C
reviews.title: Watch out!! Appearance can b very deceptive
reviews.text:
Imagine walking into the only 5* property in Gulmarg & getting a cold welcome!! 

We entered the property wit 2 senior citizens - an infant 6 months old - a child 4.5 yrs old + 3 out of the 4 adults unwell - all of them struggling wit travel sickness, tired as hell Frm the 4 hr road travel Frm Pahalgam only to see a fully busy lobby & no one to even bother about ur presence there 
Versus the other properties where u r so warmly welcomed wit some associate help u settle down while they help u thru the checkin 

Post all the formalities, we were definitely given a table where they served the kawah while they handed over the rooms.. But also, We were just abt 20 mins late for Hi tea - but were outright refused the service. 

The rooms we got were @ ground level called level 5 wit a decent view - but the first thing u would see r the green Bob wires n not the scenic beauty as they r so in ur face . 
Also, u just cannot keep the curtains open to enjoy the views at any point of time as ppl walk around n there is zero privacy!! 
It was just another room wit zero view now. 

The hotel is so overbooked wit limited staff & Resturant space that it feels like a fish market. The tables r so close to each other tht u r literally looking into ur neighbours food & hearing their conversations - the waiters have to come so close to u n take ur order coz they can barely hear u.. 
plus since they r so under equipped to handle this kind of a crowd, beware if u order al-a-cart, the quality of food is just abt edible incase u r lucky!! 
We got unlucky wit undercooked rice & super spicy salad, dal wit barely a tadka flavour & buns that were dry & hard.. 

We also requested for an empty soup bowl to make the infant porridge- but they were so busy taking other orders tht I had to personally go and get the bowl while my child was crying wit hunger. 

The people in Kashmir in general r very sweet & helpful.. All the hotels we stayed in so far whether it was the Lalit in Srinagar or Radisson in Pehalgam, we were really welcomed n well taken care of .. it was like we must make a visit to Kashmir often not just for its beauty but also for its people, love & service.
But unfortunately Khyber can really change ur opinion, 

It’s our first day here n we can’t really wait to get outta this property!! 

I would think better to try another property - this is only over hyped as it’s the only available 5 start here.

reviews.author: Leena Asnani Aka Purvi Mangtani
reviews.title: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa - A literal slice of Paradise !
reviews.text:
Gulmarg - A portmanteau of not just Gul ( Flowers) and marg ( Path) but metaphorically of emprise and empyrean. No matter what time of the year you decide to visit this notable hill station in Kashmir, you are left spellbound by its overwhelming beauty. The meadows are enveloped in the snow in winter or embraced by the otherworldly flowers in spring and summer.

When in Gulmarg, your heart desires to feel the mighty Himalayas as close as possible and breathe in the crispest air that this place has to offer. To all this, a property that does justice is The Khyber Himalayan resort & spa. The resort oozes luxury, elegance, and vintage woodsy decor with the finest bright-hued upholstery in its decorum. The corridors were redolent of tuberose & jasmine throughout. The views from the wooden patios are surreal and overlook the gigantic peeking Himalayas. Not to miss the spirit of the tall chinar trees that proudly encircle the property. The hustling cafe & restaurants in the lobby area welcome you with the warmest smile and, the Kashmiri kehwa is packed with flavors and dry fruits leaving an everlasting taste of freshness in your mouth.

The courteous staff ensures you are rested and pampered while they fulfill the check-in formalities. The rooms are huge and we booked Luxury Himalayan view rooms with balconies because there was an inevitable affair between the heart and soul-soaking views of the mighty mountains. Massive beds, the fluffiest pillows, European sofas, and vibrancy in every corner of the room. If this isn't enough, there's a plush bathroom with a bathtub with breathtaking vistas and silken toiletries from "the forest essentials".

I would rate the breakfast pleasant but with scope for improvement as the bakery products weren't as fresh as expected but overall their food is decent. The team is very attentive to your needs and makes extra efforts to ensure you are comfortable, not just within the hotel premise but also when exploring the vales and dales of Gulmarg.

They are conveniently located very close to the Gondola point and other eating/shopping joints. 

In a nutshell; a fabulous stay! I would highly recommend this property and am eager to plan my trip to Kashmir once again in the summer or fall season. I am assured there is boundless beauty this beautiful place and property has to offer.

reviews.title: Khyber is best and not over hyped

Hilal from the restaurant took care of all our required jain food , kids food , etc. he was always smiling.

reviews.author: Vishal Mangtani
reviews.title: Visit with Family
reviews.text: Our Kashmir trip was for 8 nights in Mar 2023 of which we booked 2 nights in The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa, Gulmarg. We booked Luxury balcony Himalayan view rooms, and the view of snow capped mountains with Chinar trees was breath-taking. We never felt like leaving the room since it was so luxurious, the bathroom was fit for a king, kids loved the bathtub and refused to get out of it. The only greed I could offer them more was the heated swimming pool which has glass walls on 2 sides overlooking the mountains.  The sauna, steam and jacuzzi were well maintained and my kids loved every bit of them. Breakfast covered all cuisines (English, south Indian ,north Indian, bakery) in which you would find something or everything to your liking. They need to include local food like Kashmiri breads in breakfast which i did not see. Promotion of local food is always a great plus point.  The food ordered in the room was delectable .The room service, front desk and coffee shop  staff are so warm ,they took special care of us. Needless to say this is highly recommended property for the breath-taking views, warm hospitality and proximity to Gondola rides . Thank you, The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa, Gulmarg., for having us.

reviews.text:

Mr Hussain is the epitome of excellence in service and his attitude and work ethic matches the sublime interiors and exteriors of the hotel. After he attended to us we were looked after extremely well. A shout out as well to Mr. Zahid in the restaurant for his care and attentiveness. Highly recommend the Khyber Hotel.

reviews.author: viraj s
reviews.title: Average hospitality with lacking infrastructure but really good food.
reviews.text:
For the longest time, Gulmarg meant Khyber to me. We visited the resort on 17th March with an intention of staying within the property only for the full day. We were 4 couples with 2 children. 

So we checked in on 17th March at around 3.30 PM. The usual check-in is at 2 PM. We were informed that 1 of the rooms is still not ready. Not sure why as we were already checking in 90 mins later than usual. The checkin process at their end is super clumsy and took about 45 mins in total. Not sure why.

Since we had arrived after traveling for 5 hours, we were hungry and none of their restaurants were ready to serve us. The only place where the food was available was their cafe- Chaikash which honestly is supremely understaffed. Hence the basic sandwich and pizza took about an hour.

Coming to the rooms, we were on the 5th floor. They have an issue with the plumbing and hence the bathrooms were smelling. In one of the rooms suddenly at 4 AM, AC started making weird noises and hence it had to be switched off. When complained to the management team about it with video proof, they offered an extended stay till  evening. We declined since we already had activities planned after the check out. 

Food is really good.

If honestly asked, I wouldn't recommend the property to anyone. With the amount that they charge they really lack the warmth in the hospitality and infrastructural amenities.

We stayed at Taj in Srinagar and everyone could feel the difference in the hospitality.

reviews.author: Avinash T
reviews.title: A Total Value for Money! Had an Amazing Stay for our Anniversary!
reviews.text:
We visited the Khyber on the 12th of March for our 5th Wedding Anniversary in Gulmarg.
Mr Waseem Sultan whose assigned at the Front Desk Manager, helped us with early check-in and upon request even upgraded us from the Gulmarg Balcony View Room to the Himalayan Balcony View since it was our 5th Wedding Anniversary fortunately that was the last available room, which was very thoughtful and quite considerate of the front office team.

The view from the property is breathtaking. We were offered complimentary Cake and Pastry at their restaurants by the thoughtful team and managers. The swimming pool is temperature-controlled and has all the state-of-the-art steam and sauna as well. Don't forget to take your swimming costume, but you can still buy it from the property at an additional expense. The Sheesha lounge served us amazing Sheesha with complimentary Kahwa and Non-Alcoholic Kahwa.

We eventually ended the day with dinner at the Italian Restaurant as the normal Indian Restaurant was jam-packed. The hotel also offers games like Billiards, Carrom and TT as well to play.

But overall a completely romantic and wonderful stay, the staff at the restaurant even for the restaurant buffet were really helpful and always very accommodating. A MUST TRY but try to book the Himalayan View for the best room view!

reviews.author: shouvanik
reviews.title: Heavenly Khyber
reviews.text:
Staying at Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa- an award winning resort, nestled 8825ft above the sea level in the Pirpanjal range of Himalaya- truly an experience of life time. It will mesmerise anyone once you enter in it- what a interior! A very well maintained star property with exquisite wooden work of authentic Kashmiri craftsmanship, lavishly designed room, very spacious with balcony and all modern amenities… luxury bathroom with bathtub, separate shower, toilet and changing area and A snowy view outside to indulge yourself into the world of true luxury. But the best of this property is it’s location.. what a view of Apharwat Himalaya, snowy slopes and forests of pine and deodar.. specially from the Himalayan view room… it will justify expense( approx 42k per night) which is really very high as per Indian standards. The entire property is centrally heated which will feel you very comfortable even in peak winter with minus temperature outside. The pool is also heated and the pool area has just extraordinary view of outside snowy slopes and mountains. We have stayed three nights in March 2022 and it was just an exceptional experience. The staffs are very courteous and helpful. However I felt few drawbacks too..
1. Very high cost of food and buffet which may make you uncomfortable if you are planning for long stay like three nights.
2. Limited and average breakfast menu.. not justified as per rate. We have stayed many luxury hotels across India like Taj, J W, ITC group etc who are much ahead in terms of variety and cost effectiveness of buffet
3. Loccitane Spa- our first experience of L’Occitane spa was at J W Mussoorie which was just heavenly- with that expectation with took service at Khyber too.. but here our experience was little different.. firstly it is more costly as per the quality of service. Second they provide only male to male and female to female therapists.. so if you are taking couple service, your spouse must feel comfortable to take service in presence of a male therapist in a single room. Thirdly the lounge of spa is a common area for Gym and pool too, and specially in evening it’s over crowded with people of all age group. So if you wish to relax and enjoy some special moments before taking therapy, it’s not possible.( I’ve attached a pics of the chaos too!)
3. They almost never receive any phone calls.. but reply readily on email.

Overall it’s a heavenly resort for a lifetime experience specially in winter months but definitely with a very high expenditure.

Once you enter the hotel you know it is the best property you will find in all of Kashmir. People come to Kashmir specially to stay at The Khyber and I must say, the hype is real. 

Rooms: we stayed in the Premium category room which is a bit bigger and with a private balcony with a beautiful view. We had a walk-in closet and the rest of the bathroom was quite spacious too. The rooms are luxurious! However, this category of rooms can be a long walk away from the restaurant downstairs. 

Food: no complaints about the quality and quantity here. The spread is lavish and top class. The service however was a letdown. The staff was sometimes not at their best - their communication and speed had become a big problem for our group of 15. It got so bad that we had to take this up with the management. 

Spa & Pool: could describe the spa in one word - overpriced. I got a 60min massage and I wasn't fully satisfied with my masseur but the women's masseuse was pretty good for my wife & mom. They do have steam & sauna services. The pool used to be quite packed due to the amount of guests at the hotel so we didn't spend a lot of time there but the pool area is a vibe - just spend some time here early morning or evening after 7pm.

reviews.text: The Khyber resort is the place to stay at whenever you visit the heavenly town of Gulmarg. The hotel provides you with breathtaking views both in the summer and in the winter. The resort offers some good food from around the world as well as some delicious local treats. The staff is very welcoming and kind and is always there for you whatever the problem. reviews.author: Ambar
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous! Insanely brilliant service and the slopes and snow are so good!
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 7 nights from 02Feb to 09Feb. We were 2 people, who came to snowboard. 

Airport pickup: we had asked the hotel for an airport pick and drop. This was very smooth. There was a guy right at the baggage belt, with our names on a placard and he took us out to the car, in the parking lot. The car driver was nice and friendly and we stopped in the way for a quick bite. 

Check in: Was smooth. We sat in the lounge while it was done. A bit weird, but I was asked for the invoice for the booking, which I clearly didn’t have (who does). Anycase, that wasn’t a hindrance. Checkin went smooth. 

Rooms: there are rooms with our without balcony. We took one with a balcony. Ideally, in winters, avoid a balcony room. Also, the balcony rooms come with Gulmarg view and mountain view - the mountain view is gorgeous! (Perhaps for summer). 

Restaurant: the restaurant was good and the quality of food and the service was quite nice. There is a variety of food. We did the dinner buffet one night, which was a bit disappointing - 6/10, I’d say. Breakfast was very well laid and great quality. 

Bar : the hotel doesn’t serve/sell alcohol but you’re welcome to bring your own booze and sit in the sisha lounge and drink. This worked out quite comfortably. There is service there and you get everything you need. A SHOUTOUT to Firdous, at the Shisha lounge. His service was exemplary. Made us feel welcome and service was very personalised. 

Ski/snowboard: the gondola is about a 400m walk from the hotel but it’s a steep climb back to the hotel. Unlike all good ski resorts, here there is no shuttle service. I asked the management and was told that the local taxi drivers don’t allow hotel cars (to maintain their monopoly). The local taxi guys charge 500rupees for this 500m trip. 
Possibly the only downside. 

Gondola : beautiful. Well maintained. 

Hotel pool and gym : 
The gym is very good, well equipped and quite scenic. 
The pool is very scenic, but for winter months, I think it’s a bit cold. I was hoping it to be like an onsen (like in Japan) or a hottub(in the states/Europe), but its much cooler which made me refrain from going into it. 

Internet: the internet of the hotel is quite good, considering how remote the hotel is. 

All in all - 9/10 (possible because of shuttle service). 

Will come back.

reviews.title: Pretentious and unfriendly
reviews.text: The hotel interior and setting is nice but the service is not good and watch out for out of date food. It took 3 attempts to find jam that was not out of date! Also, if you are not resident they ask for 2500 rupees extra to get a massage, that is on the top of the massage price.

reviews.author: sal30
reviews.title: What the reception lacks in welcome- the restaurant team more than makes up for it
reviews.text:
First things first - we enjoyed our stay here so much that we're already planning for next Jan. We were here for a two day ski trip and got in to the hotel by 12pm. We had emailed earlier asking for a valley view not knowing that our valley view stared out into a hut like structure. We asked for it to be changed to the other side but were met with a lot of resistance at the reception since they said we had asked for this view- we admitted we did not know and were happy to pay any change charge to the other view. However, for some reason the reception staff seemed to keep disappearing on us which is not exactly what you want after long travel. Fortunately one manager seemed proactive and asked us to have lunch while he sorted it out (which he did fairly quickly after he took over - the rest just seemed to not know what they were doing). 
In contrast we walked over to the restaurant and Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal etc were just fabulous. From the start to the time we left, they went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable and happy. They are partly the reason we will head back. 
The other of course is the view and the fact that it is the best hotel in terms of facilities which is great when traveling with younger ones.
In short - 
We loved our stay at Khyber and will definitely be back next ski season 
Loved the food - do not miss the trout at the restaurant 
Get the mountain view (we learnt this the hard way) with balcony sit out - its like staring at a picture postcard 
The pool is wonderful and relaxing so do carry swimwear 
Kahwa at Chaikash is amazing and truly appreciated after a day long of sking
Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal and all of the restaurant crew - thank you !!

reviews.author: HMS
reviews.title: Solid property with service flaws
reviews.text: We stayed 6 nights at Khyber in early March while skiing. The hotel is the most solid and luxurious hotel in Gulmarg. Rooms are sufficiently spacious and have all the usual amenities. The spa, pool and gym area is generous although it can get noisy in the late afternoon. Breakfast and dinner is served buffet style. Food quality and variety is quite satisfying. It could be a 4 star property if the service would match. Staff at reception is polite but if you need something from them you probably have to ask twice or thrice. Housekeeping is also lacking. I wasn't able to get more than 2 small towels throughout our stay despite numerous reminders. Nevertheless, I would likely return to the Khyber as other hotels do not have the same infrastructure.

The hotel is located next to the Gondola ... so has a perfect location being on the highest level of the land.
The building, rooms, were all average to be honest, compared to the price being paid.
The only significant thing about the hotel was the staff and the food.
The staff was amazing, in every department/place.
I was received by Burhaan, very decent guy who handled my check in and showed me the room. 
I'd like to thank the restaurant managers, both were superb and very decent. I was seated for dinner then because I had this headache I opted to get back to my room, they made it so easy and Abd-Allateef brought me the food to my room, another decent and polite man.
The next day I checked out , and had to rush so couldn't get enough time for breakfast, Iqbal from the restaurant packed something for me to eat on the road.

Overall it was a nice stay, comfortable, mainly because of the staff. 
Not complaining about the rooms though, they were as seen on photos, but frankly not worth the money spent as they weren't that fancy. but the staff was really welcoming and brilliant.
Onething I noticed, they some kept on calling me " brother ", which may sound unprofessional however I enjoyed it, being a muslim we tend to use brother with all, but furthermore it made me feel home.

I'd probably stay there again if I visit, for the sake of the view and the staff

reviews.author: Jay_Banglore2018
reviews.title: Royalty at the roof of the world!!!!
reviews.text: This is our very first stay in The Khyber .... no words to describe this place..... the hotel reception and the common areas are decked with lavishness and royalty.... but the room( where we were put up) itself seemed a little old fashioned smaller than we expected .....can’t say it was worth the price we paid for .... but i can’t deny the fact that it had a stunning view of the mountain peak  at such close range.... it was surreal!!!!.... and the bathtub was put to good use by my little one....the Gondola ride station is only a stones throw from the Khyber.....which is really amazing as we can get back to the warmth of our room as soon as we finish our ride.... there are other activities in the hotel to entice us like the spa and various food lounges.... but as we just stayed for one day/ night, we weren’t able to explore much..... a special mention has to be made to the breakfast buffet... really grand!!!.....don’t know if we’ll ever check-in to Khyber again..... but we had an experience we’ll cherish for a lifetime!!!!

reviews.author: Loes W
reviews.title: Swanky resort in walking distance to the slopes
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber at the recommendation of someone from Srinagar who said the hotel was the best in all of Kashmir. The hotel isn't cheap but a lot of fun to splurge on for a night. The service is impeccable and the rooms are wonderful. A highlight was the massive bath tub which overlooks the Himalaya (ask for a Himalaya view when you book). The restaurant is decent though the buffet didn't look like anything special (we went a la carte). The hotel doesn't serve any alcohol but you're welcome to bring your own if you want to savour a glass of red in the aforementioned tub. The old school grandeur as well as the location of this hotel made me want to bust out a tricycle and race over the carpet croaking 'Redrum'. A very fun experience all in all.

reviews.author: jillis gwen c
reviews.title: Unforgettable Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber 2 nights and had the most enjoyable time. Hotel room is clean and spacious, with full length window and luxurious decor. Facilities are well kept. Just sitting by the window sipping hot coffee and looking at peaceful snowfall is priceless!

Hotel staff are extremely warm and friendly. They never fail to say Hello when they see us. Upon check in, staff Mr Hamid led us into our rooms and made full effort to help us settle in. Ensured wifi was working ( very important to city girls ). He even called us to alert us to look out our room windows as it began to snow!! Much appreciated and amused! Mr Hamid was always nearby to say hello with his broadest smile. Always eager to help with anything. A service standard with an edge above all.

We would like to thank F&B manager who ensured we ate well. He was quick and flexible with our difficult requests, another service standard many other hotels need to learn from.

Overall, we felt so treasured and important in Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, like how a fully mesmerised guest should feel. Keep up the wonderful job. Definitely recommending this! 

We will miss you
Jillis

reviews.author: R1C
reviews.title: serene place with very friendly staff
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this place specially for families with kids. The place is really really beautiful and peaceful. It is pricier compared to most hotels but u get what u paid for. You get your money’s worth. We booked a basic room and it is quite spacious. I f u can shell out some more, go for the room with a balcony. I travelled with my wife and 2 kids aged 2 and 4. no charge for my kids since they are just young and they shlept with us in our king bed. We really enjoyed our stay. The lobby is very welcoming and cozy. u dont even need to queue to checkin. They will approach u and bring u to a comfy lounge and serve u the kawha, a very nice tasting welcome tea. You will just sign the form after you drink your tea and thats it, you’re already checked in. Great start after a tiring connecting flight from Delhi. 

It has a very nice and intricate interior design. Tha staff are very friendly. Special mention to Sohail and also Hamid. They are like friends already during our 3 days stay. They are very nice to us and treated us like we knew each other already. made our stay quite memorable. We even has a picture together before we left the place. We love the swimming pool my kids love to swim and since it is winter, it is a  plus to have a heated pool. I think this is the only hotel in the area with heated pool. They also have an indoor play area that our kids enjoyed. However, it is not well maintained and a bit dark. I am also not confident to leave my kids there because just outside the play room is a door leading to the outside area and no staff or security personnel guarding the door. 

The restaurant has a very nice view. There is also a hug balcony where outside the lounge area where the guests can stay and enjoy the snow without leaving the hotel premises. Food is nice, since we are not locals, it is great to have a few options for western food. My kids cannot take spicy foods yet and curry. that is a huge plus for us. The only thing that I think they can improve is to add more variety for breakfast. I am expecting more variety for this price range. Also no western food except for the omelette. Almost all food in the breakfast are local foods. Not a big deal for many I guess but since we have kids, it was a bit of a problem for us. And at this price range aroud 400usd/night, food variety should be much better. But overall, it was truly an amazing place and we had a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Rohini Leekha
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful. Experience right from check in to the last date was amazing. Beautiful and serene surroundings. The view from our Himalayan view room was totally worth it. We were lucky to experience snowfall and admire the beauty right from the balcony of our room.

The service is excellent too. Qadir from housekeeping was very helpful and ensured our stay was comfortable. The staff at breakfast was also very nice. Basically the people there go out of their way to help you. 

Simply loved the overall experience. A must visit especially during winters. Will definitely visit in summers too for a totally different experience.

reviews.author: sanket s
reviews.title: amazing resort to chill
reviews.text:
this places amazing to visit in gulmarg. will all beautiful amenties and services.
It has any amazing view which makes the holiday more beautiful...
he staff at the resort treated us very well. They were extremely friendly and accommodating with everything. Thank you for keeping the hotel very clean and taking excellent care of your guests! The food at breakfast is delicious.

reviews.author: mvinayak
reviews.title: Sweet memories@khalida
reviews.text: I believe I haven't seen a more beautiful property and hospitality than the Khyber. From the ambience of the place to the food ,everything was beyond excellence. All thanks to miss khalida, she was there with us from our check in and till the end. She made sure at every moment that our stay was pleasant and comfortable. Hoping to come back soon to this beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: NavyaBharath
reviews.title: Great Hotel with Greater Views and Hospitality
reviews.text: We stayed at Khyber from Feb 24th-27th and the experience we had is something that words can’t describe....right from airport pickup, room, food, views... everything was excellent. Our 3.5 year old had a great time playing in the snow...This place is actually a Jewel of Gulmarg. Take the Himalayan view rooms with balcony to wake up to the mesmerising view of himalayas from your balcony. The staff is very attentive. Undoubtedly the best place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Meghnasg
reviews.title: A great family hotel...
reviews.text:
We booked the Khyber and ever since I was full of skepticism. I had seen various reviews here on trip advisor regarding poor food or service etc etc.
Hence I went (along with my husband and 2 daughters- 8yo and 3yo) with an open mind. 
I must say we were in for a lovely surprise. The moment we entered the property (which was very warm - literally - thanks to the massive heating facilities) , we were given a more than warm welcome by Mr. Sohail. This made us feel very welcome and absolutely at home. We had booked a 1 bedroom cottage which Is a little away from the reception (but connected to the main building via the corridors). The room was very warm and toasty! It was snowing outside and we could move around the entire hotel in shorts!  
Rooms- 
We booked the one bedroom cottage. It had a living room, a bathroom and a small maid’s room in the ground floor with a small verandah opening into the gardens. The top floor was a very spacious bedroom with a huge balcony with breadth taking views. The bathroom was very clean, well equipped and heated! 

Food-
All the food was above average. We tried south Indian, Chinese, Italian and Indian cuisine. The breakfast spread was endless with live South Indian and egg counters. With freezing temperatures and such hostile weather, we must appreciate the fact that each and every ingredient that goes into preparation of the food is brought from the plains ( Srinagar mostly). And I think they are doing a fabulous job serving delicious and piping hot meals. 

- The heated pool is a must visit but it does get very crowded in peak season 
- the pool area has  lovely heated jacuzzis, steam and sauna too
- ‘chaikash’ serves free Kashmiri kawah (very delicious 😋) along with some lovely bakery preparations and snacks
- the spa is very good and must visit
- all postpaid mobile networks work in entire Gulmarg including the level 1 gondola place 
- liquor is not served in the hotel ( infant it’s born served anywhere in Gulmarg). However, you may carry your own drinks.
- beware of the guides and touts waiting outside the hotel. They are all cheats. Please do a thorough research on trip advisor and book in advance.
- we did skiing and loved ‘discover Gulmarg adventures’ run by Irfan and his very talented team. 
- the entire staff from the hotel waiters ( Junaid in particular ), housekeeping staff , restaurant managers etc were all very very warm and considerate. 

Only few pointers that I hope the hotel looks into -
-We saw lots of families with kids , but the property could be a little more kid friendly. The play area needs urgent upkeep. Some more activities need to be introduced.

Overall a super family vacation - we shall definitely visit again.

reviews.author: GyanVerma
reviews.title: Average stay, poor hospitality and over hyped
reviews.text:
I booked my stay through MMT with Booking ID: NH2003371406165
I feel Khyber is an overhyped resort due to absence of the other 5 star resorts in Gulmarg.
Location wise: It is good but what I noticed that you get similar views from other hotels in the Gulmarg also.
Room: Wooden work was nicely done, so rooms are good.
Check-in experience:  It seemed ok however what I despise is the fake accent of people, It does not go well with me anyways no major issues with this.I am thankful they allowed early check-in around 10:30 AM.
Food: Dinner buffet for 2.5K+Taxes was not at all worth , it did not taste well at all.
Breakfast: There was an incident regarding breakfast, the hot milk they were serving had gone bad and none of the staff seemed to notice that, I went to fetch some milk for my daughter and realised it had gone bad, I had brought this issue to their notice but did not get any apology for this oblivion behaviour and suddenly the manager was hard to locate, did not expect this kind of behaviour from so called "5 start resort".
Amenities: Swimming pool was good as generally you would not get swimming pool next to snow or mountains. Full marks in that front.
Checkout: The day we checked out It was our anniversary and I had communicated that at the time of check-in also but nobody cared to wish us. Anyways there was another thing that really made me feel embarrassed and I never got treated this way ever, it goes like this :During checkout the housekeeping guy came in to room to take feedback , I filled the feedback form, At reception while I was settling the bills ,the front office guy “Burhaan” asked me did I take any item from the minibar, “I said No” , so even after me saying No he called somebody and asked him to go and check in the room , this really made me feel bad, I had stayed in many luxury hotels but never ever somebody was so blatant in verifying the minibar items, I am not saying he should not have checked , what I feel is that either he should have done that surreptitiously  or should not have even asked me, When you would like to verify it by sending some person (it is done in lower grade hotels) then do not ask the guest you should do it with secrecy. I suggest Front office to be little careful in these situations anyways apart from this "Burhaan" did ask to give us a complimentary cake at midnight for our Anniversary, which we refused as we were very much tired that day, although I did ask for room decoration which he said would not be possible as they need to be informed 1 week before about this and also it was chargeable 2.5K+takes.

Anyways after average stay at Khyber we checked-in to Vivanta ByTaj-Srinagar and what an awesome treatment and service they had delivered, at least 7-8 staff members had greeted us, gave us complimentary upgrade, cake and nicely decorated our room with flowers and balloons.
I hope soon any other 5 star resort gets opened in Gulmarg, maybe then over hyped Khyber improves their service.
Advice to management: Good resorts/hotels are not only made up with  fancy architecture or building but also with cordial and smart staff also with good service.
Invest in your staff and get them trained well as I felt most of the staff is local and lack global exposure.

reviews.author: Punjabisanjay
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: We went for a 3 night stay to Gulmarg and stayed in this amazing resort . wonderful perfect weather . it was walking distance from the cable car ride and we had a blast on the snow Mobiles . It snowed on the 2nd day and we played in the snow . Amazing feeling to see the snow all around you . The hotel staff is very very polite and go out of their way to please you . Manzoor , Mukesh , khaleeda all of them are exceptional hosts . Super good food served in the restaurant though slightly on the expensive side . They are generous in serving yummy kavha  tea throughout our stay . It's a magical experience to play in the snow . Would love to go again . Truly the Switzerland of India .

reviews.author: Yuni27
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text:
This definitely is the best Resort in the whole of Gulmarg Area,the views are wonderful from the rooms,an absolute 5 star ski resort!
The heated swimming pool is fantastic,the pool is REALLY heated and the views from the pool are dream like!

reviews.author: harin raval
reviews.title: Truly Great Himalayan Experience.
reviews.text: A great Resort nestled between snow clad Himalayas in one of the most amazing place on earth, Gulmarg. A world full of hospitality. Amazingly efficient staff whose aim is to provide the best of services be it in Restaurants or Room Service. I would suggest that they add a Bar and Hospitality desk which would take care of sight seeing tours and bookings for Gandolas and Helicopter Rides as well as Ski Instructors to facilitate tourists to have one window option to make most of their holidays. Their packed lunches or snacks are awesome. I would suggest booking of Himalayan view rooms which offer the most scenic and breath taking views of snow clad slopes and mountain peaks. The Hotel maintains the most efficient standards of house keeping cleanliness and responding to needs of guests. Their Loungue serves amazing Hookahs. Their Spa also offers amazing treatments by a wekk trained staff. A must visit Resort

reviews.author: bachher s
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text:
What a lovely place to stay!
Was a great experience, location just perfect, good cooperative staff, delicious food, good massage experience. 
Loved the place, highly recommended.
1 star less for the untidy pool. Sorry to the management but should take care.

reviews.author: drrganesh
reviews.title: Worth every rupee!
reviews.text:
Had heard a lot of good things about this property and so was on the bucket list for a family outing to Gulmarg.
About a 90 minute drive from Srinagar, its located within walking distance from the Gulmarg gondola , the main attraction of the place.
All rooms are well appointed with views either facing the golf course/meadow or the mountain ranges. Best option would be the ones with the balcony looking towards the mountains. 
Dining options within the property: Servings are on the smaller side. Rates  not so !!!
Breakfast options are excellent. 
Whats seals it for the property is the service- impeccable. Right from the front desk to the Ski room where all the jackets/ boots are store, everybody is out to please. 
Great option in Gulmarg especially during the "snow season " - Dec - March.

reviews.author: Gangadhar P
reviews.title: Luxury at a premium
reviews.text:
The hotel is top of the line.Jacuzzi here has seating which looked terrible arrangement.
Steam facility is very good and so is the heated pool.
The library could do with daily newspapers.
Food....spectacular,tasty and out of the world.Views are post card worthy.
I wish the Hotel arranges the guides to make the guests less prone to local exploitation.
enjoyed the visit and the stay.

reviews.author: Ranadhir74
reviews.title: Simply spectacular
reviews.text: This resort would make your trip to heavenly Gulmarg complete.An unparalleled location,extremely friendly staff,extremely comfortable rooms and astounding views make this one of the outstanding hotels of this country.A must-visit place and a must-visit hotel.

reviews.author: pbhagchandka
reviews.title: Top!
reviews.text: The service is extremely personal and the everything about the hotel is absolutely stunning. The spa is world class as well. The Indian food is absolutely delicious (can't say the same about other cuisines though). Still, can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: shruti s
reviews.title: assum trip till now my husband gave me
reviews.text: i had my 2nd marriage anniversary ,,and my husband took me to gulmarg as i wanted to be in snow and wanted to be in india ... as i landed in khyber it was next to heaven ... stafff superb , hospitality superb i havent seen such good 5 star resort in my life in india ...Saaquib from front office helped us a lot in all minute details even for things outside the resort ... khyber is a beautiful resort in itself .. i stayed there for 3 nights ... it was a wonderful experience Zzz food was very goood superb taste ... must visit in lifetime ... and for me again and again

reviews.author: MANOJAGARWALA
reviews.title: Amazing Holidaying
reviews.text: Just amazing is the only word. Delicious and well spread breakfast with very warm hospitality. Swimming experience in midst of ice mountain in heated swimming pool is an out of the world experience. Very comfortable stay. Need to go once again.

reviews.author: khurram
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: My first stay at Khyber Resort. Amazing location and superb interiors. Courteous staff backed up by prompt service. Mr Bashaarat,the manager at cloves and Tawheed and Ishfaq, the F and B assistants at Cloves made my trip memorable. Imran at sales and Kaiser from Finance department were of great assistance. Only suggestion from my side is to introduce wazwaan dishes in the Menu ( Buffet or Ala Carte ) Thanks for the lovely Honeymoon experience. Would love to visit again.

reviews.author: doshiketan
reviews.title: GULMARG-heaven on earth. KHYBER- heaven in heaven
reviews.text:
Stayed here from 16 to 21 march with friends on annual skiing trip. This was our second stay after last stay in feb 2016. There has been remarkable improvements in one year in attitude of entire khyber team towards guest satisfaction.

RESERVATIONS:
Our reservation was nicely handled by Mr Irshad and Wahid and all our needs were conveyed to concerned departments before our arrival.
RECEPTION:
Check in was smooth and welcome drink Kashmiri kahwa was excellent. They upgraded us to gulmarg view balcony room for nominal amount and Mr Manzoor escorted us to room and made sure that everything was as per our requirements. Luggage arrived in few minutes only. Special thanks to Mr Manzoor and his team members Parvez, Saquib, Ishfaq for making sure that our stay was comfortable and conveyed warm greetings whenever we passed through reception area.

HOUSEKEEPING:
Excellent thanks to Mr Abhishek and his team.

SWIMMING POOL/SPA:
It is highlight of khyber with best view you can ever get from any pool in world.

RESTAURANT:
Food & beverage and service at restaurant was major highlight of our stay thanks to Mr Bashrat and Mr Abid and his entire team - Sameer, Bilal, Showket Wani, Qadir, Ishfaq, Junaid, Showket Khan, Erfan and Saila. Exec chef Sharma and his team made sure that all our special needs and dietary requirements were met to perfection.

Except for wifi which is super slow and problem with water cleaning at swimming pool, our stay was most memorable thanks to warm and efficient service and attention by entire Khyber team. 

Will surely return back next winter.  Hope you keep up the spirit and continue to strive to improve as you have between our last 2 visits.

reviews.author: 84DeepsD
reviews.title: Fabulous outing resort. ..
reviews.text: We were at this resort to celebrate our wedding anniversary.. The time we chose was the week it was snowing like hell and hence it was a very beautiful stay.. Hotel looked really nice and warm and cozy.. It had really great view from our room... Loved the hospitality here.. Asrar helped us with our room and on finding it was our anniversary he arrange a very tasty cake for us complimentary from the hotel.. We found that very delightful.. Food over here is very tasty and very quick room service.. Loved the staff here very polite and helpful.. They arranged for a very good driver and guide for us for sightseeing.. Liked where the hotel is situated right next to the gondola walking distance. Highly recommended this resort if visiting gulmarg...

reviews.author: Rushil Dedhia
reviews.title: Luxury & how!
reviews.text:
To have such luxury in a location like Gulmarg is brilliant. Hats off to the management for maintaining the property and providing excellent service & quality. Very courteous staff, amazing food at the restaurant, the indoor heated pool, the location, the luxury - in all makes this place just fabulous!
A suggestion - try to get a room facing the mountains, the view is much better.

reviews.author: Abhishek O
reviews.title: Great Stay and hospitality!!
reviews.text:
we were given a very warm welcome with a cup of khawa ( kashmiri tea ) by the hotel Executive Mr Asrar. He took care of most needs during our stay . Everytime we got back to the reception arae we were asked by Mr Asrar if we were comfortable and enjoying our  stay. They even surprised us by placing a cake in our room when we returned post dinner as he saw that we were a newly married couple. 

i recommend a saty or if one cant get a stay they should atleast go for a meal to the restaurant to enjoy authentic kashmiri cusine.

Asrar is an asset to the resort and is doing an exceptional job of taking care of the guests needs with a smile always.

reviews.author: zorbathetraveller
reviews.title: super awesome stay
reviews.text:
First thing first - The property is very comfortable and beautiful. Staff is very very helpful friendly and always smiling. Buffet spread is limited and not like any other 5 star hotel where u get plenty of options. However food is very tasty. 

Cons:- 
1. The passage towards Spa is not centrally heated so in winters all of sudden it feels super chilled. 
2. The property is situated on height and its quite a walk from ground. Being a luxury hotel they should provide a pick up at least from the ground.
3. Earlier they  used to give complimentary Kahwa in lobby which they have stopped now. 

But overall this hotel is worth staying.

reviews.author: Ayushiparikh
reviews.title: Nice hotel ,good food
reviews.text:
We were suggested by a few people that khyber is a must go while in gulmarg. Since we were in gulmarg just for a day trip we planned to have lunch at khyber.
We got pretty late by the time we reached khyber for lunch but they agreed to serve us lunch. That was really nice of them
The views from the hotel restaurant and coffee shop were beautiful! All snow covered ! Must visit!

reviews.author: Mehul D
reviews.title: Beyond expectations!!!!
reviews.text:
About Khyber,
Stayed at Khyber from 05th March to 08th March 2017
Its the best 5 star property in Gulmarg in terms of location, rooms, food and other amenities(pool, jacuzzi, spa, kids play area etc..)
Staff from the managers to the reception guys to restaurant staff to security guys..everyone is really well trained,helpful and ready to help always.

About Gulmarg,
Heaven on earth. Gondola ride and other snow activities on top of the hill are amazing.
Hiring a guide will be helpful.
Javid(contact details:7006124188,9622716814) is one of the best guide for Gulmarg. He knows the place really well, will arrange for your transport, pick up & Drop, site seeing,gondola tickets and other snow activities.
Also he will get everything done at much lower rate compared to other tour operators.

reviews.author: Ravi C
reviews.title: Gulmarg is God's Paradise
reviews.text: Gulmarg is just superb. Natural beauty is out of this world. Simply breathtaking views. And in this God's paradise is this beautiful hotel. Amazingly beautiful property. We took a luxury balcony room and it offered superb views. Luckily it was snowing when we checked in. Hotel provides excellent views of the natural beauty all around. The staff is attentive and very courteous. Took really good care of us. Food was good. Everything was really excellent in this hotel. Even when the temp outside was -12, we hardly felt it in hotel. Will again stay in this property. We just found couple of drawbacks. Nothing serious but deserves mention so they may take measures to correct it. The mattress is too soft and it gave me a back issue. The toiletries in bathroom were only for 1 person and not 2 especially when 2 ppl had checked in. The driver Aijaz which hotel had given us to drop us in Srinagar insisted that if we want to buy authentic Kashmiri stuff, we should stop at this particular shop some way before Srinagar. Since I was having a back pain issue because of mattress, I asked him to take us directly to Srinagar at our hotel Lalit. It seemed as if he did not liked us not stopping at this particular shop because after that he drove really fast and reckless and I had to ask him to slow down repeatedly. It was as if we had done something wrong by not listening to his advice for stopping mid way at his recommended shop. May be there was a commission involved or whatever. But next time when we visit this property, I am going to make sure that I don't get this driver again.

reviews.author: Sarvesh K
reviews.title: Skiing in Gulmarg.
reviews.text: Hotel was amazing.. The best I have stayed at.. Amazing location, food and service. Irfan was my skiing instructor super fun and friendly. Managed to ski down phase 1 on my third day.. Loved every bit of it and would highly recommend Irfan-7298752895.

reviews.author: Rohini B
reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text: The most wonderful hotel in India. Fantastic location , wonderful service and friendly staff. The hotel is surrounded by the mountains of the Himalayas...... beauty as never seen before! It's a once in a lifetime experience...... unforgettable!

reviews.author: shimauli
reviews.title: Holiday with the kids
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is beautiful and a must must visit. Khyber is a great hotel, conveniently located. We went when it was freezing end February 2017 but the hotel is centrally heated so it wAs fine. 

The Khyber swimming pool is fabulous and the kahwa kept me warm enough :) they don't serve any liquor in the hotel so make sure you bring your own, you won't get any shops in Gulmarg for liquor! 

Rooms are nice and cozy, bkfast is elaborate, we took our girls along 5years and 5 mnths old. Both loved it! 

Staff was friendly and courteous ! And they have the fastest room service across hotels in india that Weve visited :) 

It was snowing, and we did snow biking sledging and skiing took the gondola to 1st stage it worked out great . We had A good guide and taxi guys were great too! 

Make sure you spend enough nights if you want to learn skiing:) 

All in all great experience ! Good value for money and wasn't so crowded when we went always a good thing 😀

Happy holidays 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Sumita
reviews.title: When in Gulmarg, it is must to visit Khyber either stay or just to have lunch!
reviews.text: We were at Khyber for 2 nights and 3 days during the last few days of February 2017. The location of the hotel is a dream place. Located at the hill top in the Pir Panchal range and the hotel is stuffed with all latest amenities.  Hotel people are very warm and gentle. Room service is very efficient. My 5 yr old son enjoyed to the fullest …it’s a hotel for all age groups right from kids, to young bachelors, to honeymoon couple, to family peope, to senior citizen. The only thing which pinches is their pick and drop to-from Srinagar Airport which is Rs. 4000/- one way which could be Rs. 2000/-. Accept for Breakfast, Wifi, and welcome drink Kawah nothing is complimentary at Khyber (Lol) and if you still want to enjoy in free, you will need to be a child..the hotel does not charge anything for child. The reservation desk is very rude and rigid, no matter whatever is your problem or how good negotiator you are, they have things set which they will never come down to.  But whatever is the negative you will forget everything when you see the snow covered mountains and the pine trees smiling at you and welcoming you. A very good place to stay with the best view and you feel safe and secure. Each and every person at Khyber is very good and caring. With small kids it is one of the best place to stay in Gulmarg. I will defintly recommend Khyber.

reviews.author: Purvi S
reviews.title: Fantastic experience!!!
reviews.text: It was amongst the few best experiences... everything we needed was a call away... everything was perfect! After a long day at the slopes we would look forward to returning and getting spoilt by their always smiling hospitality... highly recommend it to all... Thank you Khyber. Will definitely come back soon....

reviews.author: bahoorani
reviews.title: Snow ! Luxury and hospitality
reviews.text:
One of the nest hotels of kashmir we were lucky to have snowfall for the 4 days we stayed there staff is pleasant. Special thanks to mr asrar he was very helpful and informative.
Heated pool is amazing and the view throughout is breath taking
They serve sheesha but no alcohol so carry your own.

reviews.author: 912nitins
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is undoubtedly one of the best hotels that Iv stayed in , in India .
The hotel staff is extremely responsive.
Upon checkin we were served Kahwa tea which was wonderful.

Our room had a wonderful  view as well.

I am definitely coming back again , and Khyber would be my choice of hotel .

reviews.author: Travel With Dee
reviews.title: Must Visit! Great place
reviews.text: We were visiting Gulmarg for the first time and couldnt have thought of a better place than Khyber! The rooms, the spa and the pool - these 3 are enough to make your decision! Service is fantastic, very friendly staff!  The food was good, however french fries could be a bit better (Since thats one of the things you want to binge eat on) breakfast spread is good too.. Sincere request and recommendation to the staff - please have nutella with your waffles!!!

reviews.author: Ranchi_doc
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth ..
reviews.text: the hotel really deserves its place in the best of the best ! amazing view especially in winters . the place is actually submerged in snow ..breath taking views straight from the room .. the service is superb . food is good considering its a boutique hotel.. staying here is a lifetime experiance . deserves to be in the hotels to visit before you die ..

reviews.author: pknrajasthan
reviews.title: Spectacular place to stay in snow
reviews.text:
What can I say about gulmarg and this little hotel set ambist the mountains and deodhar trees ..

Truly kashmiri wooden architecture 
Service with a smile 
All rooms have beautifull views 
The swimming pool is heated and indoor and gives a wow feel with its glass walls thorugh which u can see the snow 

After the somewhat tiring day at gondola the spa is a nice feature to have ..

Overall a wonderfull stay

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling
reviews.text:
We booked our rooms 6 months in advance through the hotel portal. You maybe surprised as the moment you put in your credit card details it will charge your card immediately without asking your pin or any other details. Looked like a off shore account transaction. Scary for a moment.
We traveled in a large group during the 3rd week of March. Its during this time Gulmarg received the highest snowfall of the season. The result was the drive way to the Khyber had snow and cars could not travel up or down resulting in a nightmare to get to the hotel.
We took nearly 2 hours to reach the hotel from the bottom of the drive way. It was very chaotic and Khyber management had no clue as a large number of guests were stuck down. Calls to the hotel would just end up to an answering machine.
We finally walked up with young children and there was no one at the door to greet us. We had to beg the reception to send a car down to pick other guests and our baggage. Overall it was total CHAOS.

Once in the room, we had to wait for an hour for our bags to arrive.

Without doubt the resort is very well located and is very picturesque. The rooms are comfortable and ours had a very good view of the valley.

We were on a 5 day ski holiday. However, we wasted more than an hour everyday to get our ski's etc. from the storage room. Our gear was marked but yet its a task finding your gear.
The major let down was the task to get to and fro Khyber. Most of the taxis would not make the journey up the slope and the hotel cars were not allowed to drop the guests to baby slope. Often cars would get stuck in the narrow drive way and there would be a massive jam. Every day we were fleeced just to go up and down the drive way. Anything from Rs. 600 - 1000 per ride per car. ATV's would charge anything around 600 from the bottom of the hill.
After a long day on the slopes it was a let down to deal with this on a daily basis.
The hotel concierge has no answer or a way out of this. They said they were having issues with the taxi union of Gulmarg and they could not help it. Also, they did not have enough cars incase you wanted to hire a hotel car for the day.

The room was very comfortable. However, the wall where the TV console is placed is made up of  particle board. The adjacent room's TV console is on the same wall as ours. It means that one could very clearly hear TV from the adjoining room. How BIZZARE!!! We would retire to bed early but could not sleep as the TV in the adjoining room would not shut till late in the night. We checked this in all our rooms and it was the same story. Every evening we had to politely ask the hotel staff to ask our neighbours to reduce the TV volume.

The food is decent but the buffet breakfast is pretty average.

The heated swimming pool and jacuzzi is super. We were warned about some tiles being chipped in the pool. 

Its a mixed feeling for us as the resort is beautiful and the rooms are comfortable but there is a lot of stress related with the stay. We are unsure if we will stay again unless there is a huge improvement. 

As of now we are left disappointed!

reviews.author: Shwetasree
reviews.title: Does not live up to the hype
reviews.text:
When we were driving up to Khyber I was skeptical. The steep cobblestone driveway covered with black ice was treacherous to say the least and our Toyota Innova was not equipped to do the climb. We called the hotel who asked us to essentially go figure. Disappointing for a property of this nature. Taxis just below were making a killing charging guests Rs. 600 to take them up 300 metres.
The entrance was impressive and the lobby is awe inspiring. Check in was smooth and the staff (both at the reception and the restaurant) were super nice to us throughout our stay - attentive, polite, friendly and helpful.
We spent the initial hour or so soaking in the stunning views and then eventually it hit me - the noise. I will not be exaggerating if I say that this is the noisiest mountain resort that I've ever been to. At nearly 400 USD a night (for a basic room - mine!) that's a big shocker and an immediate thumbs down for the place. The lobby is a veritable fish market - the place seems to attract (and unfortunately encourage) loud patrons. The bar opens into the lobby and the raucousness wafts into the resto as well which is a chaotic melee of loud folks and running children. They appear to have kept all the staff hanging around the lobby to service the steady stream of guests (with the late snowfall this year, the place seems full even in March) with the result that housekeeping completely sucks. For every little thing much follow up was needed.
But the worst is yet to come...paper thin room walls. I am writing this at midnight - second midnight in a row when I am waiting for my neighboring room to get done with their film watching so I can sleep. After a long day at the slopes I have resigned myself to less than 7 hours of sleep AGAIN! I knocked on their door and requested a reduction of TV volume but realised that it wasn't that high in the first place. 
Safety concerns - swimming pool had a broken tile and a kid cut her finger badly in front of me...
The L'Occitane Spa was very average - the therapists didn't do such a great job - yes I gave them positive reviews at the time but came back to the room to a lower back pain that aggravated over the course of the night.
They're killing it because of the lack of competition but honestly the place needs to do more about "the experience".

reviews.author: pawanlakhotia
reviews.title: Very nice location
reviews.text: The hotel is very nicely located in the centre of Gulmarg very close to Gandola may not be more than 300 mtrs. The food  in the restaurant was good but hotel rooms were just OK compared to its very high price.

reviews.author: ra1189
reviews.title: Worth a stay!
reviews.text:
A wonderful hotel wit great views, great staff and great food as well! The day we stayed at the hotel, there was an amazing snow shower and the views from the hotel were just breathtaking. The spa and the swimming pool are worth giving a go. Everything was perfect except the heating was not really proper in some areas of the hotel - some areas were really cold. 

Avoid room 6005 in cold weather as the bathroom has no heating and it was really really cold in there.

reviews.author: Rajneesh J
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and very well located at the centre. Enjoyed our stay thoroughly. Had a wonderful and luxurious stay. The amenities were too good. Just one word, expand restaurant area as in the morning it was too crowded and could not relish that...overall a great and pleasurable stay.

reviews.author: Aptraveler10
reviews.title: Amazing place fantastic experience
reviews.text: We stayed for a week in March and were very impressed by the quality of service at this hotel. The hotel was completely packed with large families and it snowed continuously for 4 dayes but the service remained excellent . Rooms are very well maintained , hot water , heating services continued uninterrupted , the staff is very friendly and helpful. The spa, pool, facilities are great. Wonderful place .

reviews.author: Shabeer S

reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL!!!
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Gautam73
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.text: We visited the Khyber in Feb 2016 and loved it. It was our first visit to Gulmarg and it turned it out to be amazing. Everything from the rooms, the food and the service were very good. The property is very well located and with very easy access to the ski slopes. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anybody planning to go.

reviews.author: Nitin A
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text:
Very good and luxurious hotel. The moment we stepped in the lobby, we were impressed with the lavishness of hotel. The hotel was very good!! Spa/ jacuzziwas very good! 
Service was exceptionally quick. Very impressed on that part. But not at the restaurant, where it was slow. 
Some lackings though - 
the kids play area was hardly anything.... The kind of hotel that Khyber is - a much better play area was expected!!
Restaurant - Kashmiri food served was not authentic, the service not very prompt. The staff at restaurant seemed to be bit unwelcoming kinds as compared to the staff at any other area of hotel. 
The concierge was hardly of any help to plan day trips!! 
But all these shortcomings were overlooked by the beauty of gulmarg and the hotel itself. Having a dip in warm pool, with views of snow all around was a heavenly experience. 
Definitely an expensive property, but then it's a lavish one!!
If it fits in budget, don't look anywhere else in gulmarg!!

reviews.author: Bhavna2016
reviews.title: Warm hospitality, tasty food, and a lovely pool !
reviews.text: Nice hotel with simple tasty food and warm service from all staff especially Ishfaq who made a special effort to make sure we were well looked after. Chef veer organised a delicious dinner for us for a special occassion. All our demands were happily met by Basharat and Jerin whether it was F and B or housekeeping. Memorable trip in all thanks to the staff at khyber. The pool and spa were lovely and heated perfectly to make you forget the cold outside!

reviews.author: Jayant_333
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text:
It is expensive.....It is an absolute must! It is beautiful and must include in your itinerary. 
If you can afford the stay ....go ahead! Splurge! The rooms are nice. The view is to die for! The indoor pool is good! The hospitality is great! The sit outs are awesome!
But, what do you do when you are on a budget?? Go there for an evening tea! Enjoy their delicious Khawa and biscuits! Enjoy their view! Behave nice and come back ;)

reviews.author: parsvakumar
reviews.title: Khyber , Gulmarg
reviews.text: Nice hotel , Brilliant ambience ,good facility for the children to play indoors, nice spa and heated indoor swimming pool ,useful in all seasons. Sad part is limited food variety , only one restaurant . Very nice facility to keep your extra clothes and footwear for snow in the security area without having to carry it to your room .

reviews.author: ShehreyaarDar
reviews.title: Stupendofabulious!!!
reviews.text: Awsome place & amazingly built up. Infra is outstanding & so is F&B. Need a place to relax & chil;, try Khyber. Spcl thnx To Ishfaq Shah for amazing Service. CLose in the lap of nature. Seee ya soon Khyber.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
Khyber is a nice resort, but not worth the money.
We booked directly for 3 persons, accepted the rate, but when we arrived we were told we had to pay additional 3000 rs for extra bed as the rate was only for double room even I think we already had paid enough.
We raised it to the reservation manager, but no help here.
Our room on the ground floor was extreme noisy, both from the neighbouring room as well from the corridor, so we contacted the reception first day, but they weren't able to help. Same the next day after very limited sleep, but were again told, they had only a small basement room available, which would be too small for 3 of us.
3rd day, we were pretty tired after 2 nights with little sleep, we asked to meet the Hotel Manager. He wasn't available, but would come in later. 
Eventually we met, and he was fully aware about the problem with noise in the rooms as so many are complaining !!
He would try to sort something out. Which he actually did later in the evening, so we shifted to a 2nd floor room.
Food is basic indian, taste fine, but not exciting,  not up to 4 or 5 * standard. 

Not cheap :say 950 rs for a Club sandwich., but when you stay at khyber, you better be prepared to pay for everything : bed 3000 rs, soft drink 250 rs., tea and cake 650 rs, internet 750 rs per day, all plus taxes 
The 500 meter taxi ride down or up the steep hill side to the road from the hotel can be negotiated down to 3-400 rs.  
 .

reviews.author: Gayathri P
reviews.title: Bliss
reviews.text: It was wonderful being there. Enjoyed the peace and tranquillity. I cannot forget the hospitality offered by the staffs. A good menu which is a treat to your appetite. We were lucky to witness the snow fall. The hotel facilities, swimming pool and spa were excellent. Looking forward to visiting the resort again.

reviews.author: riaznagree
reviews.title: One of the best hotels in the world.

Thanks

reviews.author: Escape392043

reviews.text: I travelled from NYC to stay in this place for only one night...but what a place. amazing hospitality, great food, great rooms with 5 star service. walking distance from all the facilities in Gulmarg including the Gondola. Would like to visit here again with more time,

reviews.author: BHMDUDE
reviews.title: Khyber#Snow#Location#View
reviews.text: What a location . A luxury resort in the lap of nature. Snow everywhere. Service is good. Only downside is food. Food prices are too high. INR 150 for one roti. Apart from food everything else was great. A must stay in gulmarg. Gondola is very close to the resort. Resort was fully covered in snow when we visited i.e. 22/03/2015. reviews.author: nimeshshahdr
reviews.title: snowbound at gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed at khyber recently for 2 nights and we were amazed at the quality of service and food at a place which is difficult to access as we were with 4 to 5 ft of snow.The kids love it as there were ample activities for them once back at the resort. .
