reviews.author: udayan28decmaroo
reviews.title: A most scenic property
reviews.text:
A classy architecture has been created at scenic hilly terrain. The various facilities offered are well thought out and managed.
Food at the restaurant offers delicious varieties for all the meals. The staff I found to be most hospitable and cultured befitting the hardware it offers. Sure to revisit!

reviews.author: dagamanoj
reviews.title: A memorable trip to Gulmarg
reviews.text: I along with my wife and our 2 grandchildren visited Gulmarg in 2nd week of March,2015 and stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa. The resort is so wonderful and the location is awesome. The breakfast menu is excellent and the quality of food overall is excellent. The staff are very courteous and very helpful. The first floor room with balcony is most sought of. By luck we had snowfall during our stay and it was so lovely. Even though it was so cold outside, but inside the hotel due to central heating, the temperature was pleasant.It is 5 star property well maintained

reviews.author: ArianPranav
reviews.title: Heaven in snow, but bit costly...
reviews.text: We went there with a group of 3 families during January and stayed for three days. Though the resort is on costly side but at such a high altitude its tuff to offer such 5 star stuff. There is indoor pool of warm water and there are ample games for kids including two X-box. They have dedicated 1-2 SUV which can take you to Gondola (rope-way) ride. They provide rubber boots for guests including kids while they want to enjoy playing in snow. Food was having lot of variety and offerings were nice. Buffet is served for breakfast, lunch and dinner which have ample options. Since it was snowing outside so remained indoor most of the time. Overall the resort is centrally heated which makes it convenient for elders and kids for most of the time while outside the temperatures are in minus. They offer kahwa as welcome drink which make you indulge in Kashmiri spirits….

reviews.author: Sundeep H
reviews.title: Great hotel in an awesome location
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel with all the good things you expect from a five-star rated property. Especially liked the hot pool with fantastic views, and the authentic Kashmiri food that's among the best I've had. However, there was one serious problem - the rooms have very poor sound proofing... one can clearly hear what's going on in the next room. That can be a deal-breaker for some..

reviews.author: Nils Ola B
reviews.title: Great hotel with fantastic service
reviews.text:
Great hotel with fantastic service and nice spa. Close to ski lifts and Monkey Hill for those randonee trips on a bad weather day. Although, most visitors are less interested in ski (I honestly do not get why they are visiting Gulmarg in winter time other than staying at a good hotel). Food is good as well, although you get kind of tired of the buffet on the fourth day... 
I miss a small bar where those after ski beers can be bought. And naturally, a glass of read wine with my curry would also be nice:)

reviews.author: suja1322
reviews.title: Snow oasis
reviews.text: I went in early March with group of friends and we were totally mesmerised with the location and kashmiri interior. The swimming pool and spa were amazing. However the food in restaurant was below the expectation and we could find much better food at other hotels in Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Sandeep_Raturi
reviews.title: Loved my stay here  !
reviews.text:
Loved my stay at the hotel. 

You can't beat the location. Simply one of the best Hill Resorts in India. New hotel but built in a style that gives its Lobby a Heritage and classy look. A lot of wood work in the hotel. Framed photographs (depicting Kashmiri culture) are used as artwork instead of paintings. Rooms are carpeted, fairly spacious (350 sq ft) and offers stunning views of the pine trees and slopes. I visited during the heaviest snowfall and the views were surreal. The pool area is very good and looks amazing with wild pine trees just behind the glass wall. Play area to keep the kids busy. Wifi is chargeable and so is the mini Theatre. 

The staff at the hotel is predominantly Kashmiris and this I personally think is highly commendable  as employment to locals is the necessary component of Eco Tourism. 
The check-in at the hotel was smooth and quick. We were given a hot cup of 'Kahwa' in the coffee lounge and by the time we finished our drink, the keys were ready and we were escorted to the room not by a porter but by a smart front office executive himself. Room service is prompt and orders were ready in no time. I waited for only 15 minutes for the Dinner to be served in the room. However the quality of service is not uniform as one would expect from a luxury hotel. The dinner plates were not cleared till my check-out next morning. This is unimaginable for a luxury resort.  More training is required for the staff especially at the restaurant. During breakfast, I had to ask for water and tea/coffee. In a Luxury resort and for that matter in any good hotel/resort, it is expected from the waiters to keep a tab on the tables and fill/refill glass of water even before the guests ask for it. I asked for a glass of water and I was given one and still the water was not served to my family which is nothing but a  lackadaisical attitude of the service staff.  But these are minor glitches and I am sure it will improve with times. 
Bathrooms are spacious with bathtub, shower cubicle and a transparent window that separates it from the bedroom. If the blinders are up, you can enjoy the view of the pine trees from the bathtub itself. Wooden blinders looks good but messy to operate. If I start nitpicking, I would be tempted to say that the WC shower appears tacky and very low quality.
The food is said to be highlight of the hotel. I am a vegetarian and not a foodie so can't comment much on it but have heard very good things about the food at this hotel. One should know that there is NO BAR at the hotel so one must come prepared with his stuff packed. There is a nice Cigar lounge for the smokers. 

I work for a travel company and overall I find it a very nice resort which I can easily recommend to my clients. I loved my stay in the hotel.

reviews.author: Jas L
reviews.title: An oasis amongst breath taking beauty...
reviews.text:
The hotel gets 5 stars just for location and view on first impressions...
But once I checked in the comfort, size of room and the breath taking view of the himalayas covered in snow earned it's value for the expensive room...
The kaishmiri food was amazing...must try the wahzawan.

reviews.author: Mamta M
reviews.title: Winter wonderland - fabulous views and very comfortable hotel.
reviews.text: We stayed in the Himalayan view rooms and had the most amazing views of the mountains. The hotel was very comfortable - fully heated and very nice rooms. The service was very good even though the hotel was totally full. The restaurant staff went out of their way to serve a Kashmiri vegetarian thali which was not even on the menu.

reviews.author: Prateek_Rungta
reviews.title: A must stay when in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights at Khyber in the month of February 2015. Excellent location, great property. Very close to the gandola and other ski places. The lobby and restaurants have a great ambiance. Rooms are well done but slightly small. The balconies & common areas have decent views - we had 2 feet of snow inside the balcony and a blanket of white all around.
The staff is very helpful - bell boys, front desk, security and housekeeping.
However, at approx INR 21000 per night may not be quite value for money.
Overall, great experience and would highly recommend it to first time visitors to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: A.k
reviews.title: Great property, but lacks personalised service.
reviews.text:
Brilliant property in a brilliant  location...has every comfort imaginable...and a fantastic spa. However, the hotel lacks personal touch that you find in most other five star hotels.

Sample this...  due to certain dietary restrictions we asked to speak with the chef (in the only restaurant that they have). We were told that he was too busy to even come out for 2 minutes. We asked again as the waiter could not understand our requirements. Again the same reply... 
I've made similar requests in most other hotels, and have never been refused! In fact, the chefs are usually really understanding and eager to cook something that I can eat. And of course, the waiters are better trained!

When I pay 18,000 for a hotel room, and upwards of 3000 per meal, I surely expect more personalised service, especially when it's related to dietary restrictions. 

May I add that the food in their only restaurant is fairly average and needs improvement and the dinner buffet is quite unpalatable.

reviews.author: Chandana S
reviews.title: A luxury resort with the most rude enviroment
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 3 days the staff right from booking the rooms and the spa and the room service... I couldn't understand how can they be so cold and arrogant.
We paid what they asked us and i guess we over payed for the service we got.
Its got the best location comfortable rooms comfortable approach and everything gets ruled out if the hospitality is worst. 
I wish they seriously look into this matter and do something about it.
We wish we could come back again but not for the same arrogance for sure

reviews.author: Vimal B
reviews.title: pay for 5 star and get facility of 7 star
reviews.text:
Location on hill top , mind blowing.Services &   facilities, everything superb.Amazing Panoramic view.Hotel surrounded by snow all around. Best experience.

Heated swimming pool 35* with wonderful spa reasonable priced..

Food as you want it, very good display in buffet. Jain Food available. .

Exceptional treatment.

To sum up we have traveled to many good properties including some luxury ones Kyber experience the best *************

reviews.author: Suzanna_stephens
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous
reviews.text: I visited the property in January this year and loved every bit of the experience. The fusion of authentic traditional Kashmiri culture with state-of-the-art facilities makes it a fantastic stay option. Of everything else that fascinates, the spa is truly an experience that is out of this world!

reviews.author: Naman49
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I visited srinagar during the winters and I don't think there is any hotel/resort better than khyber. The location is on the hill top so you can get amazing panoramic views from every room. Only minus is alcohol is not sold there so you have to bring your own but other than that its a 5 star resort.

reviews.author: ashajainDelhi
reviews.title: Jannat!
reviews.text: Location, service, facilities n ambience , everything is superb about this place! Would certainly love to visit again, this time in summers! Just a request to the concierge to arrange the activities for the guests so they would not have to deal with guides and drivers outside and are confident that they are not cheated.

reviews.author: Petlifying
reviews.title: Experience Khyber in the winters at least once in a lifetime
reviews.text:
enjoyed the stay tremendously.... The cold outside and the lovely temperatures within. The big glass facades that give excellent views . Unforgettable experience. The warmth of the pool the bubbling jacuzzi, The spa experience (La Occitane) was just too great to explain 
Will definitely be here in the summers too .

reviews.author: rksharmadelhi2015
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed in Khybwer in Gulamrg but we wre disappointed with our stay. The hotel calls itsel;f a 5* deluxe property but does not have a Bar, the breakfast spread in average with no pork or ham. The views premier rooms are also average as compared to Highlands park which we happened to see during our visit. Overall a disappointing experience considering the amount they charge.

reviews.author: bestfood029
reviews.title: Heavenly Luxury.
reviews.text:
Better late than never writing a review :) So yes, you guessed it right , the completely justify the money that they charge from you and they are completely worth that bomb that you paid :). our one night stay at gulmarg was really beautiful cos the place is stunningly beautiful and maintained exceptionally well , the lobby is grand and the interiors are royal. the service is almost impeccable except the food wasnt as great as I expected. 
The rooms are large and so are washrooms , and the view from the balcony will make you feel like never to go back . the place is just a walk away from gondola and we drove for yummy north indian eat out for dinner which was also awesome ! Given a chance , I would certainly want to go back to be there and witness the white beauty again!

reviews.author: Niklesh M
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text:
Khyber Hotel stay was just like a dream. Perfect Location , Great Hospitality , The Best.

I would recommend this Hotel to one and all visiting Gulamrg. 

The staff was very Courteous and the best I have ever seen. Food was awesome, 

Wel done !,

reviews.author: Komalika
reviews.title: Something's don't stay the same
reviews.text: Last year we visited Khyber at the same time and had the most beautiful experience,not only because of the view and the gorgeousness of the place but more so because of the hospitality of the people in the hotel!!! The warmth with which the staff used to meet us everyday was more than over whelming !!! The general manager than was Mr Aditya and he made sure everyone there was made to feel at home!!! What warmth affection and care he showed for every single person in the hotel was unbelievable but unfortunately this time it didn't feel the same!!! Mr Aditya was not working with them anymore and I believe the management had changed and nthg felt the same it was all about talking business!!! It was a sad feeling to see such a huge difference in just one year!!! Right in between the mountains the feeling of being at home was lost and that's what u need in a place like that but unfortunately that couldn't be retained by them!!! I'm sure everyone who's been there before would know the difference I'm talking about.. That one man was the pillar of the hotel is what we realised on our this visit as his absence shook the entire effect around the full place!!!

reviews.author: AvyaP
reviews.title: Beautiful is the word
reviews.text: beautiful property with great indoor facility plus extremely mesmerizing surrounding. would recommend more for people either on honeymoon/ big group as there are lot of activities to do be done both indoor as well as outdoor

reviews.author: manakmoti
reviews.title: Excellent Resort in Himalayas
reviews.text:
I have visited this super luxurious resort in Gulmarg, Himalayas in 28 feb to 3 March 2015 with family & friends.
Excellent interior, luxurious rooms, suprb location, breath taking view of himalayas, and above all always smiling staff.
Forget Switzerland, every nature lover must visit this resort for atleast 3 nites during winters & enjoy snowfall.
Room Tarrifs are worth its luxury, location and service....  
And Rafiq I miss aroma of your hot Kahwa.....& smile.....
Rest assured Mr Herbert (GM), all my morning walk friends & many more family members will soon be there.....
A must visit resort for all snow & nature lovers....

reviews.author: Nupur R
reviews.title: Excellent Hospitality, Beautiful, Serene. A must Visit
reviews.text: We stayed in this beautiful resort for three nights from 24th till 26th February, and it was one of the most memorable holidays my husband and I ever had. The view from the hotel is  fantastic. The amenities available are excellent. The hotel staff Mr. Aman, Mr. Saptarshi and the entire team are wonderful and so helpful and friendly that any recommendations for them cannot be said in words. This place is a Paradise for people who love winters and love to ski, as all options are very close to the hotel This place is a must visit in winters. Would Highly recommend to friends and guests.

reviews.author: vishalforlife
reviews.title: Hotel location
reviews.text: This is one of the most amazing located hotels in India. more beautiful than Switzerland . I went in 7 feet snow still the hotel was fantastically well maintained. Just next to Gondola gate . Rooms have excellent view . It has a heated swimming pool throughout the year which itself is an achievement considering the temperatures in Gulmarg. the hotel GM Mr. Mata personally supervises everything. excellent food .Very nice staff and you are treated royally in the hotel. Big room and even bigger bathrooms make this an absolute delight to stay.

reviews.author: Pavel Z
reviews.title: Каталка в Гульмарге
reviews.text: Ездили в феврале катать в Гульмарг. Останавливались в этом отеле. Отличная и единственная 5 на горе! С плавательным бассейном, сауной. Отличная еда и обслуживание. В номерах всегда тепло) Единственный минус не продают никакой алкоголь, даже пиво(

reviews.author: Nilesh...
reviews.title: A lifetime experience
reviews.text:
I went there to celebrate the honeymoon. Got a lovely surprise by Hotel management, they upgraded my Rooms to Presidential Suit. 
What a response and service.... Enjoyed the snowfall, stay, service and off course the lovely weather/environment...

reviews.author: Ronit22765
reviews.title: Hospitality in true senses !!
reviews.text: Was amazed with the service provided by the staff. Personalized service makes u feel like a king. Talking about king, the lavish buffet spread is inreal senses a kings meal. Rooms are again lavishly decorated and very comfortable. View from the balcony makes u speak the magical word - HEAVEN. Hats of to the management for sophisticated handling of the property, further kudos to the manpower and training team for sourcing such elite staff. Best of luck. Definitely coming back !!

reviews.author: Shawmam
reviews.title: Mind blowing experience
reviews.text: I stayed in Feb wen it was snow all around and u Wed never feel a tinch of cold inside..the food isamazin as is d service.Wed come back agn to experience out of class service.all u need is to make an eye contact n u r treated like a prince

reviews.author: Hema I
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text: Excellent staff, food is great and the service is polite and timely. I would recommend trying the Kashmiri Firni and the Kashmiri traditional tea - Kehwa. The view from this hotel is breathtaking. Overall experience was memorable....We will come back to stay here again.

reviews.author: Shalini S
reviews.title: World Class Service
reviews.text:
Location is great, service staff is polite, enthusiastic and full of love. I have traveled more then 20 countries allover the world but must admit warmth in gulmarg was simply a life time experience. we were a family of 8 and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay, pool deserves a special mention, it's worth a time to leave nature and go for a swim.

Special thanks to mashood, bilal and yatin, they made our stay a life long memory, manuj was always there to ensure we do get what we got in the end. Only dampner was the transportation which was not as per the standards...

reviews.author: Travelbuff_A
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel, Pathetic Service!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 4 who stayed here in for three nights. The property is beautiful, and the rooms have a breathtaking view of the mountains. 

I would rate the hotel high on all parameters such as the rooms, ambience, spa and even the food. We received a very warm welcome from the staff when we arrived. When I stayed here the hotel was full, with only one restaurant serving food, you can imagine what a chaos would occur during breakfast and dinner time! The service was pathetic, you had to wait for a long time for tables, they refused to take reservations. they could not even offer the roti/paratha of our choice, and when they did it took them over 30 mins to serve. We saw guests even getting water for themselves. At no point was all the dishes in the buffet, they took forever to refill them.By far the worst service I have ever experienced. A huge disappointment. 

If you go to Khyber go the the fabulous property, the location, the view and the amazing ambience and rooms. The staff at the reception and concierge are extremely helpful.

reviews.author: salil
reviews.title: 5 star property, 2 star service
reviews.text:
The property is lovely. Beautiful setting and lovely facilities. 5 minute walk to the Gondola. The pool is one of the best I have ever seen, the the spa is lovely and the food is decent.  

The service levels are simply unacceptable for a hotel that is charging premium prices.  Wait times for  specialty coffee drinks during breakfast is upwards of 20 minutes possibly because they have maybe 1 expresso machine for the whole hotel. 

One of the hotel staff was rude to my friend and upon complaining to the hotel management was rude again in front of hotel management (in fact yelling at him for no fault of his). The situation was so bad that hotel management called security was called to handle their own staff member. We saw the same person an hour back on duty later serving coffee to hotel guests suggesting no action was taken by management and that they do not really care about how the staff talk to the guests. Very disappointing about the service and management handling of customer service given this incident.

Our  room came equipped with a sofa cum bed but apparently there is  a 3000 INR charge PER DAY for using the opening up the sofa bed and you using it  as an extra bed for a 4 year old child . There is no mention of this charge in the reservation or anywhere else so be aware of hidden charges. 

Awesome hotel location but service / policies need a ton of  work.  

Stayed in March 2014

reviews.author: Ajay_b04
reviews.title: Awesome property!!!
reviews.text:
This is the best stay i ever had!!! Location is fantastic and hospitality is beyond expectations. 

They even have Gym, temperature controlled swimming pool (for Adults as well as kids), Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam bath ...... and these all services are inclusive in your room tariff....

reviews.author: venilal
reviews.title: A beautiful property in hands of a horrible management
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property but is in the hands of horrible management. 
To start with the front desk staff bis the most Un cooperative and irresponsible. 
In spite of the written confirmation voucher for balcony room we were forced to take the premium room. On firm demand they gave us the balcony rooms. 
Out of 6 members that checked in only 3 guests photo ids were taken.
On the second day when we were to change the room to balcony room, all our contents were moved to other room without our consent. In the process our valuables which were lying in the room safe were left as is and the room was given to new guest.
Hight of it was that when we came back to hotel the front desk guy made a key and told us to go and collect it from the room saying HIS SYSTEM SHOWS THE ROOM IS STILL UNOCCUPIED.  
When I opened the door a couple was in the room!!!!!!
The only restaurant can accommodate only 75 guests where as the hotel has about 90 rooms so capacity of about 180 guests. It is a big chaos at breakfast and dinner. 
Like a road side eatery you have wait on top of the just finishing guest to get a table.  Need less to say the staff just can't manage the rush at all. You ask for something nothing comes.  
The temperature controlled pool has some pump issue and the water is almost cold!!!
The jacuzzi for men 3 out 6 seats the jets don't work.
The jacuzzi for women is manned by man no female staff and the  water is cold.
I wish this beautiful property comes in some experienced hospitality group who understands in guest relation.

reviews.author: siddharthgajjar

reviews.author: petersreviews
reviews.title: First class hotel in the heart of beautiful Kashmir
reviews.text: An excellent hotel - comfortable, good value, varied and tasty local food (as well as international options), very helpful, professional and friendly staff. I highly recommend this to anyone visiting the region.

reviews.author: Ankit16tour
reviews.title: Awesome stay @ Gulmerg
reviews.text: We stayed in March. An enjoyable stay ,Nice spa, good food,good location .overall a nice resort to stay in Gulmerg and a friendly staff . Vegetarian food option is less it's not a complaint but they should have more options for vegetarian .overall a Awesome place and hotel for holidays

reviews.author: Dino1512
reviews.title: "Gulmarg - Heaven on Earth"
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to Gulmarg. We had been to Gulmarg during summer in June. It was lush green with only the mountain peaks covered in snow. Coming to Gulmarg in March was a completely a different experience. My wife being a travel agent, i knew she would do a thorough research on the places to stay. We eventually chose Khyber as we heard a lot of good reviews about the hotel and its courteous staff. 

It took us some time to reach the hotel as our car had trouble wading through the thick snow on the road, however once we entered the hotel it was just fabulous. The property is the best among the options available. What really stands out is the staff, they don't leave any opportunity to make your stay comfortable. Mr. Aditya Mata and his entire team made our stay memorable. So a big thank you to the entire team at Khyber.

While the location and courteous staff makes it a splendid property to stay, here are few pointers to note:-
1. The property is very close to the Gondola ride. Which is a big advantage
2. It is also very close to the Ski grounds. If you choose some good guides like we had, your experience will be truly awesome
3. Khyber food although not fancy is simple but very good. They have a decent spread of Kashmiri Wazwan for the 3 nights when we were there. However we felt they could do with some lavish spread considering the cost of the stay. Options for Veggies can be little limited.
4. The property does not sell alcohol, but they serve you if you make your own arrangements. Can be little turn off especially in that weather.
5. The bed is hard and the pillows were not comfortable for me, while my wife had no issues. 
6. The view from the rooms are mind blowing. every photo was a post card.
7. The heated pool and the works - steam, sauna & spa is a big plus. 

Overall we had an excellent stay at Khyber and we left Gulmarg with a very heavy heart, only to promise ourselves to come back to "Heaven on earth" some time soon!! Cheers

reviews.author: Americarte
reviews.title: an idyllic ski resort
reviews.text:
The Khyber combines hospitality expertise and personalised service. The hotel is committed to a warm setting which is both modern and comfortable with large rooms and amenities where you can feel at home. The hotel staff are enthusiastic and attentive, on hand and at your service 24/7. Whether you stay for business of leisure, every detail of the hotel is designed for your pleasure and relaxation.
Clad in timber and slate, the hotel has restaurants, cafes, heated swimming pool and spa. In summer most guests stay and go hiking along mountain trails and in winter the fresh deep powder is a snow riders’ delight. The hotel provides a delivery and pick up service to the Gulmarg gondola which rises up the mountain in two phases to 3.950 metres above sea level.
Wonderful hospitable stay - thanks to the GM, Aditya Mata and his friendly staff. In  particular, the Team Leaders: Zaffir Malik and Manzoor Alehtar.

reviews.author: Rutli
reviews.title: Awesome Stay
reviews.text:
What sets Khyber apart from a lot of other hotels I have stayed in is the attitude of the staff.
the staff here goes way above and beyond call of duty and brings alive the true Kashmir hospitality. A must try for all those who want a feel of home in their stays in hotels

reviews.author: sachinvividtraveller
reviews.title: Good hotel but average food
reviews.text: By far hotel Khyber in gulmarg is the best property in town but we being pure vegetarians cannot echo the same about their food. We stayed for four nights and found the vegetarian food lackingin taste, variety. They only know how to cook Kashmiri & little bit of mughlai food but beyond that there's nothing much to rave about. They must improve on vegetarian food for a better rating.

reviews.author: nixongupta
reviews.title: Khyber Hotel and Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text: I was there from the 5th of March to the 9th of March, the Hotel is just fabulous the location the rooms all are perfect nothing to complain, the food is ok nothing too great to rave about and so os the service the service by the waiters and other staff is also very average to ok, but other than that the whole experience in Gulmarg was just fabulous.

reviews.author: rashmipradeep
reviews.title: The Khyber was everything one could dream of-simply fantastic
reviews.text:
The views from the room with the balcony are simply breathtaking.It was a fairy tale picture post card..
The aesthetics of the room were local with beautifully embroidered Kashmiri linen and furniture. The staff at the hotel make Khyber extra special.The GM Mr Aditya Mata-was there looking after each guest personally to see how he could make each guest more comfortable .A special note for the banquets ..Mr Roshan was worth applauding! he took such special care.  Mr Abid another great asset! who helped us tremendously.The Khyber hotel- is the best you can get in Gulmarg. The "kehwa "at the hotel too was fabulous.Pls try some for sure

reviews.author: Jo D
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text:
The Khyber truly is one of those hotels where you would wan to stay indoors. The interiors are beautifully done in an exotic blend of Kashmiri and Moroccan art, which make the place even more cozy and inviting. 
The Lobby offers you an amazing view of the valley with its snow covered peaks. We were lucky to be welcomed by snowfall. The experience was beautiful. 
A special mention to the staff who are courteous and go out of their way to make you comfortable. Kudos guys. 
While there were some problems on our first day - our rooms sadly was on the back side and didn't have not much of a view, plumbing problems and temperature control. However I must add that the management was kind enough to change our room the next day, and one with a view :) 
All in all, if you are looking for a quiet time away from the bustle of the crowds, this is a place you need to visit. The Kashmiri cuisine too is sumptuous. You must try the Dum Biryani.

reviews.author: Abhishek B
reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Gorgeous!!! only way to describe the location and hotel. The views from the room are breathtaking. The hotel is beautiful with a great indoor heated pool. Gulmarg in winters is simply amazing and there is no better place than the Khyber to stay and enjoy the beauty.
The buffet spread for dinner could do with a little improvement.

reviews.author: A_SK
reviews.title: Super!
reviews.text: We went skiing with our children and had a wonderful stay at the Khyber. The staff were courteous, helpful and flexible with our children's needs. Lovely views, comfortable and great place to stay for a skiing vacation.

reviews.author: Salil_09
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: This property is best enjoyed during snow fall. We stayed there for just 2 days... and wanted to cry while checking out. I am going back every winter for sure. One of the best hotels i have ever been to. The service is just superb. The staff just doesn't say no to anything. The heated pool is amazing... and really enjoyable. The whole theme of the hotel makes u feel so warm and cozy even when its snowing outside.

reviews.author: RomalSuri
reviews.title: Mesmerising Experience at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Words fall short to describe our 3 nights stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa ,Gulmarg .. The whole experience was truly a memorable one and the memories shall be cherished forever !

The moment you step into the hotel ,you feel like you've stepped back in time when living life meant enjoying a cocktail and the lively art of conversation. This hotel has the most friendly staff  and were extremely prompt & courteous.Its truly a luxury experience and a must visit for every avid traveller ..True, the rooms are "extremely cozy & comfy " and each room opens to a breathtaking view .I'm yet to see a more picturesque place in India ..Had a lovely experience at their spa by l'occitane and their other facilities like the gym & swimming pool were top class ..  Don't miss out staying at the Khyber  if you want to truly enhance your Kashmir experience. 

I have been promoting this property to all my near & dear ones , needless to say ,that  speaks volumes about the place ..

"I cannot rave enough & would definitely return again"

Romal Suri 
CEO A.R PLACEMENTS

reviews.author: amitlodha23
reviews.title: Amazing property in snowy peaks of Gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber is a property which signifies quality in the hills of Kashmir. The property signifies luxury and sophistication in all respects. The rooms are large and are luxurious, we stayed in luxury room with balcony. Food was just ok and could be better. In all I would say though over priced hotel signifies luxury and comfort

reviews.author: Puni11
reviews.title: An awesome time amidst the snow capped mountains..
reviews.text: From the color to the entrance, the chandeliers to the lobby,the rooms to the bathroom, the view to the ambience, the food to the service, the courteous staff to the caring management, every little bit is awesome. Its Paradise !!

reviews.author: nitindalal_13
reviews.title: Ideal place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Hotel is proper 5* category. Beautiful lobby, Well furnished rooms, amazing bathrooms, Most helping and courteous staff. We stayed for 2 nights. Only suggestion is hotel should have more activity during winter within hotel as due to snow.

reviews.author: NirajKothari
reviews.title: Experience at Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg
reviews.text: We were a group of 12 Friends & stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights. It was one of the best experiences we've ever had, in terms of Property, Rooms, Service, Food, Courteousness, and of course - Snow Snow & Snow all around us. Wud like to mention a few Staff names in particular - Mr.Mithun Mondal, Mr.Rameez, Mr.Shyam Kumar, among others, who were extremely courteous & co-operative. Wud rate this hotel as One of the top 10 hotels I have visited globally.

reviews.author: Anaita E
reviews.title: By far The most comfortable accommodation in Gulmarg.
reviews.text:
Being the only 5star in Gulmarg this property wins hands down.
However the property is brand new so the Spa. Pool n activity CENTER not functioning which is disappointing as One gets done with Skiing by 4pm n not much to do after that at the hotel- improve on in house activities!
The views from this hotel are so spectacular that a glass of Pinot whilst taking on the natural beauty wud hit the spot  unfortunately   The hotel does not serve alcohol so carry ur own.

Breakfast at the hotel is fantastic however The food menu is very limited. Their F&B could do with a revamp. 

The rooms very comfortable n  views from the room were breathtaking.  

The hotel staff very polite n efficient. The key staff were knowledgable however not much can be said for other staff in general. 

The Internet is limited to only 2 devices per room which is not made clear whilst purchasing the package so a little disappointing. 

I'm sure the hotel will only get better with time n all teething problems sorted out before my next visit. 

I will most certainly stay at this property again n suggest it to all.

A suggestion Omar, this hotel will do wonders if run by a prof company my thoughts are its a perfect fit for The Autograph Collection.
